verses.sa:
त्वां ह्यग्ने सदमित्समन्यवो देवासो देवमरतिं न्येरिर इति क्रत्वा न्येरिरे ।
अमर्त्यं यजत मर्त्येष्वा देवमादेवं जनत प्रचेतसं विश्वमादेवं जनत प्रचेतसम्॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ hyagne sadamitsamanyavo devāso devamaratiṃ nyerira iti kratvā nyerire amartyaṃ yajata martyeṣvā devamādevaṃ janata pracetasaṃ viśvamādevaṃ janata pracetasam
verses.en: Thee Agni, have the Gods, ever of one accord, sent hither down, a God, appointed messenger, yea, with their wisdom sent thee down. The Immortal, O thou Holy One, mid mortal men, the God-devoted God, the wise, have they brought forth, brought forth the omnipresent God-devoted Sage.

verses.sa:
स भ्रातरं वरुणमग्न आ ववृत्स्व देवाँ अच्छा सुमती यज्ञवनसं ज्येष्ठं यज्ञवनसम् ।
ऋतावानमादित्यं चर्षणीधृतं राजानं चर्षणीधृतम्॥
verses.tr: sa bhrātaraṃ varuṇamagna ā vavṛtsva devāṃ acchā sumatī yajñavanasaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ yajñavanasam ṛtāvānamādityaṃ carṣaṇīdhṛtaṃ rājānaṃ carṣaṇīdhṛtam
verses.en: As such, O Agni, bring with favour to the Gods thy Brother Varuna who loveth sacrifice, True to the Law, the Aditya who supporteth men, the King, supporter of mankind.

verses.sa:
सखे सखायमभ्या ववृत्स्वाशुं न चक्रं रथ्येव रंह्यास्मभ्यं दस्म रंह्या ।
अग्ने मृळीकं वरुणे सचा विदो मरुत्सु विश्वभानुषु ।
तोकाय तुजे शुशुचान शं कृध्यस्मभ्यं दस्म शं कृधि॥
verses.tr: sakhe sakhāyamabhyā vavṛtsvāśuṃ na cakraṃ rathyeva raṃhyāsmabhyaṃ dasma raṃhyā agne mṛḻīkaṃ varuṇe sacā vido marutsu viśvabhānuṣu tokāya tuje śuśucāna śaṃ kṛdhyasmabhyaṃ dasma śaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Do thou, O Friend, turn hither him who is our Friend, swift as a wheel, like two car-steeds in rapid course, Wondrous! to us in rapid course. O Agni, find thou grace for us with Varuna, with Maruts who illumine all. Bless us, thou Radiant One, for seed and progeny, yea, bless us, O thou Wondrous God.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने वरुणस्य विद्वान् देवस्य हेळोऽव यासिसीष्ठाः ।
यजिष्ठो वह्नितमः शोशुचानो विश्वा द्वेषांसि प्र मुमुग्ध्यस्मत्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvān devasya heḻo'va yāsisīṣṭhāḥ yajiṣṭho vahnitamaḥ śośucāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi pra mumugdhyasmat
verses.en: Do thou who knowest Varuna, O Agni, put far away from us the God's displeasure. Best Sacrificer, brightest One, refulgent remove thou far from us all those who hate us.

verses.sa:
स त्वं नो अग्नेऽवमो भवोती नेदिष्ठो अस्या उषसो व्युष्टौ ।
अव यक्ष्व नो वरुणं रराणो वीहि मृळीकं सुहवो न एधि॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ no agne'vamo bhavotī nediṣṭho asyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau ava yakṣva no varuṇaṃ rarāṇo vīhi mṛḻīkaṃ suhavo na edhi
verses.en: Be thou, O Agni, nearest us with succour, our closest Friend while now this Morn is breaking. Reconcile to us Varuna, be bounteous enjoy the gracious juice; be swift to hear us.

verses.sa:
अस्य श्रेष्ठा सुभगस्य संदृग् देवस्य चित्रतमा मर्त्येषु ।
शुचि घृतं न तप्तमघ्न्यायाः स्पार्हा देवस्य मंहनेव धेनोः॥
verses.tr: asya śreṣṭhā subhagasya saṃdṛg devasya citratamā martyeṣu śuci ghṛtaṃ na taptamaghnyāyāḥ spārhā devasya maṃhaneva dhenoḥ
verses.en: Excellent is the glance, of brightest splendour, which the auspicious God bestows on mortals- The God's glance, longed-for even as the butter, pure, heated, of the cow, the milch-cow's bounty.

verses.sa:
त्रिरस्य ता परमा सन्ति सत्या स्पार्हा देवस्य जनिमान्यग्नेः ।
अनन्ते अन्तः परिवीत आगाच्छुचिः शुक्रो अर्यो रोरुचानः॥
verses.tr: trirasya tā paramā santi satyā spārhā devasya janimānyagneḥ anante antaḥ parivīta āgācchuciḥ śukro aryo rorucānaḥ
verses.en: Three are those births, the true, the most exalted, eagerly longed-for, of the God, of Agni. He came invested in the boundless region, pure, radiant, friendly, mightily resplendent.

verses.sa:
स दूतो विश्वेदभि वष्टि सद्मा होता हिरण्यरथो रंसुजिह्वः ।
रोहिदश्वो वपुष्यो विभावा सदा रण्वः पितुमतीव संसत्॥
verses.tr: sa dūto viśvedabhi vaṣṭi sadmā hotā hiraṇyaratho raṃsujihvaḥ rohidaśvo vapuṣyo vibhāvā sadā raṇvaḥ pitumatīva saṃsat
verses.en: This envoy joyeth in all seats of worship, borne on his golden car, sweet-tongued Invoker: Lovely to look on, with red steeds, effulgent, like a feast rich in food, joyous for ever.

verses.sa:
स चेतयन्मनुषो यज्ञबन्धुः प्र तं मह्या रशनया नयन्ति ।
स क्षेत्यस्य दुर्यासु साधन् देवो मर्तस्य सधनित्वमाप॥
verses.tr: sa cetayanmanuṣo yajñabandhuḥ pra taṃ mahyā raśanayā nayanti sa kṣetyasya duryāsu sādhan devo martasya sadhanitvamāpa
verses.en: Allied by worship, let him give man knowledge: by an extended cord they lead him onward. He stays, effectual in this mortal's dwelling, and the God wins a share in his possessions.

verses.sa:
स तू नो अग्निर्नयतु प्रजानन्नच्छा रत्नं देवभक्तं यदस्य ।
धिया यद् विश्वे अमृता अकृण्वन् द्यौष्पिता जनिता सत्यमुक्षन्॥
verses.tr: sa tū no agnirnayatu prajānannacchā ratnaṃ devabhaktaṃ yadasya dhiyā yad viśve amṛtā akṛṇvan dyauṣpitā janitā satyamukṣan
verses.en: Let Agni -for he knows the way- conduct us to all that he enjoys of God-sent riches, What all the Immortals have prepared with wisdom, Dyaus, Sire, Begetter, raining down true blessings.

verses.sa:
स जायत प्रथमः पस्त्यासु महो बुध्ने रजसो अस्य योनौ ।
अपादशीर्षा गुहमानो अन्ता ऽऽयोयुवानो वृषभस्य नीळे॥
verses.tr: sa jāyata prathamaḥ pastyāsu maho budhne rajaso asya yonau apādaśīrṣā guhamāno antā ''yoyuvāno vṛṣabhasya nīḻe
verses.en: In houses first he sprang into existence, at great heaven's base, and in this region's bosom; Footless and headless, both his ends concealing, in his Bull's lair drawing himself together.

verses.sa:
प्र शर्ध आर्त प्रथमं विपन्याँ ऋतस्य योना वृषभस्य नीळे ।
स्पार्हो युवा वपुष्यो विभावा सप्त प्रियासोऽजनयन्त वृष्णे॥
verses.tr: pra śardha ārta prathamaṃ vipanyāṃ ṛtasya yonā vṛṣabhasya nīḻe spārho yuvā vapuṣyo vibhāvā sapta priyāso'janayanta vṛṣṇe
verses.en: Wondrously first he rose aloft, defiant, in the Bull's lair, the home of holy Order, Longed-for, young, beautiful, and far-resplendent: and seven dear friends sprang up unto the Mighty.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमत्र पितरो मनुष्या अभि प्र सेदुर्ऋतमाशुषाणाः ।
अश्मव्रजाः सुदुघा वव्रे अन्तरुदुस्रा आजन्नुषसो हुवानाः॥
verses.tr: asmākamatra pitaro manuṣyā abhi pra sedurṛtamāśuṣāṇāḥ aśmavrajāḥ sudughā vavre antarudusrā ājannuṣaso huvānāḥ
verses.en: Here did our human fathers take their places, fain to fulfil the sacred Law of worship. Forth drave they, with loud call, Dawn's teeming Milch-kine bid in the mountain stable, in the cavern.

verses.sa:
ते मर्मृजत ददृवांसो अद्रिं तदेषामन्ये अभितो वि वोचन् ।
पश्वयन्त्रासो अभि कारमर्चन् विदन्त ज्योतिश्चकृपन्त धीभिः॥
verses.tr: te marmṛjata dadṛvāṃso adriṃ tadeṣāmanye abhito vi vocan paśvayantrāso abhi kāramarcan vidanta jyotiścakṛpanta dhībhiḥ
verses.en: Splendid were they when they had rent the mountain: others, around, shall tell forth this their exploit. They sang their song, prepared to free the cattle: they found the light; with holy hymns they worshipped.

verses.sa:
ते गव्यता मनसा दृध्रमुब्धं गा येमानं परि षन्तमद्रिम् ।
दृळहं नरो वचसा दैव्येन व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो वि वव्रुः॥
verses.tr: te gavyatā manasā dṛdhramubdhaṃ gā yemānaṃ pari ṣantamadrim dṛḻahaṃ naro vacasā daivyena vrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ
verses.en: Eager, with thought intent upon the booty, the men with their celestial speech threw open, The solid mountain firm, compact, enclosing, confining Cows, the stable full of cattle.

verses.sa:
ते मन्वत प्रथमं नाम धेनोस्त्रिः सप्त मातुः परमाणि विन्दन् ।
तज्जानतीरभ्यनूषत व्रा आविर्भुवदरुणीर्यशसा गोः॥
verses.tr: te manvata prathamaṃ nāma dhenostriḥ sapta mātuḥ paramāṇi vindan tajjānatīrabhyanūṣata vrā āvirbhuvadaruṇīryaśasā goḥ
verses.en: The Milch-cow's earliest name they comprehended: they found the Mother's thrice-seven noblest titles. This the bands knew, and sent forth acclamation: with the Bull's sheen the Red One was apparent.

verses.sa:
नेशत् तमो दुधितं रोचत द्यौरुद्देव्या उषसो भानुरर्त ।
आ सूर्यो बृहतस्तिष्ठदज्राँ ऋजु मर्तेषु वृजिना च पश्यन्॥
verses.tr: neśat tamo dudhitaṃ rocata dyauruddevyā uṣaso bhānurarta ā sūryo bṛhatastiṣṭhadajrāṃ ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyan
verses.en: The turbid darkness fled, the heaven was splendid! up rose the bright beam of celestial Morning. Surya ascended to the wide expanses, beholding deeds of men both good and evil.

verses.sa:
आदित् पश्चा बुबुधाना व्यख्यन्नादिद् रत्नं धारयन्त द्युभक्तम् ।
विश्वे विश्वासु दुर्यासु देवा मित्र धिये वरुण सत्यमस्तु॥
verses.tr: ādit paścā bubudhānā vyakhyannādid ratnaṃ dhārayanta dyubhaktam viśve viśvāsu duryāsu devā mitra dhiye varuṇa satyamastu
verses.en: Then, afterwards they looked around, awakened, when first they held that Heaven allotted treasure. Now all the Gods abide in all their dwellings. Varuna, Mitra, be the prayer effective.

verses.sa:
अच्छा वोचेय शुशुचानमग्निं होतारं विश्वभरसं यजिष्ठम् ।
शुच्यूधो अतृणन्न गवामन्धो न पूतं परिषिक्तमंशोः॥
verses.tr: acchā voceya śuśucānamagniṃ hotāraṃ viśvabharasaṃ yajiṣṭham śucyūdho atṛṇanna gavāmandho na pūtaṃ pariṣiktamaṃśoḥ
verses.en: I will call hither brightly-beaming Agni, the Herald, all-supporting, best at worship. He hath disclosed, like the milch cows' pure udder, the Sorria's juice when cleansed and poured from beakers.

verses.sa:
विश्वेषामदितिर्यज्ञियानां विश्वेषामतिथिर्मानुषाणाम् ।
अग्निर्देवानामव आवृणानः सुमृळीको भवतु जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: viśveṣāmaditiryajñiyānāṃ viśveṣāmatithirmānuṣāṇām agnirdevānāmava āvṛṇānaḥ sumṛḻīko bhavatu jātavedāḥ
verses.en: The freest God of all who should be worshipped, the guest who is received in all men's houses, Agni who hath secured the Gods' high favour,-may he be gracious, to us Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
यो मर्त्येष्वमृत ऋतावा देवो देवेष्वरतिर्निधायि ।
होता यजिष्ठो मह्ना शुचध्यै हव्यैरग्निर्मनुष ईरयध्यै॥
verses.tr: yo martyeṣvamṛta ṛtāvā devo deveṣvaratirnidhāyi hotā yajiṣṭho mahnā śucadhyai havyairagnirmanuṣa īrayadhyai
verses.en: The, Faithful One, Immortal among mortals, a God among the Gods, appointed envoy, Priest, best at worship, must shine forth in glory. Agni shall be raised high with man's oblations.

verses.sa:
इह त्वं सूनो सहसो नो अद्य जातो जाताँ उभयाँ अन्तरग्ने ।
दूत ईयसे युयुजान ऋष्व ऋजुमुष्कान् वृषणः शुक्राँश्च॥
verses.tr: iha tvaṃ sūno sahaso no adya jāto jātāṃ ubhayāṃ antaragne dūta īyase yuyujāna ṛṣva ṛjumuṣkān vṛṣaṇaḥ śukrāṃśca
verses.en: Born for us here this day, O Son of Vigour, between both races of born beings, Agni, Thou farest as an envoy, having harnessed, Sublime One! thy strong-muscled radiant stallions.

verses.sa:
अत्या वृधस्नू रोहिता घृतस्नू ऋतस्य मन्ये मनसा जविष्ठा ।
अन्तरीयसे अरुषा युजानो युष्माँश्च देवान् विश आ च मर्तान्॥
verses.tr: atyā vṛdhasnū rohitā ghṛtasnū ṛtasya manye manasā javiṣṭhā antarīyase aruṣā yujāno yuṣmāṃśca devān viśa ā ca martān
verses.en: I laud the ruddy steeds who pour down blessing, dropping oil, fleetest through the thoualit of Order. Yoking red horses to and fro thou goest between you Deities and mortal races.

verses.sa:
अर्यमणं वरुणं मित्रमेषामिन्द्राविष्णू मरुतो अश्विनोत ।
स्वश्वो अग्ने सुरथः सुराधा एदु वह सुहविषे जनाय॥
verses.tr: aryamaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ mitrameṣāmindrāviṣṇū maruto aśvinota svaśvo agne surathaḥ surādhā edu vaha suhaviṣe janāya
verses.en: Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna, and Indra with Visnu, of the Gods, Maruts and Asvins- These, Agni, with good car and steeds, bring hither, most bountiful, to folk with fair oblations.

verses.sa:
गोमाँ अग्नेऽविमाँ अश्वी यज्ञो नृवत्सखा सदमिदप्रमृष्यः ।
इळावाँ एषो असुर प्रजावान्दीर्घो रयिः पृथुबुध्नः सभावान्॥
verses.tr: gomāṃ agne'vimāṃ aśvī yajño nṛvatsakhā sadamidapramṛṣyaḥ iḻāvāṃ eṣo asura prajāvāndīrgho rayiḥ pṛthubudhnaḥ sabhāvān
verses.en: Agni, be this our sacrifice eternal, with brave friends, rich in kine and sheep and horses, Rich, Asura! in sacred food and children, in full assembly, wealth broad-based and during.

verses.sa:
यस्त इध्मं जभरत् सिष्विदानो मूर्धानं वा ततपते त्वाया ।
भुवस्तस्य स्वतवाँः पायुरग्ने विश्वस्मात्सी सीमघायत उरुष्य॥
verses.tr: yasta idhmaṃ jabharat siṣvidāno mūrdhānaṃ vā tatapate tvāyā bhuvastasya svatavāṃḥ pāyuragne viśvasmātsī sīmaghāyata uruṣya
verses.en: The man who, sweating, brings for thee the fuel, and makes his head to ache, thy faithful servant,- Agni, to him be a self-strong Protector guard him from all who seek to do him mischief.

verses.sa:
यस्ते भरादन्नियते चिदन्नं निशिषन्मन्द्रमतिथिमुदीरत् ।
आ देवयुरिनधते दुरोणे तस्मिन् रयिर्ध्रुवो अस्तु दास्वान्॥
verses.tr: yaste bharādanniyate cidannaṃ niśiṣanmandramatithimudīrat ā devayurinadhate duroṇe tasmin rayirdhruvo astu dāsvān
verses.en: Who brings thee food, though thou hast food in plenty, welcomes his cheerful guest and speeds him onward, Who kindles thee devoutly in his dwelling to him be wealth secure and freely giving.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा दोषा य उषसि प्रशंसात् प्रियं वा त्वा कृणवते हविष्मान् ।
अश्वो न स्वे दम आ हेम्यावान् तमंहसः पीपरो दाश्वांसम्॥
verses.tr: yastvā doṣā ya uṣasi praśaṃsāt priyaṃ vā tvā kṛṇavate haviṣmān aśvo na sve dama ā hemyāvān tamaṃhasaḥ pīparo dāśvāṃsam
verses.en: Whoso sings praise to thee at eve or morning, and, with oblation, doth the thing thou lovest,- In his own home, even as a gold-girt courser, rescue him from distress, the bounteous giver.

verses.sa:
यस्तुभ्यमग्ने अमृताय दाशद् दुवस्त्वे कृणवते यतस्रुक् ।
न स राया शशमानो वि योषन्नैनमंहः परि वरदघायोः॥
verses.tr: yastubhyamagne amṛtāya dāśad duvastve kṛṇavate yatasruk na sa rāyā śaśamāno vi yoṣannainamaṃhaḥ pari varadaghāyoḥ
verses.en: Whoso brings gifts to thee Immortal, Agni, and doth thee service with uplifted ladle,- Let him not, sorely toiling, lose his riches; let not the sinner's wickedness enclose him.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्वमग्ने अध्वरं जुजोषो देवो मर्तस्य सुधितं रराणः ।
प्रीतेदसद्धोत्रा सा यविष्ठाऽसाम यस्य विधतो वृधासः॥
verses.tr: yasya tvamagne adhvaraṃ jujoṣo devo martasya sudhitaṃ rarāṇaḥ prītedasaddhotrā sā yaviṣṭhā'sāma yasya vidhato vṛdhāsaḥ
verses.en: Whose well-wrought worship thou acceptest, Agni, thou God a mortal's gift, thou liberal Giver,- Dear be his sacrifice to thee, Most Youthful! and may we strengthen him when he adores thee.

verses.sa:
चित्तिमचित्तिं चिनवद् वि विद्वान् पृष्ठेव वीता वृजिना च मर्तान् ।
राये च नः स्वपत्याय देव दितिं च रास्वादितिमुरुष्य॥
verses.tr: cittimacittiṃ cinavad vi vidvān pṛṣṭheva vītā vṛjinā ca martān rāye ca naḥ svapatyāya deva ditiṃ ca rāsvāditimuruṣya
verses.en: May he who knows distinguish sense and folly of men, like straight and crooked backs of horses. Lead us, O God, to wealth and noble offspring: keep penury afar and grant us plenty.

verses.sa:
कविं शशासुः कवयोऽदब्धा निधारयन्तो दुर्यास्वायोः ।
अतस्त्वं दृश्याँ अग्न एतान् पड्भिः पश्येरद्भुताँ अर्य एवैः॥
verses.tr: kaviṃ śaśāsuḥ kavayo'dabdhā nidhārayanto duryāsvāyoḥ atastvaṃ dṛśyāṃ agna etān paḍbhiḥ paśyeradbhutāṃ arya evaiḥ
verses.en: This Sage the Sages, ne'er deceived, commanded, setting him down in dwellings of the living. Hence mayst thou, friendly God, with rapid footsteps behold the Gods, wonderful, fair to look on.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वाघते सुप्रणीतिः सुतसोमाय विधते यविष्ठ ।
रत्नं भर शशमानाय घृष्वे पृथु श्चन्द्रमवसे चर्षणिप्राः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne vāghate supraṇītiḥ sutasomāya vidhate yaviṣṭha ratnaṃ bhara śaśamānāya ghṛṣve pṛthu ścandramavase carṣaṇiprāḥ
verses.en: Good guidance hast thou for the priest, O Agni, who, Youngest God! with outpoured Soma serves thee. Ruler of men, thou joyous God, bring treasure splendid and plentiful to aid the toiler.

verses.sa:
अधा ह यद् वयमग्ने त्वाया पड्भिर्हस्तेभिश्चकृमा तनूभिः ।
रथं न क्रन्तो अपसा भुरिजोर्ऋतं येमुः सुध्य आशुषाणाः॥
verses.tr: adhā ha yad vayamagne tvāyā paḍbhirhastebhiścakṛmā tanūbhiḥ rathaṃ na kranto apasā bhurijorṛtaṃ yemuḥ sudhya āśuṣāṇāḥ
verses.en: Now all that we, thy faithful servants, Agni, have done with feet, with hands, and with our bodies, The wise, with toil, the holy rite have guided, as those who frame a car with manual cunning.

verses.sa:
अधा मातुरुषसः सप्त विप्रा जायेमहि प्रथमा वेधसो नॄन् ।
दिवस्पुत्रा अङ्गिरसो भवेमाद्रिं रुजेम धनिनं शुचन्तः॥
verses.tr: adhā māturuṣasaḥ sapta viprā jāyemahi prathamā vedhaso nṝn divasputrā aṅgiraso bhavemādriṃ rujema dhaninaṃ śucantaḥ
verses.en: May we, seven sages first in rank, engender, from Dawn the Mother, men to be ordainers. May we, Angirases, be sons of Heaven, and, radiant, burst the wealth-containing mountain.

verses.sa:
अधा यथा नः पितरः परासः प्रत्नासो अग्न ऋतमाशुषाणाः ।
शुचीदयन् दीधितिमुक्थशासः क्षामा भिन्दन्तो अरुणीरप व्रन्॥
verses.tr: adhā yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsaḥ pratnāso agna ṛtamāśuṣāṇāḥ śucīdayan dīdhitimukthaśāsaḥ kṣāmā bhindanto aruṇīrapa vran
verses.en: As in the days of old our ancient Fathers, speeding the work of holy worship, Agni, Sought pure light and devotion, singing praises; they cleft the ground and made red Dawns apparent.

verses.sa:
सुकर्माणः सुरुचो देवयन्तोऽयो न देवा जनिमा धमन्तः ।
शुचन्तो अग्निं ववृधन्त इन्द्रमूर्वं गव्यं परिषदन्तो अग्मन्॥
verses.tr: sukarmāṇaḥ suruco devayanto'yo na devā janimā dhamantaḥ śucanto agniṃ vavṛdhanta indramūrvaṃ gavyaṃ pariṣadanto agman
verses.en: Gods, doing holy acts, devout, resplendent, smelting like ore their human generations. Enkindling Agni and exalting Indra, they came encompassing the stall of cattle.

verses.sa:
आ यूथेव क्षुमति पश्वो अख्यद् देवानां यज्जनिमान्त्युग्र ।
मर्तानां चिदुर्वशीरकृप्रन् वृधे चिदर्य उपरस्यायोः॥
verses.tr: ā yūtheva kṣumati paśvo akhyad devānāṃ yajjanimāntyugra martānāṃ cidurvaśīrakṛpran vṛdhe cidarya uparasyāyoḥ
verses.en: Strong One! he marked them-and the Gods before them-like herds of cattle in a foodful pasture. There they moaned forth their strong desire for mortals, to aid the True, the nearest One, the Living.

verses.sa:
अकर्म ते स्वपसो अभूम ऋतमवस्रन्नुषसो विभातीः ।
अनूनमग्निं पुरुधा सुश्चन्द्रं देवस्य मर्मृजतश्चारु चक्षुः॥
verses.tr: akarma te svapaso abhūma ṛtamavasrannuṣaso vibhātīḥ anūnamagniṃ purudhā suścandraṃ devasya marmṛjataścāru cakṣuḥ
verses.en: We have worked for thee, we have laboured nobly-bright Dawns have shed their light upon our worship- Adding a beauty to the perfect Agni, and the God's beauteous eye that shines for ever.

verses.sa:
एता ते अग्न उचथानि वेधोऽवोचाम कवये ता जुषस्व ।
उच्छोचस्व कृणुहि वस्यसो नो महो रायः पुरुवार प्र यन्धि॥
verses.tr: etā te agna ucathāni vedho'vocāma kavaye tā juṣasva ucchocasva kṛṇuhi vasyaso no maho rāyaḥ puruvāra pra yandhi
verses.en: Agni, Disposer, we have sung these praises to thee the Wise: do thou accept them gladly. Blaze up on high and ever make us richer. Give us great wealth, O thou whose boons are many.

verses.sa:
आ वो राजानमध्वरस्य रुद्रं होतारं सत्ययजं रोदस्योः ।
अग्निं पुरा तनयित्नोरचित्ताद्धिरण्यरूपमवसे कृणुध्वम्॥
verses.tr: ā vo rājānamadhvarasya rudraṃ hotāraṃ satyayajaṃ rodasyoḥ agniṃ purā tanayitnoracittāddhiraṇyarūpamavase kṛṇudhvam
verses.en: Win, to assist you, Rudra, Lord of worship, Priest of both worlds, effectual Sacrificer, Agni, invested with his golden colours, before the thunder strike and lay you senseless.

verses.sa:
अयं योनिश्चकृमा यं वयं ते जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासाः ।
अर्वाचीनः परिवीतो नि षीदेमा उ ते स्वपाक प्रतीचीः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ yoniścakṛmā yaṃ vayaṃ te jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ arvācīnaḥ parivīto ni ṣīdemā u te svapāka pratīcīḥ
verses.en: This shrine have we made ready for thy coming, as the fond dame attires her for her husband. Performer of good work, sit down before us, invested while these flames incline to meet thee.

verses.sa:
आशृण्वते अदृपिताय मन्म नृचक्षसे सुमृळीकाय वेधः ।
देवाय शस्तिममृताय शंस ग्रावेव सोता मधुषुद् यमीळे॥
verses.tr: āśṛṇvate adṛpitāya manma nṛcakṣase sumṛḻīkāya vedhaḥ devāya śastimamṛtāya śaṃsa grāveva sotā madhuṣud yamīḻe
verses.en: A hymn, O Priest, to him who hears, the gentle, to him who looks on men, exceeding gracious, A song of praise sing to the God Immortal, whom the stone, presser of the sweet juice, worships.

verses.sa:
त्वं चिन्नः शम्या अग्ने अस्या ऋतस्य बोध्यृतचित् स्वाधीः ।
कदा त उक्था सधमाद्यानि कदा भवन्ति सख्या गृहे ते॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ cinnaḥ śamyā agne asyā ṛtasya bodhyṛtacit svādhīḥ kadā ta ukthā sadhamādyāni kadā bhavanti sakhyā gṛhe te
verses.en: Even as true knower of the Law, O Agni, to this our solemn rite he thou attentive. When shall thy songs of festival be sung thee? When is thy friendship shown within our dwelling?

verses.sa:
कथा ह तद् वरुणाय त्वमग्ने कथा दिवे गर्हसे कन्न आगः ।
कथा मित्राय मीळहुषे पृथिव्यै ब्रवः कदर्यम्णे कद् भगाय॥
verses.tr: kathā ha tad varuṇāya tvamagne kathā dive garhase kanna āgaḥ kathā mitrāya mīḻahuṣe pṛthivyai bravaḥ kadaryamṇe kad bhagāya
verses.en: Why this complaint to Varuna, O Agni? And why to Heaven? for what is our transgression? How wilt thou speak to Earth and bounteous Mitra? What wilt thou say to Aryaman and Bhaga?

verses.sa:
कद्धिष्ण्यासु वृधसानो अग्ने कद् वाताय प्रतवसे शुभंये ।
परिज्मने नासत्याय क्षे ब्रवः कदग्ने रुद्राय नृघ्ने॥
verses.tr: kaddhiṣṇyāsu vṛdhasāno agne kad vātāya pratavase śubhaṃye parijmane nāsatyāya kṣe bravaḥ kadagne rudrāya nṛghne
verses.en: What, when thou blazest on the lesser altars, what to the mighty Wind who comes to bless us, True, circumambient? what to Earth, O Agni, what wilt thou say to man-destroying Rudra?

verses.sa:
कथा महे पुष्टिम्भराय पूष्णे कद्रुद्राय सुमखाय हविर्दे ।
कद् विष्णव उरुगायाय रेतो ब्रवः कदग्ने शरवे बृहत्यै॥
verses.tr: kathā mahe puṣṭimbharāya pūṣṇe kadrudrāya sumakhāya havirde kad viṣṇava urugāyāya reto bravaḥ kadagne śarave bṛhatyai
verses.en: How to great Pusan who promotes our welfare,- to honoured Rudra what, who gives oblations? What sin of ours to the far-striding Visnu, what, Agni, wilt thou tell the Lofty Arrow.

verses.sa:
कथा शर्धाय मरुतामृताय कथा सूरे बृहते पृच्छ्यमानः ।
प्रति ब्रवोऽदितये तुराय साधा दिवो जातवेदश्चिकित्वान्॥
verses.tr: kathā śardhāya marutāmṛtāya kathā sūre bṛhate pṛcchyamānaḥ prati bravo'ditaye turāya sādhā divo jātavedaścikitvān
verses.en: What wilt thou tell the truthful band of Maruts, how answer the great Sun when thou art questioned? Before the Free, before the Swift, defend us: fulfil heaven's work, all-knowing Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन ऋतं नियतमीळ आ गोरामा सचा मधुमत् पक्वमग्ने ।
कृष्णा सती रुशता धासिनैषा जामर्येण पयसा पीपाय॥
verses.tr: ṛtena ṛtaṃ niyatamīḻa ā gorāmā sacā madhumat pakvamagne kṛṣṇā satī ruśatā dhāsinaiṣā jāmaryeṇa payasā pīpāya
verses.en: I crave the cow's true gift arranged by Order: though raw, she hath the sweet ripe juice, O Agni. Though she is black of hue with milk she teemeth, nutritious, brightly shining, all-sustaining.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन हि ष्मा वृषभश्चिदक्तः पुमाँ अग्निः पयसा पृष्ठ्येन ।
अस्पन्दमानो अचरद् वयोधा वृषा शुक्रं दुदुहे पृश्निरूधः॥
verses.tr: ṛtena hi ṣmā vṛṣabhaścidaktaḥ pumāṃ agniḥ payasā pṛṣṭhyena aspandamāno acarad vayodhā vṛṣā śukraṃ duduhe pṛśnirūdhaḥ
verses.en: Agni the Bull, the manly, hath been sprinkled with oil upon his back, by Law eternal. He who gives vital power goes on unswerving. Prsni the Bull hath milked the pure white udder.

verses.sa:
ऋतेनाद्रिं व्यसन् भिदन्तः समङ्गिरसो नवन्त गोभिः ।
शुनं नरः परि षदन्नुषासमाविः स्वरभवज्जाते अग्नौ॥
verses.tr: ṛtenādriṃ vyasan bhidantaḥ samaṅgiraso navanta gobhiḥ śunaṃ naraḥ pari ṣadannuṣāsamāviḥ svarabhavajjāte agnau
verses.en: By Law the Angirases cleft the rock asunder, and sang their hymns together with the cattle. Bringing great bliss the men encompassed Morning: light was apparent at the birth of Agni.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन देवीरमृता अमृक्ता अर्णोभिरापो मधुमद्भिरग्ने ।
वाजी न सर्गेषु प्रस्तुभानः प्र सदमित् स्रवितवे दधन्युः॥
verses.tr: ṛtena devīramṛtā amṛktā arṇobhirāpo madhumadbhiragne vājī na sargeṣu prastubhānaḥ pra sadamit sravitave dadhanyuḥ
verses.en: By Law the Immortal Goddesses the Waters, with meath-rich waves, O Agni, and uninjured, Like a strong courser lauded in his running, sped to flow onward swiftly and for ever.

verses.sa:
मा कस्य यक्षं सदमिद्धुरो गा मा वेशस्य प्रमिनतो मापेः ।
मा भ्रातुरग्ने अनृजोर्ऋणं वेर्मा सख्युर्दक्षं रिपोर्भुजेम॥
verses.tr: mā kasya yakṣaṃ sadamiddhuro gā mā veśasya praminato māpeḥ mā bhrāturagne anṛjorṛṇaṃ vermā sakhyurdakṣaṃ riporbhujema
verses.en: Go never to the feast of one who harms us, the treacherous neighbour or. unworthy kinsman. Punish us not for a false brother's trespass. Let us riot feel the might of friend or foeman.

verses.sa:
रक्षा णो अग्ने तव रक्षणेभी रारक्षाणः सुमख प्रीणानः ।
प्रति ष्फुर वि रुज वीड्वंहो जहि रक्षो महि चिद् वावृधानम्॥
verses.tr: rakṣā ṇo agne tava rakṣaṇebhī rārakṣāṇaḥ sumakha prīṇānaḥ prati ṣphura vi ruja vīḍvaṃho jahi rakṣo mahi cid vāvṛdhānam
verses.en: O Agni, keep us safe with thy protection, loving us, honoured God! and ever guarding. Beat thou away, destroy severe affliction slay e'en the demon when he waxes mighty.

verses.sa:
एभिर्भव सुमना अग्ने अर्कैरिमान् त्स्पृश मन्मभिः शूर वाजान् ।
उत ब्रह्माण्यङ्गिरो जुषस्व सं ते शस्तिर्देववाता जरेत॥
verses.tr: ebhirbhava sumanā agne arkairimān tspṛśa manmabhiḥ śūra vājān uta brahmāṇyaṅgiro juṣasva saṃ te śastirdevavātā jareta
verses.en: Through these our songs of praise be gracious, Agni; moved by ourprayers, O Hero, touch our viands. Accept, O Angiras, these our devotions, and let the praise which Gods desire address thee.

verses.sa:
एता विश्वा विदुषे तुभ्यं वेधो नीथान्यग्ने निण्या वचांसि ।
निवचना कवये काव्यान्यशंसिषं मतिभिर्विप्र उक्थैः॥
verses.tr: etā viśvā viduṣe tubhyaṃ vedho nīthānyagne niṇyā vacāṃsi nivacanā kavaye kāvyānyaśaṃsiṣaṃ matibhirvipra ukthaiḥ
verses.en: To thee who knowest, Agni, thou Disposer, all these wise secret speeches have I uttered, Sung to thee, Sage, the charming words of wisdom, to thee, O Singer, with. my thoughts and Praises.

verses.sa:
कृणुष्व पाजः प्रसितिं न पृथ्वीं याहि राजेवामवाँ इभेन ।
तृष्वीमनु प्रसितिं द्रूणानोऽस्तासि विध्य रक्षसस्तपिष्ठैः॥
verses.tr: kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ prasitiṃ na pṛthvīṃ yāhi rājevāmavāṃ ibhena tṛṣvīmanu prasitiṃ drūṇāno'stāsi vidhya rakṣasastapiṣṭhaiḥ
verses.en: Put forth like a wide-spreading net thy vigour; go like a mighty King with his attendants. Thou, following thy swift net, shootest arrows: transfix the fiends with darts that burn most fiercely.

verses.sa:
तव भ्रमास आशुया पतन्त्यनु स्पृश धृषता शोशुचानः ।
तपूंष्यग्ने जुह्वा पतङ्गानसंदितो वि सृज विष्वगुल्काः॥
verses.tr: tava bhramāsa āśuyā patantyanu spṛśa dhṛṣatā śośucānaḥ tapūṃṣyagne juhvā pataṅgānasaṃdito vi sṛja viṣvagulkāḥ
verses.en: Forth go in rapid flight thy whirling weapons: follow them closely, glowing in thy fury. Spread with thy tongue the winged flames, O Agni; unfettered, cast thy firebrands all around thee.

verses.sa:
प्रति स्पशो वि सृज तूर्णितमो भवा पायुर्विशो अस्या अदब्धः ।
यो नो दूरे अघशंसो यो अन्त्यग्ने माकिष्टे व्यथिरा दधर्षीत्॥
verses.tr: prati spaśo vi sṛja tūrṇitamo bhavā pāyurviśo asyā adabdhaḥ yo no dūre aghaśaṃso yo antyagne mākiṣṭe vyathirā dadharṣīt
verses.en: Send thy spies forward, fleetest in thy motion; be, ne'er deceived, the guardian of this people From him who, near or far, is bent on evil, and let no trouble sent from thee o'ercome us.

verses.sa:
उदग्ने तिष्ठ प्रत्या तनुष्व न्य१मित्राँ ओषतात् तिग्महेते ।
यो नो अरातिं समिधान चक्रे नीचा तं धक्ष्यतसं न शुष्कम्॥
verses.tr: udagne tiṣṭha pratyā tanuṣva nya1mitrāṃ oṣatāt tigmahete yo no arātiṃ samidhāna cakre nīcā taṃ dhakṣyatasaṃ na śuṣkam
verses.en: Rise up, O Agni, spread thee out before us: burn down our foes, thou who hast sharpened arrows. Him, blazing Agni! who hath worked us mischief, consume thou utterly like dried-up stubble.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो भव प्रति विध्याध्यस्मदाविष्कृणुष्व दैव्यान्यग्ने ।
अव स्थिरा तनुहि यातुजूनां जामिमजामिं प्र मृणीहि शत्रून्॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo bhava prati vidhyādhyasmadāviṣkṛṇuṣva daivyānyagne ava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnāṃ jāmimajāmiṃ pra mṛṇīhi śatrūn
verses.en: Rise, Agni, drive off those who fight against us: make manifest thine own celestial vigour. Slacken the strong bows of the demon driven: destroy our foemen whether kin or stranger.

verses.sa:
स ते जानाति सुमतिं यविष्ठ य ईवते ब्रह्मणे गातुमैरत् ।
विश्वान्यस्मै सुदिनानि रायो द्युम्नान्यर्यो वि दुरो अभि द्यौत्॥
verses.tr: sa te jānāti sumatiṃ yaviṣṭha ya īvate brahmaṇe gātumairat viśvānyasmai sudināni rāyo dyumnānyaryo vi duro abhi dyaut
verses.en: Most Youthful God, he knoweth well thy favour who gave an impulse to this high devotion. All fair days and magnificence of riches hast thou beamed forth upon the good man's portals.

verses.sa:
सेदग्ने अस्तु सुभगः सुदानुर्यस्त्वा नित्येन हविषा य उक्थैः ।
पिप्रीषति स्व आयुषि दुरोणे विश्वेदस्मै सुदिना सासदिष्टिः॥
verses.tr: sedagne astu subhagaḥ sudānuryastvā nityena haviṣā ya ukthaiḥ piprīṣati sva āyuṣi duroṇe viśvedasmai sudinā sāsadiṣṭiḥ
verses.en: Blest, Agni, be the man, the liberal giver, who with his lauds and regular oblation Is fain to please thee for his life and dwelling. May all his days be bright: be this his longing.

verses.sa:
अर्चामि ते सुमतिं घोष्यर्वाक् सं ते वावाता जरतामियं गीः ।
स्वश्वास्त्वा सुरथा मर्जयेमाऽस्मे क्षत्राणि धारयेरनु द्यून्॥
verses.tr: arcāmi te sumatiṃ ghoṣyarvāk saṃ te vāvātā jaratāmiyaṃ gīḥ svaśvāstvā surathā marjayemā'sme kṣatrāṇi dhārayeranu dyūn
verses.en: I praise thy gracious favour: sing in answer. May this my song sing like a loved one with thee. Lords of good steeds and cars may we adorn thee, and day by day vouchsafe thou us dominion.

verses.sa:
इह त्वा भूर्या चरेदुप त्मन्दोषावस्तर्दीदिवांसमनु द्यून् ।
क्रीळन्तस्त्वा सुमनसः सपेमाऽभि द्युम्ना तस्थिवांसो जनानाम्॥
verses.tr: iha tvā bhūryā caredupa tmandoṣāvastardīdivāṃsamanu dyūn krīḻantastvā sumanasaḥ sapemā'bhi dyumnā tasthivāṃso janānām
verses.en: Here of free choice let each one serve thee richly, resplendent day by day at eve and morning. So may we honour thee, content and joyous, passing beyond the glories of the people.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा स्वश्वः सुहिरण्यो अग्न उपयाति वसुमता रथेन ।
तस्य त्राता भवसि तस्य सखा यस्त आतिथ्यमानुषग्जुजोषत्॥
verses.tr: yastvā svaśvaḥ suhiraṇyo agna upayāti vasumatā rathena tasya trātā bhavasi tasya sakhā yasta ātithyamānuṣagjujoṣat
verses.en: Whoso with good steeds and fine gold, O Agni, comes nigh thee on a car laden with treasure, His Friend art thou, yea, thou art his Protector whose joy it is to entertain thee duly.

verses.sa:
महो रुजामि बन्धुता वचोभिस्तन्मा पितुर्गोतमादन्वियाय ।
त्वं नो अस्य वचसश्चिकिद्धि होतर्यविष्ठ सुक्रतो दमूनाः॥
verses.tr: maho rujāmi bandhutā vacobhistanmā piturgotamādanviyāya tvaṃ no asya vacasaścikiddhi hotaryaviṣṭha sukrato damūnāḥ
verses.en: Through words and kinship I destroy the mighty: this power I have from Gotama my father. Mark thou this speech of ours, O thou Most Youthful, Friend of the House, exceeding wise, Invoker.

verses.sa:
अस्वप्नजस्तरणयः सुशेवा अतन्द्रासोऽवृका अश्रमिष्ठाः ।
ते पायवः सध्र्यञ्चो निषद्याग्ने तव नः पान्त्वमूर॥
verses.tr: asvapnajastaraṇayaḥ suśevā atandrāso'vṛkā aśramiṣṭhāḥ te pāyavaḥ sadhryañco niṣadyāgne tava naḥ pāntvamūra
verses.en: Knowing no slumber, speedy and propitious, alert and ever friendly, most unwearied, May thy protecting powers, unerring Agni, taking their places here, combined, preserve us.

verses.sa:
ये पायवो मामतेयं ते अग्ने पश्यन्तो अन्धं दुरितादरक्षन् ।
ररक्ष तान्त्सुकृतो विश्ववेदा दिप्सन्त इद्रिपवो नाह देभुः॥
verses.tr: ye pāyavo māmateyaṃ te agne paśyanto andhaṃ duritādarakṣan rarakṣa tāntsukṛto viśvavedā dipsanta idripavo nāha debhuḥ
verses.en: Thy guardian rays, O Agni, when they saw him, preserved blind Mamateya from affliction. Lord of all riches, he preserved the pious: the fees who fain would harm them did no mischief

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं सधन्य१स्त्वोतास्तव प्रणीत्यश्याम वाजान् ।
उभा शंसा सूदय सत्यतातेऽनुष्ठुया कृणुह्यह्रयाण॥
verses.tr: tvayā vayaṃ sadhanya1stvotāstava praṇītyaśyāma vājān ubhā śaṃsā sūdaya satyatāte'nuṣṭhuyā kṛṇuhyahrayāṇa
verses.en: Aided by thee with thee may we be wealthy, may we gain strength with thee to guide us onward. Fulfil the words of both, O Ever Truthful: straightway do this, thou God whom power emboldens.

verses.sa:
अया ते अग्ने समिधा विधेम प्रति स्तोमं शस्यमानं गृभाय ।
दहाशसो रक्षसः पाह्य१स्मान्द्रुहो निदो मित्रमहो अवद्यात्॥
verses.tr: ayā te agne samidhā vidhema prati stomaṃ śasyamānaṃ gṛbhāya dahāśaso rakṣasaḥ pāhya1smāndruho nido mitramaho avadyāt
verses.en: O Agni, with this fuel will we serve thee; accept the laud we sing to thee with favour Destroy the cursing Raksasas: preserve us, O rich in friends, from guile and scorn and slander.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानराय मीळहुषे सजोषाः कथा दाशेमाग्नये बृहद्भाः ।
अनूनेन बृहता वक्षथेनोप स्तभायदुपमिन्न रोधः॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānarāya mīḻahuṣe sajoṣāḥ kathā dāśemāgnaye bṛhadbhāḥ anūnena bṛhatā vakṣathenopa stabhāyadupaminna rodhaḥ
verses.en: How shall we give with one accord oblation to Agni, to Vaisvanara the Bounteous? Great light, with full high growth hath he uplifted, and, as a pillar bears the roof, sustains it.

verses.sa:
मा निन्दत य इमां मह्यं रातिं देवो ददौ मर्त्याय स्वधावान् ।
पाकाय गृत्सो अमृतो विचेता वैश्वानरो नृतमो यह्वो अग्निः॥
verses.tr: mā nindata ya imāṃ mahyaṃ rātiṃ devo dadau martyāya svadhāvān pākāya gṛtso amṛto vicetā vaiśvānaro nṛtamo yahvo agniḥ
verses.en: Reproach not him who, God and self reliant, vouchsafed this bounty unto me a mortal,- Deathless, discerner, wise, to me the simple, Vaisvanara most manly, youthful Aini.

verses.sa:
साम द्विबर्हा महि तिग्मभृष्टिः सहस्ररेता वृषभस्तुविष्मान् ।
पदं न गोरपगूळहं विविद्वानग्निर्मह्यं प्रेदु वोचन्मनीषाम्॥
verses.tr: sāma dvibarhā mahi tigmabhṛṣṭiḥ sahasraretā vṛṣabhastuviṣmān padaṃ na gorapagūḻahaṃ vividvānagnirmahyaṃ predu vocanmanīṣām
verses.en: Sharp-pointed, powerful, strong, of boundless vigour, Agni who knows the lofty hymn, kept secret As the lost milch-cow's track, the doubly Mighty,-he hath declared to me this hidden knowledge.

verses.sa:
प्र ताँ अग्निर्बभसत् तिग्मजम्भस्तपिष्ठेन शोचिषा यः सुराधाः ।
प्र ये मिनन्ति वरुणस्य धाम प्रिया मित्रस्य चेततो ध्रुवाणि॥
verses.tr: pra tāṃ agnirbabhasat tigmajambhastapiṣṭhena śociṣā yaḥ surādhāḥ pra ye minanti varuṇasya dhāma priyā mitrasya cetato dhruvāṇi
verses.en: May he with sharpened teeth, the Bounteous Giver, Agni, consume with flame most fiercely glowing. Those who regard not Varuna's commandments and the dear steadfast laws of sapient Mitra.

verses.sa:
अभ्रातरो न योषणो व्यन्तः पतिरिपो न जनयो दुरेवाः ।
पापासः सन्तो अनृता असत्या इदं पदमजनता गभीरम्॥
verses.tr: abhrātaro na yoṣaṇo vyantaḥ patiripo na janayo durevāḥ pāpāsaḥ santo anṛtā asatyā idaṃ padamajanatā gabhīram
verses.en: Like youthful women without brothers, straying, like dames who hate their lords, of evil conduct, They who are full of sin, untrue, unfaithful, they have engendered this abysmal station.

verses.sa:
इदं मे अग्ने कियते पावकाऽमिनते गुरुं भारं न मन्म ।
बृहद् दधाथ धृषता गभीरं यह्वं पृष्ठं प्रयसा सप्तधातु॥
verses.tr: idaṃ me agne kiyate pāvakā'minate guruṃ bhāraṃ na manma bṛhad dadhātha dhṛṣatā gabhīraṃ yahvaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ prayasā saptadhātu
verses.en: To me, weak, innocent, thou, luminous Agni, bast boldly given as 'twere a heavy burthen, This Prstha hymn, profound and strong and mighty, of seven elements, and with offered dainties.

verses.sa:
तमिन्न्वे३व समना समानमभि क्रत्वा पुनती धीतिरश्याः ।
ससस्य चर्मन्नधि चारु पृश्नेरग्रे रुप आरुपितं जबारु॥
verses.tr: taminnve3va samanā samānamabhi kratvā punatī dhītiraśyāḥ sasasya carmannadhi cāru pṛśneragre rupa ārupitaṃ jabāru
verses.en: So may our song that purifies, through wisdom reach in a moment him the Universal, Established on the height, on earth's best.station, above the beauteous grassy skin of Prsni.

verses.sa:
प्रवाच्यं वचसः किं मे अस्य गुहा हितमुप निणिग्वदन्ति ।
यदुस्रियाणामप वारिव व्रन् पाति प्रियं रुपो अग्रं पदं वेः॥
verses.tr: pravācyaṃ vacasaḥ kiṃ me asya guhā hitamupa niṇigvadanti yadusriyāṇāmapa vāriva vran pāti priyaṃ rupo agraṃ padaṃ veḥ
verses.en: Of this my speech what shall I utter further? They indicate the milk stored up in secret When they have thrown as 'twere the cows' stalls open. The Bird protects earths' best and well-loved station.

verses.sa:
इदमु त्यन्महि महामनीकं यदुस्रिया सचत पूर्व्यं गौः ।
ऋतस्य पदे अधि दीद्यानं गुहा रघुष्यद् रघुयद् विवेद॥
verses.tr: idamu tyanmahi mahāmanīkaṃ yadusriyā sacata pūrvyaṃ gauḥ ṛtasya pade adhi dīdyānaṃ guhā raghuṣyad raghuyad viveda
verses.en: This is the Great Ones' mighty apparition which from of old the radiant Cow hath followed. This, shining brightly in the place of Order, swift, hasting on in secret, she discovered.

verses.sa:
अध द्युतानः पित्रोः सचासामनुत गुह्यं चारु पृश्नेः ।
मातुष्पदे परमे अन्ति षद् गोर्वृष्णः शोचिषः प्रयतस्य जिह्वा॥
verses.tr: adha dyutānaḥ pitroḥ sacāsāmanuta guhyaṃ cāru pṛśneḥ mātuṣpade parame anti ṣad gorvṛṣṇaḥ śociṣaḥ prayatasya jihvā
verses.en: He then who shone together with his Parents remembered Prsni's fair and secret treasure, Which, in the Mother Cow's most lofty station, the Bull's tongue, of the flame bent forward, tasted.

verses.sa:
ऋतं वोचे नमसा पृच्छ्यमानस्तवाशसा जातवेदो यदीदम् ।
त्वमस्य क्षयसि यद्ध विश्वं दिवि यदु द्रविणं यत् पृथिव्याम्॥
verses.tr: ṛtaṃ voce namasā pṛcchyamānastavāśasā jātavedo yadīdam tvamasya kṣayasi yaddha viśvaṃ divi yadu draviṇaṃ yat pṛthivyām
verses.en: With reverence I declare the Law, O Agni; what is, comes by thine order, Jatavedas. Of this, whate'er it be, thou art the Sovran, yea, all the wealth that is in earth or heaven.

verses.sa:
किं नो अस्य द्रविणं कद्ध रत्नं वि नो वोचो जातवेदश्चिकित्वान् ।
गुहाध्वनः परमं यन्नो अस्य रेकु पदं न निदाना अगन्म॥
verses.tr: kiṃ no asya draviṇaṃ kaddha ratnaṃ vi no voco jātavedaścikitvān guhādhvanaḥ paramaṃ yanno asya reku padaṃ na nidānā aganma
verses.en: What is our wealth therefrom, and what our treasure? Tell us O Jatavedas, for thou knowest, What is our best course in this secret passage: we, unreproached, have reached a t)lace far distant.

verses.sa:
का मर्यादा वयुना कद्ध वाममच्छा गमेम रघवो न वाजम् ।
कदा नो देवीरमृतस्य पत्नीः सूरो वर्णेन ततनन्नुषासः॥
verses.tr: kā maryādā vayunā kaddha vāmamacchā gamema raghavo na vājam kadā no devīramṛtasya patnīḥ sūro varṇena tatanannuṣāsaḥ
verses.en: What is the limit, what the rules, the guerdon? Like fleet-foot coursers speed we to the contest. When will the Goddesses, the Immortal's Spouses, the Dawns, spread over us the Sun-God's splendour?

verses.sa:
अनिरेण वचसा फल्ग्वेन प्रतीत्येन कृधुनातृपासः ।
अधा ते अग्ने किमिहा वदन्त्यनायुधास आसता सचन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: anireṇa vacasā phalgvena pratītyena kṛdhunātṛpāsaḥ adhā te agne kimihā vadantyanāyudhāsa āsatā sacantām
verses.en: Unsatisfied, with speech devoid of vigour, scanty and frivolous and inconclusive, Wherefore do they address thee here, O Agni? Let these who have no weapons suffer sorrow.

verses.sa:
अस्य श्रिये समिधानस्य वृष्णो वसोरनीकं दम आ रुरोच ।
रुशद् वसानः सुदृशीकरूपः क्षितिर्न राया पुरुवारो अद्यौत्॥
verses.tr: asya śriye samidhānasya vṛṣṇo vasoranīkaṃ dama ā ruroca ruśad vasānaḥ sudṛśīkarūpaḥ kṣitirna rāyā puruvāro adyaut
verses.en: The majesty of him the Good, the Mighty, aflame, hath shone for glory in the dwelling. He, clothed in light, hath shone most fair to look on, wealthy in boons, as a home shines with riches.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु णो अध्वरस्य होतरग्ने तिष्ठ देवताता यजीयान् ।
त्वं हि विश्वमभ्यसि मन्म प्र वेधसश्चित् तिरसि मनीषाम्॥
verses.tr: ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇo adhvarasya hotaragne tiṣṭha devatātā yajīyān tvaṃ hi viśvamabhyasi manma pra vedhasaścit tirasi manīṣām
verses.en: Priest of our rite, stand up erect, O Agni, in the Gods' service best of sacrificers, For over every thought thou art the Ruler: thou furtherest e'en the wisdom of the pious.

verses.sa:
अमूरो होता न्यसादि विक्ष्व१ग्निर्मन्द्रो विदथेषु प्रचेताः ।
ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सवितेवाश्रेन्मेतेव धूमं स्तभायदुप द्याम्॥
verses.tr: amūro hotā nyasādi vikṣva1gnirmandro vidatheṣu pracetāḥ ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitevāśrenmeteva dhūmaṃ stabhāyadupa dyām
verses.en: He was set down mid men as Priest unerring, Agni, wise, welcome in our holy synods. Like Savitar he hath lifted up his splendour, and like a builder raised his smoke to heaven.

verses.sa:
यता सुजूर्णी रातिनी घृताची प्रदक्षिणिद् देवतातिमुराणः ।
उदु स्वरुर्नवजा नाक्रः पश्वो अनक्ति सुधितः सुमेकः॥
verses.tr: yatā sujūrṇī rātinī ghṛtācī pradakṣiṇid devatātimurāṇaḥ udu svarurnavajā nākraḥ paśvo anakti sudhitaḥ sumekaḥ
verses.en: The glowing ladle, filled with oil, is lifted; choosing Gods' service to the right he circles. Eager he rises like the new-wrought pillar which, firmly set and fixed, anoints the victims.

verses.sa:
स्तीर्णे बर्हिषि समिधाने अग्ना ऊर्ध्वो अध्वर्युर्जुजुषाणो अस्थात् ।
पर्यग्निः पशुपा न होता त्रिविष्ट्येति प्रदिव उराणः॥
verses.tr: stīrṇe barhiṣi samidhāne agnā ūrdhvo adhvaryurjujuṣāṇo asthāt paryagniḥ paśupā na hotā triviṣṭyeti pradiva urāṇaḥ
verses.en: When sacred grass is strewn and Agni kindled, the Adhvaryu rises to, his task rejoicing. Agni the Priest, like one who tends the cattle, goes three times round, as from of old he wills it.

verses.sa:
परि त्मना मितद्रुरेति होता ऽग्निर्मन्द्रो मधुवचा ऋतावा ।
द्रवन्त्यस्य वाजिनो न शोका भयन्ते विश्वा भुवना यदभ्राट्॥
verses.tr: pari tmanā mitadrureti hotā 'gnirmandro madhuvacā ṛtāvā dravantyasya vājino na śokā bhayante viśvā bhuvanā yadabhrāṭ
verses.en: Agni himself, the Priest, with measured motion, goes round, with sweet speech, cheerful, true to Order. His fulgent flames run forth like vigorous horses; all creatures are affrighted when he blazes.

verses.sa:
भद्रा ते अग्ने स्वनीक संदृग्घोरस्य सतो विषुणस्य चारुः ।
न यत्ते शोचिस्तमसा वरन्त न ध्वस्मानस्तन्वी३ रेप आ धुः॥
verses.tr: bhadrā te agne svanīka saṃdṛgghorasya sato viṣuṇasya cāruḥ na yatte śocistamasā varanta na dhvasmānastanvī3 repa ā dhuḥ
verses.en: Beautiful and auspicious is thine aspect, O lovely Agni, terrible when spreading. Thy splendours are not covered by the darkness: detraction leaves no stain upon thy body.

verses.sa:
न यस्य सातुर्जनितोरवारि न मातरापितरा नू चिदिष्टौ ।
अधा मित्रो न सुधितः पावको३ऽग्निर्दीदाय मानुषीषु विक्षु॥
verses.tr: na yasya sāturjanitoravāri na mātarāpitarā nū cidiṣṭau adhā mitro na sudhitaḥ pāvako3'gnirdīdāya mānuṣīṣu vikṣu
verses.en: Naught hindered his production, Bounteous Giver: his Mother and his Sire were free to send him. Then as Friend benevolent, refulgent, Agni shone forth in human habitations.

verses.sa:
द्विर्यं पञ्च जीजनन् त्संवसानाः स्वसारो अग्निं मानुषीषु विक्षु ।
उषर्बुधमथर्यो३ न दन्तं शुक्रं स्वासं परशुं न तिग्मम्॥
verses.tr: dviryaṃ pañca jījanan tsaṃvasānāḥ svasāro agniṃ mānuṣīṣu vikṣu uṣarbudhamatharyo3 na dantaṃ śukraṃ svāsaṃ paraśuṃ na tigmam
verses.en: He, Agni, whom the twice-five sisters, dwelling together, in the homes of men engendered, Bright like a spear's tooth, wakened in the morning, with powerful mouth and like an axe well-sharpened.

verses.sa:
तव त्ये अग्ने हरितो घृतस्ना रोहितास ऋज्वञ्चः स्वञ्चः ।
अरुषासो वृषण ऋजुमुष्का आ देवतातिमह्वन्त दस्माः॥
verses.tr: tava tye agne harito ghṛtasnā rohitāsa ṛjvañcaḥ svañcaḥ aruṣāso vṛṣaṇa ṛjumuṣkā ā devatātimahvanta dasmāḥ
verses.en: These thy Bay Coursers, Agni, dropping fatness, ruddy vigorous, speeding straightly forward, And red steeds, wonderful, of mighty muscle, are to this service of the Gods invited:

verses.sa:
ये ह त्ये ते सहमाना अयासस्त्वेषासो अग्ने अर्चयश्चरन्ति ।
श्येनासो न दुवसनासो अर्थं तुविष्वणसो मारुतं न शर्धः॥
verses.tr: ye ha tye te sahamānā ayāsastveṣāso agne arcayaścaranti śyenāso na duvasanāso arthaṃ tuviṣvaṇaso mārutaṃ na śardhaḥ
verses.en: These brightly-shining games of thine, O Agni, that move for ever restless, allsubduing, Like falcons hasting eagerly to the quarry, roar loudly like the army of the Maruts.

verses.sa:
अकारि ब्रह्म समिधान तुभ्यं शंसात्युक्थं यजते व्यू धाः ।
होतारमग्निं मनुषो नि षेदुर्नमस्यन्त उशिजः शंसमायोः॥
verses.tr: akāri brahma samidhāna tubhyaṃ śaṃsātyukthaṃ yajate vyū dhāḥ hotāramagniṃ manuṣo ni ṣedurnamasyanta uśijaḥ śaṃsamāyoḥ
verses.en: To thee, O flaming God, hath prayer been offered. Let the priest laud thee: give to him who worships. Men have established Agni as Invoker, fain to adore the glory of the living.

verses.sa:
अयमिह प्रथमो धायि धातृभिर्होता यजिष्ठो अध्वरेष्वीड्यः ।
यमप्नवानो भृगवो विरुरुचुर्वनेषु चित्रं विभ्वं विशेविशे॥
verses.tr: ayamiha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhirhotā yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍyaḥ yamapnavāno bhṛgavo virurucurvaneṣu citraṃ vibhvaṃ viśeviśe
verses.en: Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites: Whom Apnavana, and the Bhrgus caused to shine bright-coloured in the wood, spreading from home to home.

verses.sa:
अग्ने कदा त आनुषग् भुवद् देवस्य चेतनम् ।
अधा हि त्वा जगृभ्रिरे मर्तासो विक्ष्वीड्यम्॥
verses.tr: agne kadā ta ānuṣag bhuvad devasya cetanam adhā hi tvā jagṛbhrire martāso vikṣvīḍyam
verses.en: When shall thy glory as a God, Agni, be suddenly shown forth. For mortal men have held thee fast, adorable in all their homes,

verses.sa:
ऋतावानं विचेतसं पश्यन्तो द्यामिव स्तृभिः ।
विश्वेषामध्वराणां हस्कर्तारं दमेदमे॥
verses.tr: ṛtāvānaṃ vicetasaṃ paśyanto dyāmiva stṛbhiḥ viśveṣāmadhvarāṇāṃ haskartāraṃ damedame
verses.en: Seeing thee faithful to the Law, most sapient, like the starry heaven, Illumining with cheerful ray each solemn rite in every house.

verses.sa:
आशुं दूतं विवस्वतो विश्वा यश्चर्षणीरभि ।
आ जभ्रुः केतुमायवो भृगवाणं विशेविशे॥
verses.tr: āśuṃ dūtaṃ vivasvato viśvā yaścarṣaṇīrabhi ā jabhruḥ ketumāyavo bhṛgavāṇaṃ viśeviśe
verses.en: Vivasvan's envoy living men have taken as their ensign, swift, The ruler over all mankind, moving like Bhrgu in each home.

verses.sa:
तमीं होतारमानुषक् चिकित्वांसं नि षेदिरे ।
रण्वं पावकशोचिषं यजिष्ठं सप्त धामभिः॥
verses.tr: tamīṃ hotāramānuṣak cikitvāṃsaṃ ni ṣedire raṇvaṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ yajiṣṭhaṃ sapta dhāmabhiḥ
verses.en: Him the intelligent have they placed duly as Invoking Priest, Welcome, with sanctifying flame, best worshipper, with sevenfold might;

verses.sa:
तं शश्वतीषु मातृषु वन आ वीतमश्रितम् ।
चित्रं सन्तं गुहा हितं सुवेदं कूचिदर्थिनम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ śaśvatīṣu mātṛṣu vana ā vītamaśritam citraṃ santaṃ guhā hitaṃ suvedaṃ kūcidarthinam
verses.en: In his Eternal Mothers, in the wood, concealed and unapproached, Kept secret though his flames are bright seeking on all sides, quickly found.

verses.sa:
ससस्य यद् वियुता सस्मिन्नूधन्नृतस्य धामन् रणयन्त देवाः ।
महाँ अग्निर्नमसा रातहव्यो वेरध्वराय सदमिदृतावा॥
verses.tr: sasasya yad viyutā sasminnūdhannṛtasya dhāman raṇayanta devāḥ mahāṃ agnirnamasā rātahavyo veradhvarāya sadamidṛtāvā
verses.en: That as food spreads forth in this earthly udder, Gods may rejoice them in the home of Order, Great Agni, served with reverence and oblation, flies ever to the sacrifice, the Faithful.

verses.sa:
वेरध्वरस्य दूत्यानि विद्वानुभे अन्ता रोदसी संचिकित्वान् ।
दूत ईयसे प्रदिव उराणो विदुष्टरो दिव आरोधनानि॥
verses.tr: veradhvarasya dūtyāni vidvānubhe antā rodasī saṃcikitvān dūta īyase pradiva urāṇo viduṣṭaro diva ārodhanāni
verses.en: Bird of each rite, skilled in an envoy's duties, knowing both worlds and that which lies between them, Thou goest from of old a willing Herald, knowing full well heaven's innermost recesses.

verses.sa:
कृष्णं त एम रुशतः पुरो भाश्चरिष्ण्व१र्चिर्वपुषामिदेकम् ।
यदप्रवीता दधते ह गर्भं सद्यश्चिज्जातो भवसीदु दूतः॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇaṃ ta ema ruśataḥ puro bhāścariṣṇva1rcirvapuṣāmidekam yadapravītā dadhate ha garbhaṃ sadyaścijjāto bhavasīdu dūtaḥ
verses.en: Bright God, thy path is black: light is before thee: thy moving splendour is the chief of wonders. When she, yet unimpregnate, hath conceived thee, even when newly born thou art an envoy.

verses.sa:
सद्यो जातस्य ददृशानमोजो यदस्य वातो अनुवाति शोचिः ।
वृणक्ति तिग्मामतसेषु जिह्वां स्थिरा चिदन्ना दयते वि जम्भैः॥
verses.tr: sadyo jātasya dadṛśānamojo yadasya vāto anuvāti śociḥ vṛṇakti tigmāmataseṣu jihvāṃ sthirā cidannā dayate vi jambhaiḥ
verses.en: Yet newly born, his vigour is apparent when the wind blows upon his fiery splendour, His sharpened tongue he layeth on the brushwood, and with his teeth e'en solid food consumeth.

verses.sa:
तृषु यदन्ना तृषुणा ववक्ष तृषुं दूतं कृणुते यह्वो अग्निः ।
वातस्य मेळिं सचते निजूर्वन्नाशुं न वाजयते हिन्वे अर्वा॥
verses.tr: tṛṣu yadannā tṛṣuṇā vavakṣa tṛṣuṃ dūtaṃ kṛṇute yahvo agniḥ vātasya meḻiṃ sacate nijūrvannāśuṃ na vājayate hinve arvā
verses.en: When he hath borne off food with swift flame swiftly, strong Agni makes himself a speedy envoy, Follows the rustling of the wind, consuming, and courser-like, speeds, drives the swift horse onward.

verses.sa: दूतं वो विश्ववेदसं हव्यवाहममर्त्यम् । यजिष्ठमृञ्जसे गिरा॥
verses.tr: dūtaṃ vo viśvavedasaṃ havyavāhamamartyam yajiṣṭhamṛñjase girā
verses.en: Your envoy who possesses all, Immortal, bearer of your gifts, Best worshipper, I woo with song.

verses.sa: स हि वेदा वसुधितिं महाँ आरोधनं दिवः । स देवाँ एह वक्षति॥
verses.tr: sa hi vedā vasudhitiṃ mahāṃ ārodhanaṃ divaḥ sa devāṃ eha vakṣati
verses.en: He, Mighty, knows the gift of wealth, he knows the deep recess of heaven: He shall bring hitherward the Gods.

verses.sa: स वेद देव आनमं देवाँ ऋतायते दमे । दाति प्रियाणि चिद् वसु॥
verses.tr: sa veda deva ānamaṃ devāṃ ṛtāyate dame dāti priyāṇi cid vasu
verses.en: He knows, a God himself, to guide Gods to the righteous in his home: He gives e'en treasures that we love.

verses.sa: स होता सेदु दूत्यं चिकित्वाँ अन्तरीयते । विद्वाँ आरोधनं दिवः॥
verses.tr: sa hotā sedu dūtyaṃ cikitvāṃ antarīyate vidvāṃ ārodhanaṃ divaḥ
verses.en: He is the Herald: well-informed, he doth his errand to and fro, Knowing the deep recess of heaven.

verses.sa: ते स्याम ये अग्नये ददाशुर्हव्यदातिभिः । य ईं पुष्यन्त इन्धते॥
verses.tr: te syāma ye agnaye dadāśurhavyadātibhiḥ ya īṃ puṣyanta indhate
verses.en: May we be they who gratify Agni with sacrificial gifts, Who cherish and enkindle him.

verses.sa: ते राया ते सुवीर्यैः ससवांसो वि शृण्विरे । ये अग्ना दधिरे दुवः॥
verses.tr: te rāyā te suvīryaiḥ sasavāṃso vi śṛṇvire ye agnā dadhire duvaḥ
verses.en: Illustrious for wealth are they, and hero deeds, victorious, Who have served Agni reverently.

verses.sa: अस्मे रायो दिवेदिवे सं चरन्तु पुरुस्पृहः । अस्मे वाजास ईरताम्॥
verses.tr: asme rāyo divedive saṃ carantu puruspṛhaḥ asme vājāsa īratām
verses.en: So unto us, day after day, may riches craved by many come, And power and might spring up for us.

verses.sa: स विप्रश्चर्षणीनां शवसा मानुषाणाम् । अति क्षिप्रेव विध्यति॥
verses.tr: sa vipraścarṣaṇīnāṃ śavasā mānuṣāṇām ati kṣipreva vidhyati
verses.en: That holy Singer in his strength shoots forth his arrows swifter than The swift shafts of the tribes of men.

verses.sa: अग्ने मृळ महाँ असि य ईमा देवयुं जनम् । इयेथ बर्हिरासदम्॥
verses.tr: agne mṛḻa mahāṃ asi ya īmā devayuṃ janam iyetha barhirāsadam
verses.en: Agni, show favour: great art thou who to this pious man art come, To seat thee on the sacred grass.

verses.sa: स मानुषीषु दूळभो विक्षु प्रावीरमर्त्यः । दूतो विश्वेषां भुवत्॥
verses.tr: sa mānuṣīṣu dūḻabho vikṣu prāvīramartyaḥ dūto viśveṣāṃ bhuvat
verses.en: May he the Immortal, Helper, bard to be deceived among mankind, Become the messenger of all.

verses.sa: स सद्म परि णीयते होता मन्द्रो दिविष्टिषु । उत पोता नि षीदति॥
verses.tr: sa sadma pari ṇīyate hotā mandro diviṣṭiṣu uta potā ni ṣīdati
verses.en: Around the altar is he led, welcome Chief Priest at solemn rites, Or as the Potar sits him down.

verses.sa: उत ग्ना अग्निरध्वर उतो गृहपतिर्दमे । उत ब्रह्मा नि षीदति॥
verses.tr: uta gnā agniradhvara uto gṛhapatirdame uta brahmā ni ṣīdati
verses.en: Agni in fire at sacrifice, and in the house as Lord thereof, And as a Brahman takes his seat.

verses.sa: वेषि ह्यध्वरीयतामुपवक्ता जनानाम् । हव्या च मानुषाणाम्॥
verses.tr: veṣi hyadhvarīyatāmupavaktā janānām havyā ca mānuṣāṇām
verses.en: Thou comest as the guide of folk who celebrate a sacrifice, And to oblations brought by men.

verses.sa: वेषीद्वस्य दूत्यं१ यस्य जुजोषो अध्वरम् । हव्यं मर्तस्य वोळहवे॥
verses.tr: veṣīdvasya dūtyaṃ1 yasya jujoṣo adhvaram havyaṃ martasya voḻahave
verses.en: Thou servest as his messenger whose sacrifice thou lovest well, To bear the mortal's gifts to heaven.

verses.sa: अस्माकं जोष्यध्वरमस्माकं यज्ञमङ्गिरः । अस्माकं शृणुधी हवम्॥
verses.tr: asmākaṃ joṣyadhvaramasmākaṃ yajñamaṅgiraḥ asmākaṃ śṛṇudhī havam
verses.en: Accept our solemn rite; be pleased, Angiras, with our sacrifice: Give ear and listen to our call.

verses.sa: परि ते दूळभो रथोऽस्माँ अश्नोतु विश्वतः । येन रक्षसि दाशुषः॥
verses.tr: pari te dūḻabho ratho'smāṃ aśnotu viśvataḥ yena rakṣasi dāśuṣaḥ
verses.en: May thine inviolable car, wherewith thou guardest those who give, Come near to us from every side.

verses.sa: अग्ने तमद्याऽश्वं न स्तोमैः क्रतुं न भद्रं हृदिस्पृशम् । ऋध्यामा त ओहैः॥
verses.tr: agne tamadyā'śvaṃ na stomaiḥ kratuṃ na bhadraṃ hṛdispṛśam ṛdhyāmā ta ohaiḥ
verses.en: This day with praises, Agni, we bring thee that which thou lovest. Right judgment, like a horse, with our devotions.

verses.sa: अधा ह्यग्ने क्रतोर्भद्रस्य दक्षस्य साधोः । रथीर्ऋतस्य बृहतो बभूथ॥
verses.tr: adhā hyagne kratorbhadrasya dakṣasya sādhoḥ rathīrṛtasya bṛhato babhūtha
verses.en: For thou hast ever been the Car-driver, Agni, of noble Strength, lofty sacrifice, and rightful judgment.

verses.sa: एभिर्नो अर्कैर्भवा नो अर्वाङ्स्व१र्ण ज्योतिः । अग्ने विश्वेभिः सुमना अनीकैः॥
verses.tr: ebhirno arkairbhavā no arvāṅsva1rṇa jyotiḥ agne viśvebhiḥ sumanā anīkaiḥ
verses.en: Through these our praises come thou to meet us, bright as the sunlight, O Agni, well disposed, with all thine aspects.

verses.sa: आभिष्टे अद्य गीर्भिर्गृणन्तोऽग्ने दाशेम । प्र ते दिवो न स्तनयन्ति शुष्माः॥
verses.tr: ābhiṣṭe adya gīrbhirgṛṇanto'gne dāśema pra te divo na stanayanti śuṣmāḥ
verses.en: Now may we serve thee singing these lauds this day to thee, Agni. Loud as the voice of Heaven thy blasts are roaring.

verses.sa: तव स्वादिष्ठा ऽग्ने संदृष्टिरिदा चिदह्न इदा चिदक्तोः । श्रिये रुक्मो न रोचत उपाके॥
verses.tr: tava svādiṣṭhā 'gne saṃdṛṣṭiridā cidahna idā cidaktoḥ śriye rukmo na rocata upāke
verses.en: just at this time of the day and the night thy look is the sweetest. It shineth near us even as gold for glory.

verses.sa: घृतं न पूतं तनूररेपाः शुचि हिरण्यम् । तत् ते रुक्मो न रोचत स्वधावः॥
verses.tr: ghṛtaṃ na pūtaṃ tanūrarepāḥ śuci hiraṇyam tat te rukmo na rocata svadhāvaḥ
verses.en: Spotless thy body, brilliant as gold, like clarified butter: This gleams like gold on thee, O Self. dependent.

verses.sa: कृतं चिद्धि ष्मा सनेमि द्वेषोऽग्न इनोषि मर्तात् । इत्था यजमानादृतावः॥
verses.tr: kṛtaṃ ciddhi ṣmā sanemi dveṣo'gna inoṣi martāt itthā yajamānādṛtāvaḥ
verses.en: All hate and mischief, yea, if committed, Agni, thou turnest, Holy One, from the man who rightly worships.

verses.sa: शिवा नः सख्या सन्तु भ्रात्रा ऽग्ने देवेषु युष्मे । सा नो नाभिः सदने सस्मिन्नूधन्॥
verses.tr: śivā naḥ sakhyā santu bhrātrā 'gne deveṣu yuṣme sā no nābhiḥ sadane sasminnūdhan
verses.en: Agni, with you Gods, prosperous be our friendships and kinships. Be this our bond here by this place, thine altar.

verses.sa:
भद्रं ते अग्ने सहसिन्ननीकमुपाक आ रोचते सूर्यस्य ।
रुशद् दृशे ददृशे नक्तया चिदरूक्षितं दृश आ रूपे अन्नम्॥
verses.tr: bhadraṃ te agne sahasinnanīkamupāka ā rocate sūryasya ruśad dṛśe dadṛśe naktayā cidarūkṣitaṃ dṛśa ā rūpe annam
verses.en: Thy blessed majesty, victorious Agni, shines brightly in the neighbourhood of Surya. Splendid to see, it shows even at nighttime, and food is fair to look on in thy beauty.

verses.sa:
वि षाह्यग्ने गृणते मनीषां खं वेपसा तुविजात स्तवानः ।
विश्वेभिर्यद् वावनः शुक्र देवैस्तन्नो रास्व सुमहो भूरि मन्म॥
verses.tr: vi ṣāhyagne gṛṇate manīṣāṃ khaṃ vepasā tuvijāta stavānaḥ viśvebhiryad vāvanaḥ śukra devaistanno rāsva sumaho bhūri manma
verses.en: Agni, disclose his thought for him who singeth, the well, Strong God! while thou art praised with fervour. Vouchsafe to us that powerful hymn, O Mighty, which, Radiant One! with all the Gods thou lovest.

verses.sa:
त्वदग्ने काव्या त्वन्मनीषास्त्वदुक्था जायन्ते राध्यानि ।
त्वदेति द्रविणं वीरपेशा इत्थाधिये दाशुषे मर्त्याय॥
verses.tr: tvadagne kāvyā tvanmanīṣāstvadukthā jāyante rādhyāni tvadeti draviṇaṃ vīrapeśā itthādhiye dāśuṣe martyāya
verses.en: From thee, O Agni, springs poetic wisdom, from thee come thoughts and hymns of praise that prosper; From thee flows wealth, with heroes to adorn it, to the true-hearted man who gives oblation.

verses.sa:
त्वद् वाजी वाजम्भरो विहाया अभिष्टिकृज्जायते सत्यशुष्मः ।
त्वद् रयिर्देवजूतो मयोभुस्त्वदाशुर्जूजुवाँ अग्ने अर्वा॥
verses.tr: tvad vājī vājambharo vihāyā abhiṣṭikṛjjāyate satyaśuṣmaḥ tvad rayirdevajūto mayobhustvadāśurjūjuvāṃ agne arvā
verses.en: From thee the hero springs who wins the booty, bringer of help, mighty, of real courage. From thee comes wealth, sent by the Gods, bliss-giving; Agni, from thee the fleet impetuous charger.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने प्रथमं देवयन्तो देवं मर्ता अमृत मन्द्रजिह्वम् ।
द्वेषोयुतमा विवासन्ति धीभिर्दमूनसं गृहपतिममूरम्॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne prathamaṃ devayanto devaṃ martā amṛta mandrajihvam dveṣoyutamā vivāsanti dhībhirdamūnasaṃ gṛhapatimamūram
verses.en: Immortal Agni, thee whose voice is pleasant, as first in rank, as God, religious mortals Invite with hymns; thee who removest hatred, Friend of the Home, the household's Lord, unerring.

verses.sa:
आरे अस्मदमतिमारे अंह आरे विश्वां दुर्मतिं यन्निपासि ।
दोषा शिवः सहसः सूनो अग्ने यं देव आ चित् सचसे स्वस्ति॥
verses.tr: āre asmadamatimāre aṃha āre viśvāṃ durmatiṃ yannipāsi doṣā śivaḥ sahasaḥ sūno agne yaṃ deva ā cit sacase svasti
verses.en: Far from us thou removest want and sorrow, far from us all ill-will when thou protectest. Son of Strength, Agni, blest is he at evening, whom thou as God attendest for his welfare.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वामग्न इनधते यतस्रुक् त्रिस्ते अन्नं कृणवत् सस्मिन्नहन् ।
स सु द्युम्नैरभ्यस्तु प्रसक्षत् तव क्रत्वा जातवेदश्चिकित्वान्॥
verses.tr: yastvāmagna inadhate yatasruk triste annaṃ kṛṇavat sasminnahan sa su dyumnairabhyastu prasakṣat tava kratvā jātavedaścikitvān
verses.en: Whoso enkindles thee, with lifted ladle, and thrice this day offiers thee food, O Agni, May he excel, triumphant through thy splendours, wise through thy mental power, O Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
इध्मं यस्ते जभरच्छश्रमाणो महो अग्ने अनीकमा सपर्यन् ।
स इधानः प्रति दोषामुषासं पुष्यन् रयिं सचते घ्नन्नमित्रान्॥
verses.tr: idhmaṃ yaste jabharacchaśramāṇo maho agne anīkamā saparyan sa idhānaḥ prati doṣāmuṣāsaṃ puṣyan rayiṃ sacate ghnannamitrān
verses.en: Whoso with toil and trouble brings thee fuel, serving the majesty of mighty Agni, He, kindling thee at evening and at morning, prospers, and comes to wealth, and slays his foemen.

verses.sa:
अग्निरीशे बृहतः क्षत्रियस्याऽग्निर्वाजस्य परमस्य रायः ।
दधाति रत्नं विधते यविष्ठो व्यानुषङ्मर्त्याय स्वधावान्॥
verses.tr: agnirīśe bṛhataḥ kṣatriyasyā'gnirvājasya paramasya rāyaḥ dadhāti ratnaṃ vidhate yaviṣṭho vyānuṣaṅmartyāya svadhāvān
verses.en: Agni is Master of sublime dominion, Agni is Lord of strength and lofty riches. Straightway the self-reliant God, Most Youthful, gives treasures to the mortal who adores him.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि ते पुरुषत्रा यविष्ठाचित्तिभिश्चकृमा कच्चिदागः ।
कृधी ष्व१स्माँ अदितेरनागान् व्येनांसि शिश्रथो विष्वगग्ने॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi te puruṣatrā yaviṣṭhācittibhiścakṛmā kaccidāgaḥ kṛdhī ṣva1smāṃ aditeranāgān vyenāṃsi śiśratho viṣvagagne
verses.en: Most Youthful God, whatever sin, through folly, we here, as human beings, have committed, In sight of Aditi make thou us sinless remit, entirely, Agni, our offences.

verses.sa:
महश्चिदग्न एनसो अभीक ऊर्वाद् देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम् ।
मा ते सखायः सदमिद् रिषाम यच्छा तोकाय तनयाय शं योः॥
verses.tr: mahaścidagna enaso abhīka ūrvād devānāmuta martyānām mā te sakhāyaḥ sadamid riṣāma yacchā tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ
verses.en: Even in the presence of great sin, O Agni, free us from prison of the Gods or mortals. Never may we who are thy friends be injured: grant health and strength unto our seed and offspring.

verses.sa:
यथा ह त्यद् वसवो गौर्यं चित् पदि षिताममुञ्चता यजत्राः ।
एवो ष्व१स्मन्मुञ्चता व्यंहः प्र तार्यग्ने प्रतरं न आयुः॥
verses.tr: yathā ha tyad vasavo gauryaṃ cit padi ṣitāmamuñcatā yajatrāḥ evo ṣva1smanmuñcatā vyaṃhaḥ pra tāryagne prataraṃ na āyuḥ
verses.en: Even as ye here, Gods Excellent and Holy, have loosed the cow that by the foot was tethered, So also set us free from this affliction long let our life, O Agni, be extended.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यद् विभातीनां सुमना रत्नधेयम् ।
यातमश्विना सुकृतो दुरोणमुत्सूर्यो ज्योतिषा देव एति॥
verses.tr: pratyagniruṣasāmagramakhyad vibhātīnāṃ sumanā ratnadheyam yātamaśvinā sukṛto duroṇamutsūryo jyotiṣā deva eti
verses.en: Agni hath looked, benevolently-minded, on the wealth-giving spring of radiant Mornings. Come, Asvins, to the dwelling of the pious: Surya the God is rising with his splendour.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सविता देवो अश्रेद् द्रप्सं दविध्वद् गविषो न सत्वा ।
अनु व्रतं वरुणो यन्ति मित्रो यत्सूर्यं दिव्यारोहयन्ति॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitā devo aśred drapsaṃ davidhvad gaviṣo na satvā anu vrataṃ varuṇo yanti mitro yatsūryaṃ divyārohayanti
verses.en: Savitar, God, hath spread on high his lustre, waving his flag like a spoil-seeking hero. Their stablished way go Varuna and Mitra, what time they make the Sun ascend the heaven.

verses.sa:
यं सीमकृण्वन् तमसे विपृचे ध्रुवक्षेमा अनवस्यन्तो अर्थम् ।
तं सूर्यं हरितः सप्त यह्वीः स्पशं विश्वस्य जगतो वहन्ति॥
verses.tr: yaṃ sīmakṛṇvan tamase vipṛce dhruvakṣemā anavasyanto artham taṃ sūryaṃ haritaḥ sapta yahvīḥ spaśaṃ viśvasya jagato vahanti
verses.en: Him whom they made to drive away the darkness, Lords of sure mansions, constant to their object, Him who beholds the universe, the Sun-God, seven strong and youthful Coursers carry onward.

verses.sa:
वहिष्ठेभिर्विहरन्यासि तन्तुमवव्ययन्नसितं देव वस्म ।
दविध्वतो रश्मयः सूर्यस्य चर्मेवावाधुस्तमो अप्स्व१न्तः॥
verses.tr: vahiṣṭhebhirviharanyāsi tantumavavyayannasitaṃ deva vasma davidhvato raśmayaḥ sūryasya carmevāvādhustamo apsva1ntaḥ
verses.en: Spreading thy web with mightiest Steeds thou comest, rending apart, thou God, the black-hued mantle. The rays of Surya tremulously shining sink, like a hide, the darkness in the waters.

verses.sa:
अनायतो अनिबद्धः कथायं न्यङ्ङुत्तानोऽव पद्यते न ।
कया याति स्वधया को ददर्श दिवः स्कम्भः समृतः पाति नाकम्॥
verses.tr: anāyato anibaddhaḥ kathāyaṃ nyaṅṅuttāno'va padyate na kayā yāti svadhayā ko dadarśa divaḥ skambhaḥ samṛtaḥ pāti nākam
verses.en: How is it that, unbound and not supported, he falleth not although directed downward? By what self power moves he? Who hath seen it? He guards the vault of heaven, a close-set pillar.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्निरुषसो जातवेदा अख्यद् देवो रोचमाना महोभिः ।
आ नासत्योरुगाया रथेनेमं यज्ञमुप नो यातमच्छ॥
verses.tr: pratyagniruṣaso jātavedā akhyad devo rocamānā mahobhiḥ ā nāsatyorugāyā rathenemaṃ yajñamupa no yātamaccha
verses.en: The God hath looked, even Agni Jatavedas, to meet the Dawns refulgent in their glories. Come on your chariot, ye who travel widely, come to this sacrifice of ours, Nasatyas.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वं केतुं सविता देवो अश्रेज्ज्योतिर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय कृण्वन् ।
आप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं वि सूर्यो रश्मिभिश्चेकितानः॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvaṃ ketuṃ savitā devo aśrejjyotirviśvasmai bhuvanāya kṛṇvan āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ vi sūryo raśmibhiścekitānaḥ
verses.en: Producing light for all the world of creatures, God Savitar hath raised aloft his banner. Making his presence known by sunbeams, Surya hath filled the firmament and earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
आवहन्त्यरुणीर्ज्योतिषागान्मही चित्रा रश्मिभिश्चेकिताना ।
प्रबोधयन्ती सुविताय देव्यु१षा ईयते सुयुजा रथेन॥
verses.tr: āvahantyaruṇīrjyotiṣāgānmahī citrā raśmibhiścekitānā prabodhayantī suvitāya devyu1ṣā īyate suyujā rathena
verses.en: Red Dawn.is come, riding with brightness onward, distinguished by her beams, gay-hued and mighty. Dawn on her nobly-harnessed car, the Goddess, awaking men to happiness, approacheth.

verses.sa:
आ वां वहिष्ठा इह ते वहन्तु रथा अश्वास उषसो व्युष्टौ ।
इमे हि वां मधुपेयाय सोमा अस्मिन् यज्ञे वृषणा मादयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ vahiṣṭhā iha te vahantu rathā aśvāsa uṣaso vyuṣṭau ime hi vāṃ madhupeyāya somā asmin yajñe vṛṣaṇā mādayethām
verses.en: May those most powerful steeds and chariot bring you, O Asvins, hither at the break of morning. Here for your draught of meath are Soma juices: at this our sacrifice rejoice, ye Mighty.

verses.sa:
अनायतो अनिबद्धः कथायं न्यङ्ङुत्तानोऽव पद्यते न ।
कया याति स्वधया को ददर्श दिवः स्कम्भः समृतः पाति नाकम्॥
verses.tr: anāyato anibaddhaḥ kathāyaṃ nyaṅṅuttāno'va padyate na kayā yāti svadhayā ko dadarśa divaḥ skambhaḥ samṛtaḥ pāti nākam
verses.en: How is it that, unbound and unsupported, he falleth not although directed downward? By what self-power moves he? Who hath seen it? He guards the vault of heaven, a close-set pillar?

verses.sa: अग्निर्होता नो अध्वरे वाजी सन् परि णीयते । देवो देवेषु यज्ञियः॥
verses.tr: agnirhotā no adhvare vājī san pari ṇīyate devo deveṣu yajñiyaḥ
verses.en: Agni the Herald, like a horse, is led forth at our solemn rite, God among Gods adorable.

verses.sa: परि त्रिविष्ट्यध्वरं यात्यग्नी रथीरिव । आ देवेषु प्रयो दधत्॥
verses.tr: pari triviṣṭyadhvaraṃ yātyagnī rathīriva ā deveṣu prayo dadhat
verses.en: Three times unto our solemn rite comes Agni like a charioteer, Bearing the viands to the Gods.

verses.sa: परि वाजपतिः कविरग्निर्हव्यान्यक्रमीत् । दधद् रत्नानि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: pari vājapatiḥ kaviragnirhavyānyakramīt dadhad ratnāni dāśuṣe
verses.en: Round the oblations hath he paced, Agni the Wise, the Lord of Strength, Giving the offerer precious boons.

verses.sa: अयं यः सृञ्जये पुरो दैववाते समिध्यते । द्युमाँ अमित्रदम्भनः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ yaḥ sṛñjaye puro daivavāte samidhyate dyumāṃ amitradambhanaḥ
verses.en: He who is kindled eastward for Srnjaya, Devavata's son, Resplendent, tamer of the foe.

verses.sa: अस्य घा वीर ईवतोऽग्नेरीशीत मर्त्यः । तिग्मजम्भस्य मीळहुषः॥
verses.tr: asya ghā vīra īvato'gnerīśīta martyaḥ tigmajambhasya mīḻahuṣaḥ
verses.en: So mighty be the Agni whom the mortal hero shall command, With sharpened teeth and bountiful.

verses.sa: तमर्वन्तं न सानसिमरुषं न दिवः शिशुम् । मर्मृज्यन्ते दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: tamarvantaṃ na sānasimaruṣaṃ na divaḥ śiśum marmṛjyante divedive
verses.en: Day after day they dress him, as they clean a horse who wins the prize. Dress the red Scion of the Sky.

verses.sa: बोधद्यन्मा हरिभ्यां कुमारः साहदेव्यः । अच्छा न हूत उदरम्॥
verses.tr: bodhadyanmā haribhyāṃ kumāraḥ sāhadevyaḥ acchā na hūta udaram
verses.en: When Sahadeva's princely son with two bay horses thought of me, Summoned by him I drew not back.

verses.sa: उत त्या यजता हरी कुमारात् साहदेव्यात् । प्रयता सद्य आ ददे॥
verses.tr: uta tyā yajatā harī kumārāt sāhadevyāt prayatā sadya ā dade
verses.en: And truly those two noble bays I straightway took when offered me, From Sahadeva's princely son.

verses.sa: एष वां देवावश्विना कुमारः साहदेव्यः । दीर्घायुरस्तु सोमकः॥
verses.tr: eṣa vāṃ devāvaśvinā kumāraḥ sāhadevyaḥ dīrghāyurastu somakaḥ
verses.en: Long, O ye Asvins, may he live, your care, ye Gods, the princely son. Of Sahadeva, Somaka.

verses.sa: तं युवं देवावश्विना कुमारं साहदेव्यम् । दीर्घायुषं कृणोतन॥
verses.tr: taṃ yuvaṃ devāvaśvinā kumāraṃ sāhadevyam dīrghāyuṣaṃ kṛṇotana
verses.en: Cause him the youthful prince, the son of Sahadeva, to enjoy Long life, O Asvins, O ye Gods.

verses.sa:
आ सत्यो यातु मघवाँ ऋजीषी द्रवन्त्वस्य हरय उप नः ।
तस्मा इदन्धः सुषुमा सुदक्षमिहाभिपित्वं करते गृणानः॥
verses.tr: ā satyo yātu maghavāṃ ṛjīṣī dravantvasya haraya upa naḥ tasmā idandhaḥ suṣumā sudakṣamihābhipitvaṃ karate gṛṇānaḥ
verses.en: Impetuous, true, let Maghavan come hither, and let his Tawny Coursers speed to reach us. For him have we pressed juice exceeding potent: here, praised with song, let him effect his visit.

verses.sa:
अव स्य शूराध्वनो नान्तेऽस्मिन् नो अद्य सवने मन्दध्यै ।
शंसात्युक्थमुशनेव वेधाश्चिकितुषे असुर्याय मन्म॥
verses.tr: ava sya śūrādhvano nānte'smin no adya savane mandadhyai śaṃsātyukthamuśaneva vedhāścikituṣe asuryāya manma
verses.en: Unyoke, as at thy journey's end, O Hero, to gladden thee today at this libation. Like Usana, the priest a laud shall utter, a hymn to thee, the Lord Divine, who markest.

verses.sa:
कविर्न निण्यं विदथानि साधन्वृ वृषा यत् सेकं विपिपानो अर्चात् ।
दिव इत्था जीजनत् सप्त कारूनह्ना चिच्चक्रुर्वयुना गृणन्तः॥
verses.tr: kavirna niṇyaṃ vidathāni sādhanvṛ vṛṣā yat sekaṃ vipipāno arcāt diva itthā jījanat sapta kārūnahnā ciccakrurvayunā gṛṇantaḥ
verses.en: When the Bull, quaffing, praises our libation, as a sage paying holy rites in secret, Seven singers here from heaven hath he begotten, who e'en by day have wrought their works while singing.

verses.sa:
स्व१र्यद् वेदि सुदृशीकमर्कैर्महि ज्योती रुरुचुर्यद्ध वस्तोः ।
अन्धा तमांसि दुधिता विचक्षे नृभ्यश्चकार नृतमो अभिष्टौ॥
verses.tr: sva1ryad vedi sudṛśīkamarkairmahi jyotī rurucuryaddha vastoḥ andhā tamāṃsi dudhitā vicakṣe nṛbhyaścakāra nṛtamo abhiṣṭau
verses.en: When heaven's fair light by hymns was made apparent (they made great splendour shine at break of morning), He with his succour, best of Heroes, scattered the blinding darkness so that men saw clearly.

verses.sa:
ववक्ष इन्द्रो अमितमृजीष्यु१भे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा ।
अतश्चिदस्य महिमा वि रेच्यभि यो विश्वा भुवना बभूव॥
verses.tr: vavakṣa indro amitamṛjīṣyu1bhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā ataścidasya mahimā vi recyabhi yo viśvā bhuvanā babhūva
verses.en: Indra, Impetuous One, hath waxed immensely: he with his vastness hath filled earth and heaven. E'en beyond this his majesty extendeth who hath exceeded all the worlds in greatness.

verses.sa:
विश्वानि शक्रो नर्याणि विद्वानपो रिरेच सखिभिर्निकामैः ।
अश्मानं चिद् ये बिभिदुर्वचोभिर्व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो वि वव्रुः॥
verses.tr: viśvāni śakro naryāṇi vidvānapo rireca sakhibhirnikāmaiḥ aśmānaṃ cid ye bibhidurvacobhirvrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ
verses.en: Sakra who knoweth well all human actions hath with his eager Friends let loose the waters. They with their songs cleft e'en the mountain open and willingly disclosed the stall of cattle.

verses.sa:
अपो वृत्रं वव्रिवांसं पराहन् प्रावत् ते वज्रं पृथिवी सचेताः ।
प्रार्णांसि समुद्रियाण्यैनोः पतिर्भवञ्छवसा शूर धृष्णो॥
verses.tr: apo vṛtraṃ vavrivāṃsaṃ parāhan prāvat te vajraṃ pṛthivī sacetāḥ prārṇāṃsi samudriyāṇyainoḥ patirbhavañchavasā śūra dhṛṣṇo
verses.en: He smote away the floods' obstructer, Vrtra; Earth, conscious, lent her aid to speed thy thunder. Thou sentest forth the waters of the ocean, as Lord through power and might, O daring Hero.

verses.sa:
अपो यदद्रिं पुरुहूत दर्दराविर्भुवत्सरमा पूर्व्यं ते ।
स नो नेता वाजमा दर्षि भूरिं गोत्रा रुजन्नङ्गिरोभिर्गृणानः॥
verses.tr: apo yadadriṃ puruhūta dardarāvirbhuvatsaramā pūrvyaṃ te sa no netā vājamā darṣi bhūriṃ gotrā rujannaṅgirobhirgṛṇānaḥ
verses.en: When, Much-invoked! the water's rock thou cleftest, Sarama showed herself and went before thee. Hymned by Angirases, bursting the cowstalls, much strength thou foundest for us as our leader.

verses.sa:
अच्छा कविं नृमणो गा अभिष्टौ स्वर्षाता मघवन्नाधमानम् ।
ऊतिभिस्तमिषणो द्युम्नहूतौ नि मायावानब्रह्मा दस्युरर्त॥
verses.tr: acchā kaviṃ nṛmaṇo gā abhiṣṭau svarṣātā maghavannādhamānam ūtibhistamiṣaṇo dyumnahūtau ni māyāvānabrahmā dasyurarta
verses.en: Come, Maghavan, Friend of Man, to aid the singer imploring thee in battle for the sunlight. Speed him with help in his inspired invokings: down sink the sorcerer, the prayerless Dasyu.

verses.sa:
आ दस्युघ्ना मनसा याह्यस्तं भुवत् ते कुत्सः सख्ये निकामः ।
स्वे योनौ नि षदतं सरूपा वि वां चिकित्सदृतचिद्ध नारी॥
verses.tr: ā dasyughnā manasā yāhyastaṃ bhuvat te kutsaḥ sakhye nikāmaḥ sve yonau ni ṣadataṃ sarūpā vi vāṃ cikitsadṛtaciddha nārī
verses.en: Come to our home resolved to slay the Dasyu: Kutsa longed eagerly to win thy friendship. Alike in form ye both sate in his dwelling the faithful Lady was in doubt between you.

verses.sa:
यासि कुत्सेन सरथमवस्युस्तोदो वातस्य हर्योरीशानः ।
ऋज्रा वाजं न गध्यं युयूषन् कविर्यदहन् पार्याय भूषात्॥
verses.tr: yāsi kutsena sarathamavasyustodo vātasya haryorīśānaḥ ṛjrā vājaṃ na gadhyaṃ yuyūṣan kaviryadahan pāryāya bhūṣāt
verses.en: Thou comest, fain to succour him, with Kutsa,-a goad that masters both the Wind-God's horses, That, holding the brown steeds like spoil for capture, the sage may on the final day be present.

verses.sa:
कुत्साय शुष्णमशुषं नि बर्हीः प्रपित्वे अह्नः कुयवं सहस्रा ।
सद्यो दस्यून् प्र मृण कुत्स्येन प्र सूरश्चक्रं वृहतादभीके॥
verses.tr: kutsāya śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ ni barhīḥ prapitve ahnaḥ kuyavaṃ sahasrā sadyo dasyūn pra mṛṇa kutsyena pra sūraścakraṃ vṛhatādabhīke
verses.en: For Kutsa, with thy thousand, thou at day-break didst hurl down greedy Susna, foe of harvest. Quickly with Kutsa's friend destroy the Dasyus, and roll the chariot-wheel of Sarya near us.

verses.sa:
त्वं पिप्रुं मृगयं शूशुवांसमृजिश्वने वैदथिनाय रन्धीः ।
पञ्चाशत् कृष्णा नि वपः सहस्रा ऽत्कं न पुरो जरिमा वि दर्दः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ pipruṃ mṛgayaṃ śūśuvāṃsamṛjiśvane vaidathināya randhīḥ pañcāśat kṛṣṇā ni vapaḥ sahasrā 'tkaṃ na puro jarimā vi dardaḥ
verses.en: Thou to the son of Vidathin, Rjisvan, gavest up mighty Mrgaya and Pipru. Thou smotest down the swarthy fifty thousand, and rentest forts as age consumes a garment.

verses.sa:
सूर उपाके तन्वं१ दधानो वि यत्ते चेत्यमृतस्य वर्पः ।
मृगो न हस्ती तविषीमुषाणः सिंहो न भीम आयुधानि बिभ्रत्॥
verses.tr: sūra upāke tanvaṃ1 dadhāno vi yatte cetyamṛtasya varpaḥ mṛgo na hastī taviṣīmuṣāṇaḥ siṃho na bhīma āyudhāni bibhrat
verses.en: What time thou settest near the Sun thy body, thy form, Immortal One, is seen expanding: Thou a wild elephant with might invested. like a dread lion as thou wieldest weapons.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं कामा वसूयन्तो अग्मन् त्स्वर्मीळहे न सवने चकानाः ।
श्रवस्यवः शशमानास उक्थैरोको न रण्वा सुदृशीव पुष्टिः॥
verses.tr: indraṃ kāmā vasūyanto agman tsvarmīḻahe na savane cakānāḥ śravasyavaḥ śaśamānāsa ukthairoko na raṇvā sudṛśīva puṣṭiḥ
verses.en: Wishes for wealth have gone to Indra, longing for him in war for light and at libation, Eager for glory, labouring with praisesongs: he is like home, like sweet and fair nutrition.

verses.sa:
तमिद्व इन्द्रं सुहवं हुवेम यस्ता चकार नर्या पुरूणि ।
यो मावते जरित्रे गध्यं चिन्मक्षू वाजं भरति स्पार्हराधाः॥
verses.tr: tamidva indraṃ suhavaṃ huvema yastā cakāra naryā purūṇi yo māvate jaritre gadhyaṃ cinmakṣū vājaṃ bharati spārharādhāḥ
verses.en: Call we for you that Indra, prompt to listen, him who hath done so much for men's advantage; Who, Lord of envied bounty, to a singer like me brings quickly booty worth the capture.

verses.sa:
तिग्मा यदन्तरशनिः पताति कस्मिञ्चिच्छूर मुहुके जनानाम् ।
घोरा यदर्य समृतिर्भवात्यध स्मा नस्तन्वो बोधि गोपाः॥
verses.tr: tigmā yadantaraśaniḥ patāti kasmiñcicchūra muhuke janānām ghorā yadarya samṛtirbhavātyadha smā nastanvo bodhi gopāḥ
verses.en: When the sharp-pointed arrow, O thou Hero, flieth mid any conflict of the people, When, Faithful One, the dread encounter cometh, then be thou the Protector of our body.

verses.sa:
भुवोऽविता वामदेवस्य धीनां भुवः सखावृको वाजसातौ ।
त्वामनु प्रमतिमा जगन्मोरुशंसो जरित्रे विश्वध स्याः॥
verses.tr: bhuvo'vitā vāmadevasya dhīnāṃ bhuvaḥ sakhāvṛko vājasātau tvāmanu pramatimā jaganmoruśaṃso jaritre viśvadha syāḥ
verses.en: Further the holy thoughts of Vamadeva be thou a guileless Friend in fight for booty. We come to thee whose providence protects us: wide be thy sway for ever for thy singer.

verses.sa:
एभिर्नृभिरिन्द्र त्वायुभिष्ट्वा मघवद्भिर्मघवन् विश्व आजौ ।
द्यावो न द्युम्नैरभि सन्तो अर्यः क्षपो मदेम शरदश्च पूर्वीः॥
verses.tr: ebhirnṛbhirindra tvāyubhiṣṭvā maghavadbhirmaghavan viśva ājau dyāvo na dyumnairabhi santo aryaḥ kṣapo madema śaradaśca pūrvīḥ
verses.en: O Indra, with these men who love thee truly, free givers, Maghavan, in every battle, May we rejoice through many autumns, quelling our foes, as days subdue the nights with splendour.

verses.sa:
एवेदिन्द्राय वृषभाय वृष्णे ब्रह्माकर्म भृगवो न रथम् ।
नू चिद् यथा नः सख्या वियोषदसन्न उग्रोऽविता तनूपाः॥
verses.tr: evedindrāya vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe brahmākarma bhṛgavo na ratham nū cid yathā naḥ sakhyā viyoṣadasanna ugro'vitā tanūpāḥ
verses.en: Now, as the Bhrgus wrought a car, for Indra the Strong, the Mighty, we our prayer have fashioned, That he may, ne'er withdraw from us his friendship, but be our bodies' guard and strong defender.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो३ न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः॥
verses.tr: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo3 na pīpeḥ akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
verses.en: Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let power swell. high like rivers for the singer. For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays, is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
त्वं महाँ इन्द्र तुभ्यं ह क्षा अनु क्षत्रं मंहना मन्यत द्यौः ।
त्वं वृत्रं शवसा जघन्वान् त्सृजः सिन्धूँरहिना जग्रसानान्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ mahāṃ indra tubhyaṃ ha kṣā anu kṣatraṃ maṃhanā manyata dyauḥ tvaṃ vṛtraṃ śavasā jaghanvān tsṛjaḥ sindhūṃrahinā jagrasānān
verses.en: Great art thou, Indra; yea, the earth, with gladness, and heaven confess to thee thine high dominion. Thou in thy vigour having slaughtered Vrtra didst free the floods arrested by the Dragon.

verses.sa:
तव त्विषो जनिमन् रेजत द्यौ रेजद् भूमिर्भियसा स्वस्य मन्योः ।
ऋघायन्त सुभ्व१ः पर्वतास आर्दन् धन्वानि सरयन्त आपः॥
verses.tr: tava tviṣo janiman rejata dyau rejad bhūmirbhiyasā svasya manyoḥ ṛghāyanta subhva1ḥ parvatāsa ārdan dhanvāni sarayanta āpaḥ
verses.en: Heaven trembled at the birth of thine effulgence; Earth trembled at the fear of thy displeasure. The stedfast mountains shook in agitation. the waters flowed, and desert spots were flooded.

verses.sa:
भिनद् गिरिं शवसा वज्रमिष्णन्नाविष्कृण्वानः सहसान ओजः ।
वधीद् वृत्रं वज्रेण मन्दसानः सरन्नापो जवसा हतवृष्णीः॥
verses.tr: bhinad giriṃ śavasā vajramiṣṇannāviṣkṛṇvānaḥ sahasāna ojaḥ vadhīd vṛtraṃ vajreṇa mandasānaḥ sarannāpo javasā hatavṛṣṇīḥ
verses.en: Hurling his bolt with might he cleft the mountain, while, putting forth his strength, he showed his vigour. He slaughtered Vrtra with his bolt, exulting, and, their lord slain, forth flowed the waters swiftly.

verses.sa:
सुवीरस्ते जनिता मन्यत द्यौरिन्द्रस्य कर्ता स्वपस्तमो भूत् ।
य ईं जजान स्वर्यं सुवज्रमनपच्युतं सदसो न भूम॥
verses.tr: suvīraste janitā manyata dyaurindrasya kartā svapastamo bhūt ya īṃ jajāna svaryaṃ suvajramanapacyutaṃ sadaso na bhūma
verses.en: Thy Father Dyaus esteemed himself a hero: most noble was the work of Indra's Maker, His who begat the strong bolt's Lord who roareth, immovable like earth from her foundation.

verses.sa:
य एक इच्च्यावयति प्र भूमा राजा कृष्टीनां पुरुहूत इन्द्रः ।
सत्यमेनमनु विश्वे मदन्ति रातिं देवस्य गृणतो मघोनः॥
verses.tr: ya eka iccyāvayati pra bhūmā rājā kṛṣṭīnāṃ puruhūta indraḥ satyamenamanu viśve madanti rātiṃ devasya gṛṇato maghonaḥ
verses.en: He who alone o'erthrows the world of creatures, Indra the peoples' King, invoked of many- Verily all rejoice in him, extolling the boons which Maghavan the God hath sent them.

verses.sa:
सत्रा सोमा अभवन्नस्य विश्वे सत्रा मदासो बृहतो मदिष्ठाः ।
सत्राभवो वसुपतिर्वसूनां दत्रे विश्वा अधिथा इन्द्र कृष्टीः॥
verses.tr: satrā somā abhavannasya viśve satrā madāso bṛhato madiṣṭhāḥ satrābhavo vasupatirvasūnāṃ datre viśvā adhithā indra kṛṣṭīḥ
verses.en: All Soma juices are his own for ever, most gladdening draughts are ever his, the Mighty, Thou ever wast the Treasure-Lord of treasures: Indra, thou lettest all folk share thy bounty.

verses.sa:
त्वमध प्रथमं जायमानोऽमे विश्वा अधिथा इन्द्र कृष्टीः ।
त्वं प्रति प्रवत आशयानमहिं वज्रेण मघवन् वि वृश्चः॥
verses.tr: tvamadha prathamaṃ jāyamāno'me viśvā adhithā indra kṛṣṭīḥ tvaṃ prati pravata āśayānamahiṃ vajreṇa maghavan vi vṛścaḥ
verses.en: Moreover, when thou first wast born, O Indra, thou struckest terror into all the people. Thou, Maghavan, rentest with thy bolt the Dragon who lay against the waterfloods of heaven.

verses.sa:
सत्राहणं दाधृषिं तुम्रमिन्द्रं महामपारं वृषभं सुवज्रम् ।
हन्ता यो वृत्रं सनितोत वाजं दाता मघानि मघवा सुराधाः॥
verses.tr: satrāhaṇaṃ dādhṛṣiṃ tumramindraṃ mahāmapāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ suvajram hantā yo vṛtraṃ sanitota vājaṃ dātā maghāni maghavā surādhāḥ
verses.en: The ever-slaying, bold and furious Indra, the bright bolt's Lord, infinite, strong and mighty, Who slayeth Vrtra and acquireth booty, giver of blessings, Maghavan the bounteous:

verses.sa:
अयं वृतश्चातयते समीचीर्य आजिषु मघवा शृण्व एकः ।
अयं वाजं भरति यं सनोत्यस्य प्रियासः सख्ये स्याम॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vṛtaścātayate samīcīrya ājiṣu maghavā śṛṇva ekaḥ ayaṃ vājaṃ bharati yaṃ sanotyasya priyāsaḥ sakhye syāma
verses.en: Alone renowned as Maghavan in battles, he frighteneth away assembled armies. He bringeth us the booty that he winneth may we, well-loved, continue in his friendship.

verses.sa:
अयं शृण्वे अध जयन्नुत घ्नन्नयमुत प्र कृणुते युधा गाः ।
यदा सत्यं कृणुते मन्युमिन्द्रो विश्वं दृळहं भयत एजदस्मात्॥
