verses.tr: ayaṃ śṛṇve adha jayannuta ghnannayamuta pra kṛṇute yudhā gāḥ yadā satyaṃ kṛṇute manyumindro viśvaṃ dṛḻahaṃ bhayata ejadasmāt
verses.en: Renowned is he when conquering and when slaying: 'fis he who winneth cattle in the combat. When Indra hardeneth his indignation all that is fixed and all that moveth fear him.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्रो गा अजयत् सं हिरण्या समश्विया मघवा यो ह पूर्वीः ।
एभिर्नृभिर्नृतमो अस्य शाकै रायो विभक्ता सम्भरश्च वस्वः॥
verses.tr: samindro gā ajayat saṃ hiraṇyā samaśviyā maghavā yo ha pūrvīḥ ebhirnṛbhirnṛtamo asya śākai rāyo vibhaktā sambharaśca vasvaḥ
verses.en: Indra hath won all kine, all gold, all horses, Maghavan, he who breaketh forts in pieces; Most manly with these men of his who help him, dealing out wealth and gathering the treasure.

verses.sa:
कियत् स्विदिन्द्रो अध्येति मातुः कियत् पितुर्जनितुर्यो जजान ।
यो अस्य शुष्मं मुहुकैरियर्ति वातो न जूतः स्तनयद्भिरभ्रैः॥
verses.tr: kiyat svidindro adhyeti mātuḥ kiyat piturjanituryo jajāna yo asya śuṣmaṃ muhukairiyarti vāto na jūtaḥ stanayadbhirabhraiḥ
verses.en: What is the care of Indra for his Mother, what cares he for the Father who begat him? His care is that which speeds his might in conflicts, like wind borne onward by the clouds that thunder.

verses.sa:
क्षियन्तं त्वमक्षियन्तं कृणोतीयर्ति रेणुं मघवा समोहम् ।
विभञ्जनुरशनिमाँ इव द्यौरुत स्तोतारं मघवा वसौ धात्॥
verses.tr: kṣiyantaṃ tvamakṣiyantaṃ kṛṇotīyarti reṇuṃ maghavā samoham vibhañjanuraśanimāṃ iva dyauruta stotāraṃ maghavā vasau dhāt
verses.en: Maghavan makes the settled man unsettled: he scatters dust that he hath swept together, Breaking in pieces like Heaven armed with lightning: Maghavan shall enrich the man who lauds h;m.

verses.sa:
अयं चक्रमिषणत् सूर्यस्य न्येतशं रीरमत् ससृमाणम् ।
आ कृष्ण ईं जुहुराणो जिघर्ति त्वचो बुध्ने रजसो अस्य योनौ॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ cakramiṣaṇat sūryasya nyetaśaṃ rīramat sasṛmāṇam ā kṛṣṇa īṃ juhurāṇo jigharti tvaco budhne rajaso asya yonau
verses.en: He urged the chariot-wheel of Surya forward: Etasa, speeding on his way, he rested. Him the black undulating cloud bedeweth, in this mid-air's depth, at the base of darkness,

verses.sa: असिक्न्यां यजमानो न होता॥
verses.tr: asiknyāṃ yajamāno na hotā
verses.en: As in the night the sacrificing priest.

verses.sa:
गव्यन्त इन्द्रं सख्याय विप्रा अश्वायन्तो वृषणं वाजयन्तः ।
जनीयन्तो जनिदामक्षितोतिमा च्यावयामोऽवते न कोशम्॥
verses.tr: gavyanta indraṃ sakhyāya viprā aśvāyanto vṛṣaṇaṃ vājayantaḥ janīyanto janidāmakṣitotimā cyāvayāmo'vate na kośam
verses.en: Eager for booty, craving strength and horses, we-singers stir Indra, the strong, for friendship, Who gives the wives we seek, whose succour fails not, to hasten, like a pitcher to the fountain.

verses.sa:
त्राता नो बोधि ददृशान आपिरभिख्याता मर्डिता सोम्यानाम् ।
सखा पिता पितृतमः पितॄणां कर्तेमु लोकमुशते वयोधाः॥
verses.tr: trātā no bodhi dadṛśāna āpirabhikhyātā marḍitā somyānām sakhā pitā pitṛtamaḥ pitṝṇāṃ kartemu lokamuśate vayodhāḥ
verses.en: Be thou our guardian, show thyself our kinsman, watching and blessing those who pour the Soma; As Friend, as Sire, most fatherly of fathers giving the suppliant vital strength and freedom.

verses.sa:
सखीयतामविता बोधि सखा गृणान इन्द्र स्तुवते वयो धाः ।
वयं ह्या ते चकृमा सबाध आभिः शमीभिर्महयन्त इन्द्र॥
verses.tr: sakhīyatāmavitā bodhi sakhā gṛṇāna indra stuvate vayo dhāḥ vayaṃ hyā te cakṛmā sabādha ābhiḥ śamībhirmahayanta indra
verses.en: Be helping Friend of those who seek thy friendship. give life, when lauded, Indra, to the singer. For, Indra, we the priests have paid thee worship, exalting thee with these our sacrifices.

verses.sa:
स्तुत इन्द्रो मघवा यद्ध वृत्रा भूरीण्येको अप्रतीनि हन्ति ।
अस्य प्रियो जरिता यस्य शर्मन्नकिर्देवा वारयन्ते न मर्ताः॥
verses.tr: stuta indro maghavā yaddha vṛtrā bhūrīṇyeko apratīni hanti asya priyo jaritā yasya śarmannakirdevā vārayante na martāḥ
verses.en: Alone, when Indra Maghavan is lauded, he slayeth many ne'er-resisted Vrtras. Him in whose keeping is the well-loved singer never do Gods or mortals stay or hinder.

verses.sa:
एवा न इन्द्रो मघवा विरप्शी करत् सत्या चर्षणीधृदनर्वा ।
त्वं राजा जनुषां धेह्यस्मे अधि श्रवो माहिनं यज्जरित्रे॥
verses.tr: evā na indro maghavā virapśī karat satyā carṣaṇīdhṛdanarvā tvaṃ rājā januṣāṃ dhehyasme adhi śravo māhinaṃ yajjaritre
verses.en: E’en so let Maghavan, the loud-voiced Indra, give us true blessings, foeless, men's upholder. King of all creatures, give us glory amply, exalted glory due to him who lauds thee.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो३न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः॥
verses.tr: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo3na pīpeḥ akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
verses.en: Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let power swell high like rivers for the singer. For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays! is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
अयं पन्था अनुवित्तः पुराणो यतो देवा उदजायन्त विश्वे ।
अतश्चिदा जनिषीष्ट प्रवृद्धो मा मातरममुया पत्तवे कः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ panthā anuvittaḥ purāṇo yato devā udajāyanta viśve ataścidā janiṣīṣṭa pravṛddho mā mātaramamuyā pattave kaḥ
verses.en: This is the ancient and accepted pathway by which all Gods have come into existence. Hereby could one be born though waxen mighty. Let him not, otherwise, destroy his Mother.

verses.sa:
नाहमतो निरया दुर्गहैतत् तिरश्चता पार्श्वान्निर्गमाणि ।
बहूनि मे अकृता कर्त्वानि युध्यै त्वेन सं त्वेन पृच्छै॥
verses.tr: nāhamato nirayā durgahaitat tiraścatā pārśvānnirgamāṇi bahūni me akṛtā kartvāni yudhyai tvena saṃ tvena pṛcchai
verses.en: Not this way go I forth: hard is the passage. Forth from the side obliquely will I issue. Much that is yet undone must I accomplish; one must I combat and the other question.

verses.sa:
परायतीं मातरमन्वचष्ट न नानु गान्यनु नू गमानि ।
त्वष्टुर्गृहे अपिबत् सोममिन्द्रः शतधन्यं चम्वोः सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: parāyatīṃ mātaramanvacaṣṭa na nānu gānyanu nū gamāni tvaṣṭurgṛhe apibat somamindraḥ śatadhanyaṃ camvoḥ sutasya
verses.en: He bent his eye upon the dying Mother: My word I now withdraw. That way I follow. In Tvastar's dwelling India drank the Soma, a hundredworth of juice pressed from the mortar.

verses.sa:
किं स ऋधक् कृणवद् यं सहस्रं मासो जभार शरदश्च पूर्वीः ।
नही न्वस्य प्रतिमानमस्त्यन्तर्जातेषूत ये जनित्वाः॥
verses.tr: kiṃ sa ṛdhak kṛṇavad yaṃ sahasraṃ māso jabhāra śaradaśca pūrvīḥ nahī nvasya pratimānamastyantarjāteṣūta ye janitvāḥ
verses.en: What strange act shall he do, he whom his Mother bore for a thousand months and many autumns? No peer hath he among those born already, nor among those who shall be born hereafter.

verses.sa:
अवद्यमिव मन्यमाना गुहाकरिन्द्रं माता वीर्येणा न्यृष्टम् ।
अथोदस्थात् स्वयमत्कं वसान आ रोदसी अपृणाज्जायमानः॥
verses.tr: avadyamiva manyamānā guhākarindraṃ mātā vīryeṇā nyṛṣṭam athodasthāt svayamatkaṃ vasāna ā rodasī apṛṇājjāyamānaḥ
verses.en: Deeming him a reproach, his mother hid him, Indra, endowed with all heroic valour. Then up he sprang himself, assumed his vesture, and filled, as soon as born, the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
एता अर्षन्त्यललाभवन्तीर्ऋतावरीरिव संक्रोशमानाः ।
एता वि पृच्छ किमिदं भनन्ति कमापो अद्रिं परिधिं रुजन्ति॥
verses.tr: etā arṣantyalalābhavantīrṛtāvarīriva saṃkrośamānāḥ etā vi pṛccha kimidaṃ bhananti kamāpo adriṃ paridhiṃ rujanti
verses.en: With lively motion onward flow these waters, the Holy Ones, shouting, as 'twere, together. Ask them to. tell thee what the floods are saying, what girdling rock the waters burst asunder.

verses.sa:
किमु ष्विदस्मै निविदो भनन्तेन्द्रस्यावद्यं दिधिषन्त आपः ।
ममैतान् पुत्रो महता वधेन वृत्रं जघन्वाँ असृजद् वि सिन्धून्॥
verses.tr: kimu ṣvidasmai nivido bhanantendrasyāvadyaṃ didhiṣanta āpaḥ mamaitān putro mahatā vadhena vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ asṛjad vi sindhūn
verses.en: Are they addressing him with words of welcome? Will the floods take on them the shame of Indra? With his great thunderbolt my Son hath slaughtered Vrtra, and set these rivers free to wander.

verses.sa:
ममच्चन त्वा युवतिः परास ममच्चन त्वा कुषवा जगार ।
ममच्चिदापः शिशवे ममृड्युर्ममच्चिदिन्द्रः सहसोदतिष्ठत्॥
verses.tr: mamaccana tvā yuvatiḥ parāsa mamaccana tvā kuṣavā jagāra mamaccidāpaḥ śiśave mamṛḍyurmamaccidindraḥ sahasodatiṣṭhat
verses.en: I cast thee from me, mine,-thy youthful mother: thee, mine own offspring, Kusava hath swallowed. To him, mine infant, were the waters gracious. Indra, my Son, rose up in conquering vigour.

verses.sa:
ममच्चन ते मघवन् व्यंसो निविविध्वाँ अप हनू जघान ।
अधा निविद्ध उत्तरो बभूवाञ्छिरो दासस्य सं पिणग्वधेन॥
verses.tr: mamaccana te maghavan vyaṃso nivividhvāṃ apa hanū jaghāna adhā nividdha uttaro babhūvāñchiro dāsasya saṃ piṇagvadhena
verses.en: Thou art mine own, O Maghavan, whom Vyamsa struck to the ground and smote thy jaws in pieces. But, smitten through, the mastery thou wonnest, and with thy bolt the Dasa's head thou crushedst.

verses.sa:
गृष्टिः ससूव स्थविरं तवागामनाधृष्यं वृषभं तुम्रमिन्द्रम् ।
अरीळहं वत्सं चरथाय माता स्वयं गातुं तन्व इच्छमानम्॥
verses.tr: gṛṣṭiḥ sasūva sthaviraṃ tavāgāmanādhṛṣyaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tumramindram arīḻahaṃ vatsaṃ carathāya mātā svayaṃ gātuṃ tanva icchamānam
verses.en: The Heifer hath brought forth the Strong, the Mighty, the unconquerable Bull, the furious Indra. The Mother left her unlicked Calf to wander, seeking himself, the path that he would follow.

verses.sa:
उत माता महिषमन्ववेनदमी त्वा जहति पुत्र देवाः ।
अथाब्रवीद् वृत्रमिन्द्रो हनिष्यन् त्सखे विष्णो वितरं वि क्रमस्व॥
verses.tr: uta mātā mahiṣamanvavenadamī tvā jahati putra devāḥ athābravīd vṛtramindro haniṣyan tsakhe viṣṇo vitaraṃ vi kramasva
verses.en: Then to her mighty Child the Mother turned her, saying, My son, these Deities forsake thee. Then Indra said, about to slaughter Vrtra, O my friend Vrtra, stride full boldly forward.

verses.sa:
कस्ते मातरं विधवामचक्रच्छयुं कस्त्वामजिघांसच्चरन्तम् ।
कस्ते देवो अधि मार्डीक आसीद् यत् प्राक्षिणाः पितरं पादगृह्य॥
verses.tr: kaste mātaraṃ vidhavāmacakracchayuṃ kastvāmajighāṃsaccarantam kaste devo adhi mārḍīka āsīd yat prākṣiṇāḥ pitaraṃ pādagṛhya
verses.en: Who was he then who made thy Mother widow? Who sought to stay thee lying still or moving? What God, when by the foot thy Sire thou tookest and slewest, was at hand to give thee comfort?

verses.sa:
अवर्त्या शुन आन्त्राणि पेचे न देवेषु विविदे मर्डितारम् ।
अपश्यं जायाममहीयमानामधा मे श्येनो मध्वा जभार॥
verses.tr: avartyā śuna āntrāṇi pece na deveṣu vivide marḍitāram apaśyaṃ jāyāmamahīyamānāmadhā me śyeno madhvā jabhāra
verses.en: In deep distress I cooked a dog's intestines. Among the Gods I found not one to comfort. My consort I beheld in degradation. The Falcon then brought me the pleasant Soma.

verses.sa:
एवा त्वामिन्द्र वज्रिन्नत्र विश्वे देवासः सुहवास ऊमाः ।
महामुभे रोदसी वृद्धमृष्वं निरेकमिद् वृणते वृत्रहत्ये॥
verses.tr: evā tvāmindra vajrinnatra viśve devāsaḥ suhavāsa ūmāḥ mahāmubhe rodasī vṛddhamṛṣvaṃ nirekamid vṛṇate vṛtrahatye
verses.en: Thee, verily, O Thunder-wielding Indra, all the Gods here, the Helpers swift to listen, And both the worlds elected, thee the Mighty, High, waxen strong, alone to slaughter Vrtra.

verses.sa:
अवासृजन्त जिव्रयो न देवा भुवः सम्राळिन्द्र सत्ययोनिः ।
अहन्नहिं परिशयानमर्णः प्र वर्तनीररदो विश्वधेनाः॥
verses.tr: avāsṛjanta jivrayo na devā bhuvaḥ samrāḻindra satyayoniḥ ahannahiṃ pariśayānamarṇaḥ pra vartanīrarado viśvadhenāḥ
verses.en: The Gods, as worn witheld, relaxed their efforts: thou, Indra, born of truth, wast Sovran Ruler. Thou slewest Ahi who besieged the waters, and duggest out their all-supporting channels.

verses.sa:
अतृप्णुवन्तं वियतमबुध्यमबुध्यमानं सुषुपाणमिन्द्र ।
सप्त प्रति प्रवत आशयानमहिं वज्रेण वि रिणा अपर्वन्॥
verses.tr: atṛpṇuvantaṃ viyatamabudhyamabudhyamānaṃ suṣupāṇamindra sapta prati pravata āśayānamahiṃ vajreṇa vi riṇā aparvan
verses.en: The insatiate one, extended, hard to waken, who slumbered in perpetual sleep, O Indra, The Dragon stretched against the seven prone rivers, where no joint was, thou rentest with thy thunder.

verses.sa:
अक्षोदयच्छवसा क्षाम बुध्नं वार्ण वातस्तविषीभिरिन्द्रः ।
दृळहान्यौभ्नादुशमान ओजोऽवाभिनत् ककुभः पर्वतानाम्॥
verses.tr: akṣodayacchavasā kṣāma budhnaṃ vārṇa vātastaviṣībhirindraḥ dṛḻahānyaubhnāduśamāna ojo'vābhinat kakubhaḥ parvatānām
verses.en: Indra with might shook earth and her foundation as the wind stirs the water with its fury. Striving, with strength he burst the firm asunder, and tore away the summits of the mountains.

verses.sa:
अभि प्र दद्रुर्जनयो न गर्भं रथा इव प्र ययुः साकमद्रयः ।
अतर्पयो विसृत उब्ज ऊर्मीन् त्वं वृताँ अरिणा इन्द्र सिन्धून्॥
verses.tr: abhi pra dadrurjanayo na garbhaṃ rathā iva pra yayuḥ sākamadrayaḥ atarpayo visṛta ubja ūrmīn tvaṃ vṛtāṃ ariṇā indra sindhūn
verses.en: They ran to thee as mothers to their offspring: the clouds, like chariots, hastened forth together. Thou didst refresh the streams and force the billows: thou, Indra, settest free obstructed rivers.

verses.sa:
त्वं महीमवनिं विश्वधेनां तुर्वीतये वय्याय क्षरन्तीम् ।
अरमयो नमसैजदर्णः सुतरणाँ अकृणोरिन्द्र सिन्धून्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ mahīmavaniṃ viśvadhenāṃ turvītaye vayyāya kṣarantīm aramayo namasaijadarṇaḥ sutaraṇāṃ akṛṇorindra sindhūn
verses.en: Thou for the sake of Vayya and Turviti didst stay the great stream, flowing, allsustaining: Yea, at their prayer didst check the rushing river and make the floods easy to cross, O Indra.

verses.sa:
प्राग्रुवो नभन्वो३ न वक्वा ध्वस्रा अपिन्वद् युवतीर्ऋतज्ञाः ।
धन्वान्यज्राँ अपृणक् तृषाणाँ अधोगिन्द्रः स्तर्यो३ दंसुपत्नीः॥
verses.tr: prāgruvo nabhanvo3 na vakvā dhvasrā apinvad yuvatīrṛtajñāḥ dhanvānyajrāṃ apṛṇak tṛṣāṇāṃ adhogindraḥ staryo3 daṃsupatnīḥ
verses.en: He let the young Maids skilled in Law, unwedded, like fountains, bubbling, flow forth streaming onward. He inundated thirsty plains and deserts, and milked the dry Cows of the mighty master.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीरुषसः शरदश्च गूर्ता वृत्रं जघन्वाँ असृजद् वि सिन्धून् ।
परिष्ठिता अतृणद् बद्बधानाः सीरा इन्द्रः स्रवितवे पृथिव्या॥
verses.tr: pūrvīruṣasaḥ śaradaśca gūrtā vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ asṛjad vi sindhūn pariṣṭhitā atṛṇad badbadhānāḥ sīrā indraḥ sravitave pṛthivyā
verses.en: Through many a morn and many a lovely autumn, having slain Vrtra, lie set free the rivers. Indra hath set at liberty to wander on earth the streams encompassed pressed together.

verses.sa:
वम्रीभिः पुत्रमग्रुवो अदानं निवेशनाद्धरिव आ जभर्थ ।
व्य१न्धो अख्यदहिमाददानो निर्भूदुखच्छित्समरन्त पर्व॥
verses.tr: vamrībhiḥ putramagruvo adānaṃ niveśanāddhariva ā jabhartha vya1ndho akhyadahimādadāno nirbhūdukhacchitsamaranta parva
verses.en: Lord of Bay Steeds, thou broughtest from the ant-hill the unwedded damsel's son whom ants were eating. The blind saw clearly, as he grasped the serpent, rose, brake the jar: his joints again united.

verses.sa:
प्र ते पूर्वाणि करणानि विप्राऽऽविद्वाँ आह विदुषे करांसि ।
यथायथा वृष्ण्यानि स्वगूर्ता ऽपांसि राजन् नर्याविवेषीः॥
verses.tr: pra te pūrvāṇi karaṇāni viprā''vidvāṃ āha viduṣe karāṃsi yathāyathā vṛṣṇyāni svagūrtā 'pāṃsi rājan naryāviveṣīḥ
verses.en: To the wise man, O Sage and Sovran Ruler, the man who knoweth all thine ancient exploits. Hath told these deeds of might as thou hast wrought them, great acts, spontaneous, and to man's advantage.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो३ न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः॥
verses.tr: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo3 na pīpeḥ akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
verses.en: Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let powers swell high, like rivers, for the singer. For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays! is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
आ न इन्द्रो दूरादा न आसादभिष्टिकृदवसे यासदुग्रः ।
ओजिष्ठेभिर्नृपतिर्वज्रबाहुः संगे समत्सु तुर्वणिः पृतन्यून्॥
verses.tr: ā na indro dūrādā na āsādabhiṣṭikṛdavase yāsadugraḥ ojiṣṭhebhirnṛpatirvajrabāhuḥ saṃge samatsu turvaṇiḥ pṛtanyūn
verses.en: From near or far away may mighty Indra giver of succour, come for our protection Lord of men, armed with thunder, with the Strongest, slaying his foes in conflict, in the battles.

verses.sa:
आ न इन्द्रो हरिभिर्यात्वच्छाऽर्वाचीनोऽवसे राधसे च ।
तिष्ठाति वज्री मघवा विरप्शीमं यज्ञमनु नो वाजसातौ॥
verses.tr: ā na indro haribhiryātvacchā'rvācīno'vase rādhase ca tiṣṭhāti vajrī maghavā virapśīmaṃ yajñamanu no vājasātau
verses.en: May Indra come to us with Tawny Coursers, inclined to us, to favour and enrich us. May Maghavan, loud-voiced and wielding thunder, stand by us at this sacrifice, in combat.

verses.sa:
इमं यज्ञं त्वमस्माकमिन्द्र पुरो दधत् सनिष्यसि क्रतुं नः ।
श्वघ्नीव वज्रिन् त्सनये धनानां त्वया वयमर्य आजिं जयेम॥
verses.tr: imaṃ yajñaṃ tvamasmākamindra puro dadhat saniṣyasi kratuṃ naḥ śvaghnīva vajrin tsanaye dhanānāṃ tvayā vayamarya ājiṃ jayema
verses.en: Thou, honouring this our sacrifice, O Indra, shalt give us strength and fill us full of courage. To win the booty, Thunder-armed! like hunters may we with thee subdue in fight our foemen.

verses.sa:
उशन्नु षु णः सुमना उपाके सोमस्य नु सुषुतस्य स्वधावः ।
पा इन्द्र प्रतिभृतस्य मध्वः समन्धसा ममदः पृष्ठ्येन॥
verses.tr: uśannu ṣu ṇaḥ sumanā upāke somasya nu suṣutasya svadhāvaḥ pā indra pratibhṛtasya madhvaḥ samandhasā mamadaḥ pṛṣṭhyena
verses.en: Loving us well, benevolent, close beside us, drink, Godlike Indra, of the well pressed Soma. Drink of the meath we offer, and delight thee with food that cometh from the mountain ridges.

verses.sa:
वि यो ररप्श ऋषिभिर्नवेभिर्वृक्षो न पक्वः सृण्यो न जेता ।
मर्यो न योषामभि मन्यमानोऽच्छा विवक्मि पुरुहूतमिन्द्रम्॥
verses.tr: vi yo rarapśa ṛṣibhirnavebhirvṛkṣo na pakvaḥ sṛṇyo na jetā maryo na yoṣāmabhi manyamāno'cchā vivakmi puruhūtamindram
verses.en: Him who is sung aloud by recent sages, like a ripe-fruited tree, a scythe-armed victor,- I, like a bridegroom thinking of his consort, call hither Indra, him invoked of many;

verses.sa:
गिरिर्न यः स्वतवाँ ऋष्व इन्द्रः सनादेव सहसे जात उग्रः ।
आदर्ता वज्रं स्थविरं न भीम उद्नेव कोशं वसुना न्यृष्टम्॥
verses.tr: girirna yaḥ svatavāṃ ṛṣva indraḥ sanādeva sahase jāta ugraḥ ādartā vajraṃ sthaviraṃ na bhīma udneva kośaṃ vasunā nyṛṣṭam
verses.en: Him who in native strength is like a mountain, the lofty Indra born or old for conquest, Terrific wielder of the ancient thunder. filled full with splendour as a jar with water.

verses.sa:
न यस्य वर्ता जनुषा न्वस्ति न राधस आमरीता मघस्य ।
उद्वावृषाणस्तविषीव उग्रास्मभ्यं दद्धि पुरुहूत रायः॥
verses.tr: na yasya vartā januṣā nvasti na rādhasa āmarītā maghasya udvāvṛṣāṇastaviṣīva ugrāsmabhyaṃ daddhi puruhūta rāyaḥ
verses.en: Whom from of old there is not one to hinder, none to curtail the riches of his bounty. Pouring forth freely, O thou Strong and Mighty, vouchsafe us riches, God invoked of many!

verses.sa:
ईक्षे रायः क्षयस्य चर्षणीनामुत व्रजमपवर्तासि गोनाम् ।
शिक्षानरः समिथेषु प्रहावान् वस्वो राशिमभिनेतासि भूरिम्॥
verses.tr: īkṣe rāyaḥ kṣayasya carṣaṇīnāmuta vrajamapavartāsi gonām śikṣānaraḥ samitheṣu prahāvān vasvo rāśimabhinetāsi bhūrim
verses.en: Of wealth and homes of men thou art the ruler, and opener of the stable of the cattle. Helper of men, winner of spoil in combats, thou leadest to an ample heap of riches.

verses.sa:
कया तच्छृण्वे शच्या शचिष्ठो यया कृणोति मुहु का चिदृष्वः ।
पुरु दाशुषे विचयिष्ठो अंहोऽथा दधाति द्रविणं जरित्रे॥
verses.tr: kayā tacchṛṇve śacyā śaciṣṭho yayā kṛṇoti muhu kā cidṛṣvaḥ puru dāśuṣe vicayiṣṭho aṃho'thā dadhāti draviṇaṃ jaritre
verses.en: By what great might is he renowned as strongest, wherewith the Lofty One stirs up wild battles? Best soother of the worshipper's great sorrow, he gives possessions to the man who lauds him.

verses.sa:
मा नो मर्धीरा भरा दद्धि तन्नः प्र दाशुषे दातवे भूरि यत्ते ।
नव्ये देष्णे शस्ते अस्मिन् त उक्थे प्र ब्रवाम वयमिन्द्र स्तुवन्तः॥
verses.tr: mā no mardhīrā bharā daddhi tannaḥ pra dāśuṣe dātave bhūri yatte navye deṣṇe śaste asmin ta ukthe pra bravāma vayamindra stuvantaḥ
verses.en: Slay us not; bring, bestow onus the ample gift which thou hast to give to him who offers. At this new gift, with this laud sung before thee, extolling thee, we, Indra, will declare it.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो३ न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः॥
verses.tr: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo3 na pīpeḥ akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
verses.en: Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let power swell high, like rivers, for the singer. A new hymn, Lord of Bays! for thee is fashioned. May we, car-born, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
आ यात्विन्द्रोऽवस उप न इह स्तुतः सधमादस्तु शूरः ।
वावृधानस्तविषीर्यस्य पूर्वीर्द्यौर्न क्षत्रमभिभूति पुष्यात्॥
verses.tr: ā yātvindro'vasa upa na iha stutaḥ sadhamādastu śūraḥ vāvṛdhānastaviṣīryasya pūrvīrdyaurna kṣatramabhibhūti puṣyāt
verses.en: May Indra come to us for our protection; here be the Hero, praised, our feast-companion. May he whose powers are many, waxen mighty, cherish, like Dyaus, his own supreme dominion.

verses.sa:
तस्येदिह स्तवथ वृष्ण्यानि तुविद्युम्नस्य तुविराधसो नॄन् ।
यस्य क्रतुर्विदथ्यो३ न सम्राट् साह्वान्तरुत्रो अभ्यस्ति कृष्टीः॥
verses.tr: tasyediha stavatha vṛṣṇyāni tuvidyumnasya tuvirādhaso nṝn yasya kraturvidathyo3 na samrāṭ sāhvāntarutro abhyasti kṛṣṭīḥ
verses.en: Here magnify his great heroic exploits, most glorious One, enriching men with bounties, Whose will is like a Sovran in assembly, who rules the people, Conqueror, all-surpassing.

verses.sa:
आ यात्विन्द्रो दिव आ पृथिव्या मक्षू समुद्रादुत वा पुरीषात् ।
स्वर्णरादवसे नो मरुत्वान् परावतो वा सदनादृतस्य॥
verses.tr: ā yātvindro diva ā pṛthivyā makṣū samudrāduta vā purīṣāt svarṇarādavase no marutvān parāvato vā sadanādṛtasya
verses.en: Hither let Indra come from earth or heaven, hither with speech from firmament or ocean; With Maruts, from the realm of light to aid us, or from a distance, from the seat of Order.

verses.sa:
स्थूरस्य रायो बृहतो य ईशे तमु ष्टवाम विदथेष्विन्द्रम् ।
यो वायुना जयति गोमतीषु प्र धृष्णुया नयति वस्यो अच्छ॥
verses.tr: sthūrasya rāyo bṛhato ya īśe tamu ṣṭavāma vidatheṣvindram yo vāyunā jayati gomatīṣu pra dhṛṣṇuyā nayati vasyo accha
verses.en: That Indra will we laud in our assemblies, him who is Lord of great and lasting riches, Victor with Vayu where the herds are gathered, who leads with boldness on to higher fortune.

verses.sa:
उप यो नमो नमसि स्तभायन्नियर्ति वाचं जनयन् यजध्यै ।
ऋञ्जसानः पुरुवार उक्थैरेन्द्रं कृण्वीत सदनेषु होता॥
verses.tr: upa yo namo namasi stabhāyanniyarti vācaṃ janayan yajadhyai ṛñjasānaḥ puruvāra ukthairendraṃ kṛṇvīta sadaneṣu hotā
verses.en: May the Priest, Lord of many blessings, striving,-who fixing reverence on reverence, giving Vent to his voice, inciteth men to worship with lauds bring Indra hither to our dwellings.

verses.sa:
धिषा यदि धिषण्यन्तः सरण्यान् त्सदन्तो अद्रिमौशिजस्य गोहे ।
आ दुरोषाः पास्त्यस्य होता यो नो महान् त्संवरणेषु वह्निः॥
verses.tr: dhiṣā yadi dhiṣaṇyantaḥ saraṇyān tsadanto adrimauśijasya gohe ā duroṣāḥ pāstyasya hotā yo no mahān tsaṃvaraṇeṣu vahniḥ
verses.en: When sitting pondering in deep devotion in Ausija's abode they ply the press-stone, May he whose wrath is fierce, the mighty bearer, come as the house-lord's priest within our chambers.

verses.sa:
सत्रा यदीं भार्वरस्य वृष्णः सिषक्ति शुष्मः स्तुवते भराय ।
गुहा यदीमौशिजस्य गोहे प्र यद् धिये प्रायसे मदाय॥
verses.tr: satrā yadīṃ bhārvarasya vṛṣṇaḥ siṣakti śuṣmaḥ stuvate bharāya guhā yadīmauśijasya gohe pra yad dhiye prāyase madāya
verses.en: Surely the power of Bharvara the mighty for ever helpeth to support the singer; That which in Ausija's abode lies hidden, to come forth for delight and for devotion.

verses.sa:
वि यद् वरांसि पर्वतस्य वृण्वे पयोभिर्जिन्वे अपां जवांसि ।
विदद् गौरस्य गवयस्य गोहे यदी वाजाय सुध्यो३ वहन्ति॥
verses.tr: vi yad varāṃsi parvatasya vṛṇve payobhirjinve apāṃ javāṃsi vidad gaurasya gavayasya gohe yadī vājāya sudhyo3 vahanti
verses.en: When he unbars the spaces of the mountains, and quickens with his floods the water-torrents, He finds in lair the buffalo and wild-ox when the wise lead him on to vigorous exploit.

verses.sa:
भद्रा ते हस्ता सुकृतोत पाणी प्रयन्तारा स्तुवते राध इन्द्र ।
का ते निषत्तिः किमु नो ममत्सि किं नोदुदु हर्षसे दातवा उ॥
verses.tr: bhadrā te hastā sukṛtota pāṇī prayantārā stuvate rādha indra kā te niṣattiḥ kimu no mamatsi kiṃ nodudu harṣase dātavā u
verses.en: Auspicious are thy hands, thine arms well fashioned which proffer bounty, Indra, to thy praiser. What sloth is this? Why dost thou not rejoice thee? Why dost thou not delight thyself with giving?

verses.sa:
एवा वस्व इन्द्रः सत्यः सम्राड्ढन्ता वृत्रं वरिवः पूरवे कः ।
पुरुष्टुत क्रत्वा नः शग्धि रायो भक्षीय तेऽवसो दैव्यस्य॥
verses.tr: evā vasva indraḥ satyaḥ samrāḍḍhantā vṛtraṃ varivaḥ pūrave kaḥ puruṣṭuta kratvā naḥ śagdhi rāyo bhakṣīya te'vaso daivyasya
verses.en: So Indra is the truthful Lord of treasure. Freedom he gave to man by slaying Vrtra. Much-lauded! help us with thy power to riches: may I be sharer of thy Godlike favour.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो३ न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः॥
verses.tr: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo3 na pīpeḥ akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
verses.en: Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let power swell high, like rivers, for,the singer. For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays! is fashioned. May we, care-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
यन्न इन्द्रो जुजुषे यच्च वष्टि तन्नो महान् करति शुष्म्या चित् ।
ब्रह्म स्तोमं मघवा सोममुक्था यो अश्मानं शवसा बिभ्रदेति॥
verses.tr: yanna indro jujuṣe yacca vaṣṭi tanno mahān karati śuṣmyā cit brahma stomaṃ maghavā somamukthā yo aśmānaṃ śavasā bibhradeti
verses.en: That gift of ours which Indra loves and welcomes, even that he makes for us, the Great and Strong One. He who comes wielding in his might the thunder, Maghavan, gives prayer, praise, and laud, and Soma.

verses.sa:
वृषा वृषन्धिं चतुरश्रिमस्यन्नुग्रो बाहुभ्यां नृतमः शचीवान् ।
श्रिये परुष्णीमुषमाण ऊर्णां यस्याः पर्वाणि सख्याय विव्ये॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā vṛṣandhiṃ caturaśrimasyannugro bāhubhyāṃ nṛtamaḥ śacīvān śriye paruṣṇīmuṣamāṇa ūrṇāṃ yasyāḥ parvāṇi sakhyāya vivye
verses.en: Bull, hurler of the four-edged rain-producer with both his arms, strong, mighty, most heroic; Wearing as wool Parusni for adornment, whose joints for sake of friendship he hath covered.

verses.sa:
यो देवो देवतमो जायमानो महो वाजेभिर्महद्भिश्च शुष्मैः ।
दधानो वज्रं बाह्वोरुशन्तं द्याममेन रेजयत् प्र भूम॥
verses.tr: yo devo devatamo jāyamāno maho vājebhirmahadbhiśca śuṣmaiḥ dadhāno vajraṃ bāhvoruśantaṃ dyāmamena rejayat pra bhūma
verses.en: God who of all the Gods was born divinest, endowed with ample strength and mighty powers, And bearing in his arms the yearning thunder, with violent rush caused heaven and earth to tremble.

verses.sa:
विश्वा रोधांसि प्रवतश्च पूर्वीर्द्यौर्ऋष्वाज्जनिमन् रेजत क्षाः ।
आ मातरा भरति शुष्म्या गोर्नृवत् परिज्मन् नोनुवन्त वाताः॥
verses.tr: viśvā rodhāṃsi pravataśca pūrvīrdyaurṛṣvājjaniman rejata kṣāḥ ā mātarā bharati śuṣmyā gornṛvat parijman nonuvanta vātāḥ
verses.en: Before the High God, at his birth, heaven trembled, earth, many floods and all the precipices. The Strong One bringeth nigh the Bull's two Parents: loud sing the winds, like men, in air's mid-region.

verses.sa:
ता तू त इन्द्र महतो महानि विश्वेष्वित् सवनेषु प्रवाच्या ।
यच्छूर धृष्णो धृषता दधृष्वानहिं वज्रेण शवसाविवेषीः॥
verses.tr: tā tū ta indra mahato mahāni viśveṣvit savaneṣu pravācyā yacchūra dhṛṣṇo dhṛṣatā dadhṛṣvānahiṃ vajreṇa śavasāviveṣīḥ
verses.en: These are thy great deeds, Indra, thine, the Mighty, deeds to be told aloud at all libations, That thou, O Hero, bold and boldly daring, didst with thy bolt, by strength, destroy the Dragon.

verses.sa:
ता तू ते सत्या तुविनृम्ण विश्वा प्र धेनवः सिस्रते वृष्ण ऊध्नः ।
अधा ह त्वद् वृषमणो भियानाः प्र सिन्धवो जवसा चक्रमन्त॥
verses.tr: tā tū te satyā tuvinṛmṇa viśvā pra dhenavaḥ sisrate vṛṣṇa ūdhnaḥ adhā ha tvad vṛṣamaṇo bhiyānāḥ pra sindhavo javasā cakramanta
verses.en: True are all these thy deeds, O Most Heroic. The Milch-kine issued from the streaming udder. In fear of thee, O thou of manly spirit, the rivers swiftly set themselves in motion.

verses.sa:
अत्राह ते हरिवस्ता उ देवीरवोभिरिन्द्र स्तवन्त स्वसारः ।
यत् सीमनु प्र मुचो बद्बधाना दीर्घामनु प्रसितिं स्यन्दयध्यै॥
verses.tr: atrāha te harivastā u devīravobhirindra stavanta svasāraḥ yat sīmanu pra muco badbadhānā dīrghāmanu prasitiṃ syandayadhyai
verses.en: With joy, O Indra, Lord of Tawny Coursers, the Sisters then, these Goddesses, extolled thee, When thou didst give the prisoned ones their freedom to wander at their will in long succession.

verses.sa:
पिपीळे अंशुर्मद्यो न सिन्धुरा त्वा शमी शशमानस्य शक्तिः ।
अस्मद्र्यक् शुशुचानस्य यम्या आशुर्न रश्मिं तुव्योजसं गोः॥
verses.tr: pipīḻe aṃśurmadyo na sindhurā tvā śamī śaśamānasya śaktiḥ asmadryak śuśucānasya yamyā āśurna raśmiṃ tuvyojasaṃ goḥ
verses.en: Pressed is the gladdening stalk as 'twere a river: so let the rite, the toiler's power, attract thee To us-ward, of the Bright One, as the courser strains his. exceedingly strong leather bridle.

verses.sa:
अस्मे वर्षिष्ठा कृणुहि ज्येष्ठा नृम्णानि सत्रा सहुरे सहांसि ।
अस्मभ्यं वृत्रा सुहनानि रन्धि जहि वधर्वनुषो मर्त्यस्य॥
verses.tr: asme varṣiṣṭhā kṛṇuhi jyeṣṭhā nṛmṇāni satrā sahure sahāṃsi asmabhyaṃ vṛtrā suhanāni randhi jahi vadharvanuṣo martyasya
verses.en: Ever by us perform thy most heroic, thine highest, best victorious deeds, O Victor. For us make Vrtras easy to be conquered: destroy the weapon of our mortal foeman.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमित् सु शृणुहि त्वमिन्द्राऽस्मभ्यं चित्राँ उप माहि वाजान् ।
अस्मभ्यं विश्वा इषणः पुरंधीरस्माकं सु मघवन् बोधि गोदाः॥
verses.tr: asmākamit su śṛṇuhi tvamindrā'smabhyaṃ citrāṃ upa māhi vājān asmabhyaṃ viśvā iṣaṇaḥ puraṃdhīrasmākaṃ su maghavan bodhi godāḥ
verses.en: Graciously listen to our prayer, O Indra, and strength of varied sort bestow thou on us. Send to us all intelligence arid wisdom O Maghavan, be he who gives us cattle.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो३ न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः॥
verses.tr: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo3 na pīpeḥ akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
verses.en: Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let wealth swell high like rivers to the singer. For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays, is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
कथा महामवृधत् कस्य होतुर्यज्ञं जुषाणो अभि सोममूधः ।
पिबन्नुशानो जुषमाणो अन्धो ववक्ष ऋष्वः शुचते धनाय॥
verses.tr: kathā mahāmavṛdhat kasya hoturyajñaṃ juṣāṇo abhi somamūdhaḥ pibannuśāno juṣamāṇo andho vavakṣa ṛṣvaḥ śucate dhanāya
verses.en: How, what priest's sacrifice hath he made mighty, rejoicing in the Soma and its fountain? Delighting in juice, eagerly drinking, the Lofty One hath waxed for splendid riches.

verses.sa:
को अस्य वीरः सधमादमाप समानंश सुमतिभिः को अस्य ।
कदस्य चित्रं चिकिते कदूती वृधे भुवच्छशमानस्य यज्योः॥
verses.tr: ko asya vīraḥ sadhamādamāpa samānaṃśa sumatibhiḥ ko asya kadasya citraṃ cikite kadūtī vṛdhe bhuvacchaśamānasya yajyoḥ
verses.en: What hero hath been made his feast-companion? Who hath been partner in his loving-kindness? What know we of his wondrous acts? How often comes he to aid and speed the pious toiler?

verses.sa:
कथा शृणोति हूयमानमिन्द्रः कथा शृण्वन्नवसामस्य वेद ।
का अस्य पूर्वीरुपमातयो ह कथैनमाहुः पपुरिं जरित्रे॥
verses.tr: kathā śṛṇoti hūyamānamindraḥ kathā śṛṇvannavasāmasya veda kā asya pūrvīrupamātayo ha kathainamāhuḥ papuriṃ jaritre
verses.en: How heareth Indra offered invocation? How, hearing, marketh he the invoker's wishes? What are his ancient acts of bounty? Wherefore call they him One who filleth full the singer?

verses.sa:
कथा सबाधः शशमानो अस्य नशदभि द्रविणं दीध्यानः ।
देवो भुवन्नवेदा म ऋतानां नमो जगृभ्वाँ अभि यज्जुजोषत्॥
verses.tr: kathā sabādhaḥ śaśamāno asya naśadabhi draviṇaṃ dīdhyānaḥ devo bhuvannavedā ma ṛtānāṃ namo jagṛbhvāṃ abhi yajjujoṣat
verses.en: How doth the priest who laboureth, ever longing, win for himself the wealth which he possesseth? May he, the God, mark well my truthful praises, having received the homage which he loveth.

verses.sa:
कथा कदस्या उषसो व्युष्टौ देवो मर्तस्य सख्यं जुजोष ।
कथा कदस्य सख्यं सखिभ्यो ये अस्मिन् कामं सुयुजं ततस्रे॥
verses.tr: kathā kadasyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau devo martasya sakhyaṃ jujoṣa kathā kadasya sakhyaṃ sakhibhyo ye asmin kāmaṃ suyujaṃ tatasre
verses.en: How, and what bond of friendship with a mortal hath the God chosen as this morn is breaking? How, and what love hath he for those who love him, who have entwined in him their firm affection?

verses.sa:
किमादमत्रं सख्यं सखिभ्यः कदा नु ते भ्रात्रं प्र ब्रवाम ।
श्रिये सुदृशो वपुरस्य सर्गाः स्व१र्ण चित्रतममिष आ गोः॥
verses.tr: kimādamatraṃ sakhyaṃ sakhibhyaḥ kadā nu te bhrātraṃ pra bravāma śriye sudṛśo vapurasya sargāḥ sva1rṇa citratamamiṣa ā goḥ
verses.en: Is then thy friendship with thy friends most mighty? Thy brotherhood with us, -when may we tell it? The streams of milk move, as most wondrous sunlight, the beauty of the Lovely One for glory.

verses.sa:
द्रुहं जिघांसन् ध्वरसमनिन्द्रां तेतिक्ते तिग्मा तुजसे अनीका ।
ऋणा चिद् यत्र ऋणया न उग्रो दूरे अज्ञाता उषसो बबाधे॥
verses.tr: druhaṃ jighāṃsan dhvarasamanindrāṃ tetikte tigmā tujase anīkā ṛṇā cid yatra ṛṇayā na ugro dūre ajñātā uṣaso babādhe
verses.en: About to stay the Indra-less destructive spirit he sharpens his keen arms to strike her. Whereby the Strong, although our debts' exactor, drives in the distant mornings that we know not.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य हि शुरुधः सन्ति पूर्वीर्ऋतस्य धीतिर्वृजिनानि हन्ति ।
ऋतस्य श्लोको बधिरा ततर्द कर्णा बुधानः शुचमान आयोः॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya hi śurudhaḥ santi pūrvīrṛtasya dhītirvṛjināni hanti ṛtasya śloko badhirā tatarda karṇā budhānaḥ śucamāna āyoḥ
verses.en: Eternal Law hath varied food that strengthens; thought of eternal Law, removes transgressions. The praise-hymn of eternal Law, arousing, glowing, hath opened the deaf ears of the living.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य दृळहा धरुणानि सन्ति पुरूणि चन्द्रा वपुषे वपूंषि ।
ऋतेन दीर्घमिषणन्त पृक्ष ऋतेन गाव ऋतमा विवेशुः॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya dṛḻahā dharuṇāni santi purūṇi candrā vapuṣe vapūṃṣi ṛtena dīrghamiṣaṇanta pṛkṣa ṛtena gāva ṛtamā viveśuḥ
verses.en: Firm-seated are eternal Law's foundations in its fair form are many splendid beauties. By holy Law long lasting food they bring us; by holy Law have cows come to our worship.

verses.sa:
ऋतं येमान ऋतमिद् वनोत्यृतस्य शुष्मस्तुरया उ गव्युः ।
ऋताय पृथ्वी बहुले गभीरे ऋताय धेनू परमे दुहाते॥
verses.tr: ṛtaṃ yemāna ṛtamid vanotyṛtasya śuṣmasturayā u gavyuḥ ṛtāya pṛthvī bahule gabhīre ṛtāya dhenū parame duhāte
verses.en: Fixing eternal Law he, too, upholds it swift moves the might of Law and wins the booty. To Law belong the vast deep Earth and Heaven: Milch-kine supreme, to Law their milk they render.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो३ न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः॥
verses.tr: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo3 na pīpeḥ akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
verses.en: Now, Indra! lauded,- glorified with praises, let power swell high like rivers to the singer. For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays, is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
का सुष्टुतिः शवसः सूनुमिन्द्रमर्वाचीनं राधस आ ववर्तत् ।
ददिर्हि वीरो गृणते वसूनि स गोपतिर्निष्षिधां नो जनासः॥
verses.tr: kā suṣṭutiḥ śavasaḥ sūnumindramarvācīnaṃ rādhasa ā vavartat dadirhi vīro gṛṇate vasūni sa gopatirniṣṣidhāṃ no janāsaḥ
verses.en: What worthy praise will bring before us Indra, the Son of Strength, that he may grant us riches; For he the Hero, gives the singer treasures: he is the Lord who sends us gifts, ye people.

verses.sa:
स वृत्रहत्ये हव्यः स ईड्यः स सुष्टुत इन्द्रः सत्यराधाः ।
स यामन्ना मघवा मर्त्याय ब्रह्मण्यते सुष्वये वरिवो धात्॥
verses.tr: sa vṛtrahatye havyaḥ sa īḍyaḥ sa suṣṭuta indraḥ satyarādhāḥ sa yāmannā maghavā martyāya brahmaṇyate suṣvaye varivo dhāt
verses.en: To be invoked and hymned in fight with Vrtra, that well-praised Indra gives us real bounties. That Maghavan brings comfort in the foray to the religious man who pours libations.

verses.sa:
तमिन्नरो वि ह्वयन्ते समीके रिरिक्वांसस्तन्वः कृण्वत त्राम् ।
मिथो यत् त्यागमुभयासो अग्मन् नरस्तोकस्य तनयस्य सातौ॥
verses.tr: taminnaro vi hvayante samīke ririkvāṃsastanvaḥ kṛṇvata trām mitho yat tyāgamubhayāso agman narastokasya tanayasya sātau
verses.en: Him, verily, the men invoke in combat; risking their lives they make him their protector, When heroes, foe to foe, give up their bodies, fighting, each side, for children and their offspring.

verses.sa:
क्रतूयन्ति क्षितयो योग उग्राऽऽशुषाणासो मिथो अर्णसातौ ।
सं यद् विशोऽववृत्रन्त युध्मा आदिन्नेम इन्द्रयन्ते अभीके॥
verses.tr: kratūyanti kṣitayo yoga ugrā''śuṣāṇāso mitho arṇasātau saṃ yad viśo'vavṛtranta yudhmā ādinnema indrayante abhīke
verses.en: Strong God! the folk at need put forth their vigour, striving together in the whirl of battle. When warrior bands encounter one another some in the grapple quit themselves like Indra.

verses.sa:
आदिद्ध नेम इन्द्रियं यजन्त आदित् पक्तिः पुरोळाशं रिरिच्यात् ।
आदित् सोमो वि पपृच्यादसुष्वीनादिज्जुजोष वृषभं यजध्यै॥
verses.tr: ādiddha nema indriyaṃ yajanta ādit paktiḥ puroḻāśaṃ riricyāt ādit somo vi papṛcyādasuṣvīnādijjujoṣa vṛṣabhaṃ yajadhyai
verses.en: Hence many a one worships the might of Indra: hence let the brew succeed the meal-oblation. Hence let the Soma banish those who pour not: even hence I joy to pay the Strong One worship.

verses.sa:
कृणोत्यस्मै वरिवो य इत्थेन्द्राय सोममुशते सुनोति ।
सध्रीचीनेन मनसाविवेनन् तमित् सखायं कृणुते समत्सु॥
verses.tr: kṛṇotyasmai varivo ya itthendrāya somamuśate sunoti sadhrīcīnena manasāvivenan tamit sakhāyaṃ kṛṇute samatsu
verses.en: Indra gives comfort to the man who truly presses, for him who longs for it, the Soma, Not disaffected, with devoted spirit this man he takes to be his friend in battles.

verses.sa:
य इन्द्राय सुनवत् सोममद्य पचात् पक्तीरुत भृज्जाति धानाः ।
प्रति मनायोरुचथानि हर्यन् तस्मिन् दधद् वृषणं शुष्ममिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: ya indrāya sunavat somamadya pacāt paktīruta bhṛjjāti dhānāḥ prati manāyorucathāni haryan tasmin dadhad vṛṣaṇaṃ śuṣmamindraḥ
verses.en: He who this day for Indra presses Soma, prepares the brew and fries the grains of barley- Loving the hymns of that devoted servant, to him may Indra give heroic vigour.

verses.sa:
यदा समर्यं व्यचेदृघावा दीर्घं यदाजिमभ्यख्यदर्यः ।
अचिक्रदद् वृषणं पत्न्यच्छा दुरोण आ निशितं सोमसुद्भिः॥
verses.tr: yadā samaryaṃ vyacedṛghāvā dīrghaṃ yadājimabhyakhyadaryaḥ acikradad vṛṣaṇaṃ patnyacchā duroṇa ā niśitaṃ somasudbhiḥ
verses.en: When the impetuous chief hath sought the conflict, and the lord looked upon the long-drawn battle, The matron calls to the Strong God whom pressers of Soma have encouraged into the dwelling.

verses.sa:
भूयसा वस्नमचरत् कनीयोऽविक्रीतो अकानिषं पुनर्यन् ।
स भूयसा कनीयो नारिरेचीद् दीना दक्षा वि दुहन्ति प्र वाणम्॥
verses.tr: bhūyasā vasnamacarat kanīyo'vikrīto akāniṣaṃ punaryan sa bhūyasā kanīyo nārirecīd dīnā dakṣā vi duhanti pra vāṇam
verses.en: He bid a small price for a thing of value: I was content, returning, still unpurchased. He heightened not his insufficient offer. Simple and clever, both milk out the udder.

verses.sa:
क इमं दशभिर्ममेन्द्रं क्रीणाति धेनुभिः ।
यदा वृत्राणि जङ्घनदथैनं मे पुनर्ददत्॥
verses.tr: ka imaṃ daśabhirmamendraṃ krīṇāti dhenubhiḥ yadā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanadathainaṃ me punardadat
verses.en: Who for ten milch-kine purchaseth from me this Indra who is mine? When he hath slain the Vrtras let the buyer give him back to me.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो३ न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः॥
verses.tr: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo3 na pīpeḥ akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
verses.en: Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let wealth swell high like rivers for the singer. For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays, is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
को अद्य नर्यो देवकाम उशन्निन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुजोष ।
को वा महेऽवसे पार्याय समिद्धे अग्नौ सुतसोम ईट्टे॥
verses.tr: ko adya naryo devakāma uśannindrasya sakhyaṃ jujoṣa ko vā mahe'vase pāryāya samiddhe agnau sutasoma īṭṭe
verses.en: What friend of man, God-loving, hath delighted, yearning therefor, this day in Indra's friendship? Who with enkindled flame and flowing Soma laudeth him for his great protecting favour?

verses.sa:
को नानाम वचसा सोम्याय मनायुर्वा भवति वस्त उस्राः ।
क इन्द्रस्य युज्यं कः सखित्वं को भ्रात्रं वष्टि कवये क ऊती॥
verses.tr: ko nānāma vacasā somyāya manāyurvā bhavati vasta usrāḥ ka indrasya yujyaṃ kaḥ sakhitvaṃ ko bhrātraṃ vaṣṭi kavaye ka ūtī
verses.en: Who hath with prayer bowed to the Soma-lover? What pious man endues the beams of morning? Who seeks bond, friendship, brotherhood with Indra? Who hath recourse unto the Sage for succour?

verses.sa:
को देवानामवो अद्या वृणीते क आदित्याँ अदितिं ज्योतिरीट्टे ।
कस्याश्विनाविन्द्रो अग्निः सुतस्यांऽशोः पिबन्ति मनसाविवेनम्॥
verses.tr: ko devānāmavo adyā vṛṇīte ka ādityāṃ aditiṃ jyotirīṭṭe kasyāśvināvindro agniḥ sutasyāṃ'śoḥ pibanti manasāvivenam
verses.en: Who claims to-day the Deities' protection, asks Aditi for light, or the Adityas? Of whose pressed stalk of Soma drink the Asvins, Indra, and Agni, well-inclined in spirit?

verses.sa:
तस्मा अग्निर्भारतः शर्म यंसज्ज्योक् पश्यात् सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् ।
य इन्द्राय सुनवामेत्याह नरे नर्याय नृतमाय नृणाम्॥
verses.tr: tasmā agnirbhārataḥ śarma yaṃsajjyok paśyāt sūryamuccarantam ya indrāya sunavāmetyāha nare naryāya nṛtamāya nṛṇām
verses.en: To him shall Agni Bharata give shelter: long shall he look upon the Sun up-rising, Who sayeth, Let us press the juice for Indra, man's Friend, the Hero manliest of heroes.

verses.sa:
न तं जिनन्ति बहवो न दभ्रा उर्वस्मा अदितिः शर्म यंसत् ।
प्रियः सुकृत् प्रिय इन्द्रे मनायुः प्रियः सुप्रावीः प्रियो अस्य सोमी॥
verses.tr: na taṃ jinanti bahavo na dabhrā urvasmā aditiḥ śarma yaṃsat priyaḥ sukṛt priya indre manāyuḥ priyaḥ suprāvīḥ priyo asya somī
verses.en: Him neither few men overcome, nor many to him shall Aditi give spacious shelter. Dear is the pious, the devout, to Indra dear is the zealous, dear the Soma-bringer.

verses.sa:
सुप्राव्यः प्राशुषाळेष वीरः सुष्वेः पक्तिं कृणुते केवलेन्द्रः ।
नासुष्वेरापिर्न सखा न जामिर्दुष्प्राव्योऽवहन्तेदवाचः॥
verses.tr: suprāvyaḥ prāśuṣāḻeṣa vīraḥ suṣveḥ paktiṃ kṛṇute kevalendraḥ nāsuṣverāpirna sakhā na jāmirduṣprāvyo'vahantedavācaḥ
verses.en: This Hero curbs the mighty for the zealous: the presser's brew Indra possesses solely: No brother, kin, or friend to him who pours not, destroyer of the dumb who would resist him.

verses.sa:
न रेवता पणिना सख्यमिन्द्रोऽसुन्वता सुतपाः सं गृणीते ।
आस्य वेदः खिदति हन्ति नग्नं वि सुष्वये पक्तये केवलो भूत्॥
verses.tr: na revatā paṇinā sakhyamindro'sunvatā sutapāḥ saṃ gṛṇīte āsya vedaḥ khidati hanti nagnaṃ vi suṣvaye paktaye kevalo bhūt
verses.en: Not with the wealthy churl who pours no Soma doth Indra, Soma-drinker, bind alliance. He draws away his wealth and slays him naked, own Friend to him who offers, for oblation.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं परेऽवरे मध्यमास इन्द्रं यान्तोऽवसितास इन्द्रम् ।
इन्द्रं क्षियन्त उत युध्यमाना इन्द्रं नरो वाजयन्तो हवन्ते॥
verses.tr: indraṃ pare'vare madhyamāsa indraṃ yānto'vasitāsa indram indraṃ kṣiyanta uta yudhyamānā indraṃ naro vājayanto havante
verses.en: Highest and lowest, men who stand between diem, going, returning, dwelling in contentment, Those who show forth their strength when urged to battle-these are the men who call for aid on Indra.

verses.sa:
अहं मनुरभवं सूर्यश्चाहं कक्षीवाँ ऋषिरस्मि विप्रः ।
अहं कुत्समार्जुनेयं न्यृञ्जेऽहं कविरुशना पश्यता मा॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ manurabhavaṃ sūryaścāhaṃ kakṣīvāṃ ṛṣirasmi vipraḥ ahaṃ kutsamārjuneyaṃ nyṛñje'haṃ kaviruśanā paśyatā mā
verses.en: I WAS aforetime Manu, I was Surya: I am the sage Kaksivan, holy singer. Kutsa the son of Arjuni I master. I am the sapient Usana behold me.

verses.sa:
अहं भूमिमददामार्यायाऽहं वृष्टिं दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
अहमपो अनयं वावशाना मम देवासो अनु केतमायन्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ bhūmimadadāmāryāyā'haṃ vṛṣṭiṃ dāśuṣe martyāya ahamapo anayaṃ vāvaśānā mama devāso anu ketamāyan
verses.en: I have bestowed the earth upon the Arya, and rain upon the man who brings oblation. I guided forth the loudly-roaring waters, and the Gods moved according to my pleasure.

verses.sa:
अहं पुरो मन्दसानो व्यैरं नव साकं नवतीः शम्बरस्य ।
शततमं वेश्यं सर्वताता दिवोदासमतिथिग्वं यदावम्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ puro mandasāno vyairaṃ nava sākaṃ navatīḥ śambarasya śatatamaṃ veśyaṃ sarvatātā divodāsamatithigvaṃ yadāvam
verses.en: In the wild joy of Soma I demolished Sambara's forts, ninety-and-nine, together; And, utterly, the hundredth habitation, when helping Divodasa Atithigva.

verses.sa:
प्र सु ष विभ्यो मरुतो विरस्तु प्र श्येनः श्येनेभ्य आशुपत्वा ।
अचक्रया यत् स्वधया सुपर्णो हव्यं भरन्मनवे देवजुष्टम्॥
verses.tr: pra su ṣa vibhyo maruto virastu pra śyenaḥ śyenebhya āśupatvā acakrayā yat svadhayā suparṇo havyaṃ bharanmanave devajuṣṭam
verses.en: Before all birds be ranked this Bird, O Maruts; supreme of falcons be this fleet-winged Falcon, Because, strong- pinioned, with no car to bear him, he brought to Manu the God loved oblation.

verses.sa:
भरद् यदि विरतो वेविजानः पथोरुणा मनोजवा असर्जि ।
तूयं ययौ मधुना सोम्येनोत श्रवो विविदे श्येनो अत्र॥
verses.tr: bharad yadi virato vevijānaḥ pathoruṇā manojavā asarji tūyaṃ yayau madhunā somyenota śravo vivide śyeno atra
verses.en: When the Bird brought it, hence in rapid motion sent on the wide path fleet as thought he hurried. Swift he returned with sweetness of the Soma, and hence the Falcon hath acquired his glory.

verses.sa:
ऋजीपी श्येनो ददमानो अंशुं परावतः शकुनो मन्द्रं मदम् ।
सोमं भरद् दादृहाणो देवावान् दिवो अमुष्मादुत्तरादादाय॥
verses.tr: ṛjīpī śyeno dadamāno aṃśuṃ parāvataḥ śakuno mandraṃ madam somaṃ bharad dādṛhāṇo devāvān divo amuṣmāduttarādādāya
verses.en: Bearing the stalk, the Falcon speeding onward, Bird bringing from afar the draught that gladdens, Friend of the Gods, brought, grasping fast, the Soma which be bad taken from yon loftiest heaven.

verses.sa:
आदाय श्येनो अभरत् सोमं सहस्रं सवाँ अयुतं च साकम् ।
अत्रा पुरंधिरजहादरातीर्मदे सोमस्य मूरा अमूरः॥
verses.tr: ādāya śyeno abharat somaṃ sahasraṃ savāṃ ayutaṃ ca sākam atrā puraṃdhirajahādarātīrmade somasya mūrā amūraḥ
verses.en: The Falcon took and brought the Soma, bearing thousand libations with him, yea, ten thousand. The Bold One left malignities behind him, wise, in wild joy of Soma, left the foolish.

verses.sa:
गर्भे नु सन्नन्वेषामवेदमहं देवानां जनिमानि विश्वा ।
शतं मा पुर आयसीररक्षन्नध श्येनो जवसा निरदीयम्॥
verses.tr: garbhe nu sannanveṣāmavedamahaṃ devānāṃ janimāni viśvā śataṃ mā pura āyasīrarakṣannadha śyeno javasā niradīyam
verses.en: I, As I lay within the womb, considered all generations of these Gods in order. A hundred iron fortresses confined me, but forth I flew with rapid speed a Falcon,

verses.sa:
न घा स मामप जोषं जभाराऽभीमास त्वक्षसा वीर्येण ।
ईर्मा पुरंधिरजहादरातीरुत वाताँ अतरच्छूशुवानः॥
verses.tr: na ghā sa māmapa joṣaṃ jabhārā'bhīmāsa tvakṣasā vīryeṇa īrmā puraṃdhirajahādarātīruta vātāṃ ataracchūśuvānaḥ
verses.en: Not at his own free pleasure did he bear me: he conquered with his strength and manly courage. Straightway the Bold One left the fiends behind him and passed the winds as he grew yet more mighty.

verses.sa:
अव यच्छ्येनो अस्वनीदध द्योर्वि यद् यदि वात ऊहुः पुरंधिम् ।
सृजद् यदस्मा अव ह क्षिपज्ज्यां कृशानुरस्ता मनसा भुरण्यन्॥
verses.tr: ava yacchyeno asvanīdadha dyorvi yad yadi vāta ūhuḥ puraṃdhim sṛjad yadasmā ava ha kṣipajjyāṃ kṛśānurastā manasā bhuraṇyan
verses.en: When with loud cry from heaven down sped the Falcon, thence hasting like the wind he bore the Bold One, Then, wildly raging in his mind, the archer Kṛiṣânu aimed and loosed the string to strike him.

verses.sa:
ऋजिप्य ईमिन्द्रावतो न भुज्युं श्येनो जभार बृहतो अधि ष्णोः ।
अन्तः पतत् पतत्र्यस्य पर्णमध यामनि प्रसितस्य तद् वेः॥
verses.tr: ṛjipya īmindrāvato na bhujyuṃ śyeno jabhāra bṛhato adhi ṣṇoḥ antaḥ patat patatryasya parṇamadha yāmani prasitasya tad veḥ
verses.en: The Falcon bore him from heaven's lofty summit as the swift car of Indra's Friend bore Bhujyu. Then downward hither fell a flying feather of the Bird hasting forward in his journey.

verses.sa:
अध श्वेतं कलशं गोभिरक्तमापिप्यानं मघवा शुक्रमन्धः ।
अध्वर्युभिः प्रयतं मध्वो अग्रमिन्द्रो मदाय प्रति धत् पिबध्यै शूरो मदाय प्रति धत् पिबध्यै॥
verses.tr: adha śvetaṃ kalaśaṃ gobhiraktamāpipyānaṃ maghavā śukramandhaḥ adhvaryubhiḥ prayataṃ madhvo agramindro madāya prati dhat pibadhyai śūro madāya prati dhat pibadhyai
verses.en: And now let Maghavan accept the beaker, white, filled with milk, filled with the shining liquid; The best of sweet meath which the priests have offered: that Indra to his joy may drink, the Hero, that he may take and drink it to his rapture. 1 The womb of the rain cloud. A hundred fortresses:cf 'Şambara's hundred ancient castles' (II, 14. 6.) Considered: or reviewed, in hope of finding a deliverer. The speaker is Agni, that is, the lightning which rends the cloud and brings down the sweet rain-the fleet Falcon who brings Soma from heaven. See Prof. Bloomfield, The Myth of Soma and the Eagle, Festgruss an Rudolf von Roth, 1893, pp 149-155. Of. Hymns of the Atharva-veda, VI. 48. 1. 2 Not at his own free pleasure: the falcon's mere will was not enough, says Soma; he had first to fight and conquer my keepers. The Bold One; Indra. See stanza 7 of the preceding hymn, 3 The Bold One: meaning Soma. The construction of the first line is difficult. Krisdnu: one of the guards of the celestial Soma. See I. 155 2 4 The allusion in the first line is to the rescue of Bhujyu, by the Asvins (see I. 112. 6), and we should therefore expect indravatoh, 'of Indra's two friends, instead of indravato. Feather: parnám, which became on earth the sacred Parpa or Palasa tree, the beautiful Butea Frondosa. 5 The metrical form and the ritual application indicate the comparatively recent addition of this stanza to the ancient hymn. The hymn has been discussed by Weber, Vedische Beiträge, pp. 4. ff.

verses.sa:
त्वा युजा तव तत् सोम सख्य इन्द्रो अपो मनवे सस्रुतस्कः ।
अहन्नहिमरिणात् सप्त सिन्धूनपावृणोदपिहितेव खानि॥
verses.tr: tvā yujā tava tat soma sakhya indro apo manave sasrutaskaḥ ahannahimariṇāt sapta sindhūnapāvṛṇodapihiteva khāni
verses.en: Allied with thee, in this thy friendship, Soma, Indra for man made waters flow together, Slew Ahi, and sent forth the Seven Rivers, and opened as it were obstructed fountains.

verses.sa:
त्वा युजा नि खिदत् सूर्यस्येन्द्रश्चक्रं सहसा सद्य इन्दो ।
अधि ष्णुना बृहता वर्तमानं महो द्रुहो अप विश्वायु धायि॥
verses.tr: tvā yujā ni khidat sūryasyendraścakraṃ sahasā sadya indo adhi ṣṇunā bṛhatā vartamānaṃ maho druho apa viśvāyu dhāyi
verses.en: Indu, with thee for his confederate, Indra swiftly with might pressed down the wheel of Surya. What rolled, all life's support, on heaven's high summit was separated from the great oppressor.

verses.sa:
अहन्निन्द्रो अदहदग्निरिन्दो पुरा दस्यून्मध्यंदिनादभीके ।
दुर्गे दुरोणे क्रत्वा न यातां पुरू सहस्रा शर्वा नि बर्हीत्॥
verses.tr: ahannindro adahadagnirindo purā dasyūnmadhyaṃdinādabhīke durge duroṇe kratvā na yātāṃ purū sahasrā śarvā ni barhīt
verses.en: Indra smote down, Agni consumed, O Indu, the Dasyus ere the noontide in the conflict. Of those who gladly sought a hard-won dwelling he cast down many a thousand with his arrow.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्मात् सीमधमाँ इन्द्र दस्यून् विशो दासीरकृणोरप्रशस्ताः ।
अबाधेथाममृणतं नि शत्रूनविन्देथामपचितिं वधत्रैः॥
verses.tr: viśvasmāt sīmadhamāṃ indra dasyūn viśo dāsīrakṛṇorapraśastāḥ abādhethāmamṛṇataṃ ni śatrūnavindethāmapacitiṃ vadhatraiḥ
verses.en: Lower than all besides hast thou, O Indra, cast down the Dasyus, abject tribes of Dasas. Ye drave away, ye put to death the foemen, and took great vengeance with your murdering weapons.

verses.sa:
एवा सत्यं मघवाना युवं तदिन्द्रश्च सोमोर्वमश्व्यं गोः ।
आदर्दृतमपिहितान्यश्ना रिरिचथुः क्षाश्चित् ततृदाना॥
verses.tr: evā satyaṃ maghavānā yuvaṃ tadindraśca somorvamaśvyaṃ goḥ ādardṛtamapihitānyaśnā riricathuḥ kṣāścit tatṛdānā
verses.en: So, of a truth, Indra and Soma, Heroes, ye burst the stable of the kine and horses, The stable which the bar or stone obstructed; and piercing through set free the habitations.

verses.sa:
आ नः स्तुत उप वाजेभिरूती इन्द्र याहि हरिभिर्मन्दसानः ।
तिरश्चिदर्यः सवना पुरूण्याङ्गूषेभिर्गृणानः सत्यराधाः॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ stuta upa vājebhirūtī indra yāhi haribhirmandasānaḥ tiraścidaryaḥ savanā purūṇyāṅgūṣebhirgṛṇānaḥ satyarādhāḥ
verses.en: Come, lauded, unto us with powers and succours, O Indra, with thy Tawny Steeds; exulting, Past even the foeman's manifold libations, glorified with our hymns, true Wealth-bestower.

verses.sa:
आ हि ष्मा याति नर्यश्चिकित्वान् हूयमानः सोतृभिरुप यज्ञम् ।
स्वश्वो यो अभीरुर्मन्यमानः सुष्वाणेभिर्मदति सं ह वीरैः॥
verses.tr: ā hi ṣmā yāti naryaścikitvān hūyamānaḥ sotṛbhirupa yajñam svaśvo yo abhīrurmanyamānaḥ suṣvāṇebhirmadati saṃ ha vīraiḥ
verses.en: Man's Friend, to this our sacrifice he cometh marking how he is called by Soma-pressers. Fearless, and conscious that his Steeds are noble, he joyeth with the Soma-pouring heroes.

verses.sa:
श्रावयेदस्य कर्णा वाजयध्यै जुष्टामनु प्र दिशं मन्दयध्यै ।
उद्वावृषाणो राधसे तुविष्मान् करन्न इन्द्रः सुतीर्थाभयं च॥
verses.tr: śrāvayedasya karṇā vājayadhyai juṣṭāmanu pra diśaṃ mandayadhyai udvāvṛṣāṇo rādhase tuviṣmān karanna indraḥ sutīrthābhayaṃ ca
verses.en: Make his cars hear, that he may show his vigour and may be joyful in the way he loveth. May mighty Indra pouring forth in bounty bestow on us good roads and perfect safety;

verses.sa:
अच्छा यो गन्ता नाधमानमूती इत्था विप्रं हवमानं गृणन्तम् ।
उप त्मनि दधानो धुर्या३शून् त्सहस्राणि शतानि वज्रबाहुः॥
verses.tr: acchā yo gantā nādhamānamūtī itthā vipraṃ havamānaṃ gṛṇantam upa tmani dadhāno dhuryā3śūn tsahasrāṇi śatāni vajrabāhuḥ
verses.en: He who with succour comes to his implorer, the singer here who with his song invites him; He who himself sets to the pole swift Coursers, he who hath hundreds, thousands, Thunder-wielder.

verses.sa:
त्वोतासो मघवन्निन्द्र विप्रा वयं ते स्याम सूरयो गृणन्तः ।
भेजानासो बृहद्दिवस्य राय आकाय्यस्य दावने पुरुक्षोः॥
verses.tr: tvotāso maghavannindra viprā vayaṃ te syāma sūrayo gṛṇantaḥ bhejānāso bṛhaddivasya rāya ākāyyasya dāvane purukṣoḥ
verses.en: O Indra Maghavan, by thee protected may we be thine, princes and priests and singers, Sharing the riches sent from lofty heaven which yields much food, and all desire its bounty.

verses.sa: नकिरिन्द्र त्वदुत्तरो न ज्यायाँ अस्ति वृत्रहन् । नकिरेवा यथा त्वम्॥
verses.tr: nakirindra tvaduttaro na jyāyāṃ asti vṛtrahan nakirevā yathā tvam
verses.en: O INDRA, Vrtra-slayer, none is better, mightier than thou: Verily there is none like thee.

verses.sa: सत्रा ते अनु कृष्टयो विश्वा चक्रेव वावृतुः । सत्रा महाँ असि श्रुतः॥
verses.tr: satrā te anu kṛṣṭayo viśvā cakreva vāvṛtuḥ satrā mahāṃ asi śrutaḥ
verses.en: Like chariot-wheels these people all together follow after thee: Thou ever art renowned as Great.

verses.sa: विश्वे चनेदना त्वा देवास इन्द्र युयुधुः । यदहा नक्तमातिरः॥
verses.tr: viśve canedanā tvā devāsa indra yuyudhuḥ yadahā naktamātiraḥ
verses.en: Not even all the gathered Gods conquered thee, Indra, in the war, When thou didst lengthen days by night.

verses.sa: यत्रोत बाधितेभ्यश्चक्रं कुत्साय युध्यते । मुषाय इन्द्र सूर्यम्॥
verses.tr: yatrota bādhitebhyaścakraṃ kutsāya yudhyate muṣāya indra sūryam
verses.en: When for the sake of those oppressed, and Kutsa as he battled, Thou stolest away the Sun's car-wheel.

verses.sa: यत्र देवाँ ऋघायतो विश्वाँ अयुध्य एक इत् । त्वमिन्द्र वनूँरहन्॥
verses.tr: yatra devāṃ ṛghāyato viśvāṃ ayudhya eka it tvamindra vanūṃrahan
verses.en: When, fighting singly, Indra. thou o'ercamest all the furious Gods, Thou slewest those who strove with thee.

verses.sa: यत्रोत मर्त्याय कमरिणा इन्द्र सूर्यम् । प्रावः शचीभिरेतशम्॥
verses.tr: yatrota martyāya kamariṇā indra sūryam prāvaḥ śacībhiretaśam
verses.en: When also for a mortal man, Indra, thou speddest forth the Sun, And holpest Etasa with might.

verses.sa: किमादुतासि वृत्रहन् मघवन् मन्युमत्तमः । अत्राह दानुमातिरः॥
verses.tr: kimādutāsi vṛtrahan maghavan manyumattamaḥ atrāha dānumātiraḥ
verses.en: What? Vrtra-slayer, art not thou, Maghavan, fiercest in thy wrath? So hast thou quelled the demon too.

verses.sa: एतद् घेदुत वीर्य१मिन्द्र चकर्थ पौंस्यम् । स्त्रियं यद् दुर्हणायुवं वधीर्दुहितरं दिवः॥
verses.tr: etad gheduta vīrya1mindra cakartha pauṃsyam striyaṃ yad durhaṇāyuvaṃ vadhīrduhitaraṃ divaḥ
verses.en: And this heroic deed of might thou, Indra, also hast achieved, That thou didst smite to death the Dame, Heaven's Daughter, meditating ill.

verses.sa: दिवश्चिद् घा दुहितरं महान् महीयमानाम् । उषासमिन्द्र सं पिणक्॥
verses.tr: divaścid ghā duhitaraṃ mahān mahīyamānām uṣāsamindra saṃ piṇak
verses.en: Thou, Indra, Mighty One, didst crush Usas, though Daughter of the Sky. When lifting up herself in pride.

verses.sa: अपोषा अनसः सरत् सम्पिष्टादह बिभ्युषी । नि यत्सीं शिश्नथद् वृषा॥
verses.tr: apoṣā anasaḥ sarat sampiṣṭādaha bibhyuṣī ni yatsīṃ śiśnathad vṛṣā
verses.en: Then from her chariot Usas fled, affrighted, from her ruined car. When the strong God had shattered it.

verses.sa: एतदस्या अनः शये सुसम्पिष्टं विपाश्या । ससार सीं परावतः॥
verses.tr: etadasyā anaḥ śaye susampiṣṭaṃ vipāśyā sasāra sīṃ parāvataḥ
verses.en: So there this car of Usas lay, broken to pieces, in Vipas, And she herself fled far away.

verses.sa: उत सिन्धुं विबाल्यं वितस्थानामधि क्षमि । परि ष्ठा इन्द्र मायया॥
verses.tr: uta sindhuṃ vibālyaṃ vitasthānāmadhi kṣami pari ṣṭhā indra māyayā
verses.en: Thou, Indra, didst. with magic power resist the overflowing stream Who spread her waters o'er the land.

verses.sa: उत शुष्णस्य धृष्णुया प्र मृक्षो अभि वेदनम् । पुरो यदस्य सम्पिणक्॥
verses.tr: uta śuṣṇasya dhṛṣṇuyā pra mṛkṣo abhi vedanam puro yadasya sampiṇak
verses.en: Valiantly didst thou seize and take the store which Susna had amassed, When thou didst crush his fortresses.

verses.sa: उत दासं कौलितरं बृहतः पर्वतादधि । अवाहन्निन्द्र शम्बरम्॥
verses.tr: uta dāsaṃ kaulitaraṃ bṛhataḥ parvatādadhi avāhannindra śambaram
verses.en: Thou, Indra, also smotest down Kulitara's son Sambara, The Dasa, from the lofty hill.

verses.sa: उत दासस्य वर्चिनः सहस्राणि शतावधीः । अधि पञ्च प्रधीँरिव॥
verses.tr: uta dāsasya varcinaḥ sahasrāṇi śatāvadhīḥ adhi pañca pradhīṃriva
verses.en: Of Dasa Varcin's thou didst slay the hundred thousand and the five, Crushed like the fellies, of a car.

verses.sa: उत त्यं पुत्रमग्रुवः परावृक्तं शतक्रतुः । उक्थेष्विन्द्र आभजत्॥
verses.tr: uta tyaṃ putramagruvaḥ parāvṛktaṃ śatakratuḥ uktheṣvindra ābhajat
verses.en: So Indra, Lord of Heroes, Powers, caused the unwedded damsel's son, The castaway, to share the lauds.

verses.sa: उत त्या तुर्वशायदू अस्नातारा शचीपतिः । इन्द्रो विद्वाँ अपारयत्॥
verses.tr: uta tyā turvaśāyadū asnātārā śacīpatiḥ indro vidvāṃ apārayat
verses.en: So sapient Indra, Lord of Might, brought Turvaga and Yadu, those Who feared the flood, in safely o'er.

verses.sa: उत त्या सद्य आर्या सरयोरिन्द्र पारतः । अर्णाचित्ररथावधीः॥
verses.tr: uta tyā sadya āryā sarayorindra pārataḥ arṇācitrarathāvadhīḥ
verses.en: Arpa and Citraratha, both Aryas, thou, Indra, slewest swift, On yonder side of Sarayu,

verses.sa: अनु द्वा जहिता नयोऽन्धं श्रोणं च वृत्रहन् । न तत् ते सुम्नमष्टवे॥
verses.tr: anu dvā jahitā nayo'ndhaṃ śroṇaṃ ca vṛtrahan na tat te sumnamaṣṭave
verses.en: Thou, Vrtra-slayer, didst conduct those two forlorn, the blind, the lame. None may attain this bliss of thine.

verses.sa: शतमश्मन्मयीनां पुरामिन्द्रो व्यास्यत् । दिवोदासाय दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: śatamaśmanmayīnāṃ purāmindro vyāsyat divodāsāya dāśuṣe
verses.en: For Divodasa, him who brought oblation, 1ndra overthrew A hundred fortresses of stone.

verses.sa: अस्वापयद् दभीतये सहस्रा त्रिंशतं हथैः । दासानामिन्द्रो मायया॥
verses.tr: asvāpayad dabhītaye sahasrā triṃśataṃ hathaiḥ dāsānāmindro māyayā
verses.en: The thirty thousand Disas he with magic power and weapons sent To slumber, for Dabhiti's sake.

verses.sa: स घेदुतासि वृत्रहन् त्समान इन्द्र गोपतिः । यस्ता विश्वानि चिच्युषे॥
verses.tr: sa ghedutāsi vṛtrahan tsamāna indra gopatiḥ yastā viśvāni cicyuṣe
verses.en: As such, O Vrtra-slayer, thou art general Lord of kine for all, Thou Shaker of all things that be.

verses.sa: उत नूनं यदिन्द्रियं करिष्या इन्द्र पौंस्यम् । अद्या नकिष्टदा मिनत्॥
verses.tr: uta nūnaṃ yadindriyaṃ kariṣyā indra pauṃsyam adyā nakiṣṭadā minat
verses.en: Indra, whatever deed of might thou hast this day to execute, None be there now to hinder it.

verses.sa: वामंवामं त आदुरे देवो ददात्वर्यमा । वामं पूषा वामं भगो वामं देवः करूळती॥
verses.tr: vāmaṃvāmaṃ ta ādure devo dadātvaryamā vāmaṃ pūṣā vāmaṃ bhago vāmaṃ devaḥ karūḻatī
verses.en: O Watchful One, may Aryaman the God give thee all goodly things. May Risan, Bhaga, and the God Karulati give all things fair.

verses.sa: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा । कया शचिष्ठया वृता॥
verses.tr: kayā naścitra ā bhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā
verses.en: With what help will he come to us, wonderful, ever-waxing Friend; With what most mighty company?

verses.sa: कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मंहिष्ठो मत्सदन्धसः । दृळहा चिदारुजे वसु॥
verses.tr: kastvā satyo madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭho matsadandhasaḥ dṛḻahā cidāruje vasu
verses.en: What genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burst Open e'en strongly-guarded wealth?

verses.sa: अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणाम् । शतं भवास्यूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: abhī ṣu ṇaḥ sakhīnāmavitā jaritṝṇām śataṃ bhavāsyūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Do thou who art Protector of us thy friends who praise thee With hundred aids approach us.

verses.sa: अभी न आ ववृत्स्व चक्रं न वृत्तमर्वतः । नियुद्भिश्चर्षणीनाम्॥
verses.tr: abhī na ā vavṛtsva cakraṃ na vṛttamarvataḥ niyudbhiścarṣaṇīnām
verses.en: Like as a courser's circling wheel, so turn thee hitherward to us, Attracted by the hymns of men.

verses.sa: प्रवता हि क्रतूनामा हा पदेव गच्छसि । अभक्षि सूर्ये सचा॥
verses.tr: pravatā hi kratūnāmā hā padeva gacchasi abhakṣi sūrye sacā
verses.en: Thou seekest as it were thine own stations with swift descent of powers: I share thee even with the Sun.

verses.sa: सं यत्त इन्द्र मन्यवः सं चक्राणि दधन्विरे । अध त्वे अध सूर्ये॥
verses.tr: saṃ yatta indra manyavaḥ saṃ cakrāṇi dadhanvire adha tve adha sūrye
verses.en: What time thy courage and his wheels together, Indra, run their course With thee and with the Sun alike,

verses.sa: उत स्मा हि त्वामाहुरिन्मघवानं शचीपते । दातारमविदीधयुम्॥
verses.tr: uta smā hi tvāmāhurinmaghavānaṃ śacīpate dātāramavidīdhayum
verses.en: So even, Lord of Power and Might, the people call thee Maghavan, Giver, who pauses not to think.

verses.sa: उत स्मा सद्य इत् परि शशमानाय सुन्वते । पुरू चिन्मंहसे वसु॥
verses.tr: uta smā sadya it pari śaśamānāya sunvate purū cinmaṃhase vasu
verses.en: And verily to him who toils and presses Soma juice for thee Thou quickly givest ample wealth.

verses.sa: नहि ष्मा ते शतं चन राधो वरन्त आमुरः । न च्यौत्नानि करिष्यतः॥
verses.tr: nahi ṣmā te śataṃ cana rādho varanta āmuraḥ na cyautnāni kariṣyataḥ
verses.en: No, not a hundred hinderers can check thy gracious bounty's flow, Nor thy great deeds when thou wilt act.

verses.sa: अस्माँ अवन्तु ते शतमस्मान् त्सहस्रमूतयः । अस्मान् विश्वा अभिष्टयः॥
verses.tr: asmāṃ avantu te śatamasmān tsahasramūtayaḥ asmān viśvā abhiṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: May thine assistance keep us safe, thy hundred and thy thousand aids: May all thy favours strengthen us.

verses.sa: अस्माँ इहा वृणीष्व सख्याय स्वस्तये । महो राये दिवित्मते॥
verses.tr: asmāṃ ihā vṛṇīṣva sakhyāya svastaye maho rāye divitmate
verses.en: Do thou elect us this place for friendship and prosperity, And great celestial opulence.

verses.sa: अस्माँ अविड्ढि विश्वहेन्द्र राया परीणसा । अस्मान् विश्वाभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: asmāṃ aviḍḍhi viśvahendra rāyā parīṇasā asmān viśvābhirūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Favour us, Indra, evermore with overflowing store of wealth: With all thy succours aid thou us.

verses.sa: अस्मभ्यं ताँ अपा वृधि व्रजाँ अस्तेव गोमतः । नवाभिरिन्द्रोतिभिः॥
verses.tr: asmabhyaṃ tāṃ apā vṛdhi vrajāṃ asteva gomataḥ navābhirindrotibhiḥ
verses.en: With new protections, Indra, like an archer, open thou for us The stables that are filled with kine.

verses.sa: अस्माकं धृष्णुया रथो द्युमाँ इन्द्रानपच्युतः । गव्युरश्वयुरीयते॥
verses.tr: asmākaṃ dhṛṣṇuyā ratho dyumāṃ indrānapacyutaḥ gavyuraśvayurīyate
verses.en: Our chariot, Indra, boldly moves endued with splendour, ne'er repulsed, Winning for us both kine and steeds.

verses.sa: अस्माकमुत्तमं कृधि श्रवो देवेषु सूर्य । वर्षिष्ठं द्यामिवोपरि॥
verses.tr: asmākamuttamaṃ kṛdhi śravo deveṣu sūrya varṣiṣṭhaṃ dyāmivopari
verses.en: O Surya, make our fame to be most excellent among the Gods, Most lofty as the heaven on high.

verses.sa: आ तू न इन्द्र वृत्रहन्नस्माकमर्धमा गहि । महान्महीभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: ā tū na indra vṛtrahannasmākamardhamā gahi mahānmahībhirūtibhiḥ
verses.en: O THOU who slewest Vrtra, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty One with thy mighty aids.

verses.sa: भृमिश्चिद् घासि तूतुजिरा चित्र चित्रिणीष्वा । चित्रं कृणोष्यूतये॥
verses.tr: bhṛmiścid ghāsi tūtujirā citra citriṇīṣvā citraṃ kṛṇoṣyūtaye
verses.en: Swift and impetuous art thou, wondrous amid the well-dressed folk: Thou doest marvels for our help.

verses.sa: दभ्रेभिश्चिच्छशीयांसं हंसि व्राधन्तमोजसा । सखिभिर्ये त्वे सचा॥
verses.tr: dabhrebhiścicchaśīyāṃsaṃ haṃsi vrādhantamojasā sakhibhirye tve sacā
verses.en: Even with the weak thou smitest down him who is stronger, with thy strength The mighty, with the Friends thou hast.

verses.sa: वयमिन्द्र त्वे सचा वयं त्वाभि नोनुमः । अस्माँअस्माँ इदुदव॥
verses.tr: vayamindra tve sacā vayaṃ tvābhi nonumaḥ asmāṃasmāṃ idudava
verses.en: O Indra, we are close to thee; to thee we sing aloud our songs: Help and defend us, even us.

verses.sa: स नश्चित्राभिरद्रिवोऽनवद्याभिरूतिभिः । अनाधृष्टाभिरा गहि॥
verses.tr: sa naścitrābhiradrivo'navadyābhirūtibhiḥ anādhṛṣṭābhirā gahi
verses.en: As such, O Caster of the Stone, come with thy succours wonderful, Blameless, and irresistible.

verses.sa: भूयामो षु त्वावतः सखाय इन्द्र गोमतः । युजो वाजाय घृष्वये॥
verses.tr: bhūyāmo ṣu tvāvataḥ sakhāya indra gomataḥ yujo vājāya ghṛṣvaye
verses.en: May we be friends of one like thee, O Indra, with the wealth of kine, Comrades for lively energy.

verses.sa: त्वं ह्येक ईशिष इन्द्र वाजस्य गोमतः । स नो यन्धि महीमिषम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hyeka īśiṣa indra vājasya gomataḥ sa no yandhi mahīmiṣam
verses.en: For thou, O Indra, art alone the Lord of strength that comes from kine So grant thou us abundant food.

verses.sa: न त्वा वरन्ते अन्यथा यद् दित्ससि स्तुतो मघम् । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र गिर्वणः॥
verses.tr: na tvā varante anyathā yad ditsasi stuto magham stotṛbhya indra girvaṇaḥ
verses.en: They turn thee not another way, when, lauded, Lover of the Song, Thou wilt give wealth to those who praise.

verses.sa: अभि त्वा गोतमा गिरानूषत प्र दावने । इन्द्र वाजाय घृष्वये॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā gotamā girānūṣata pra dāvane indra vājāya ghṛṣvaye
verses.en: The Gotamas have sung their song of praise to thee that thou mayst give, Indra, for lively energy.

verses.sa: प्र ते वोचाम वीर्या३ या मन्दसान आरुजः । पुरो दासीरभीत्य॥
verses.tr: pra te vocāma vīryā3 yā mandasāna ārujaḥ puro dāsīrabhītya
verses.en: We will declare thy hero deeds, what Disa forts thou brakest down, Attacking them in rapturous joy.

verses.sa: ता ते गृणन्ति वेधसो यानि चकर्थ पौंस्या । सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः॥
verses.tr: tā te gṛṇanti vedhaso yāni cakartha pauṃsyā suteṣvindra girvaṇaḥ
verses.en: The sages sing those manly deeds which, Indra, Lover of the Song, Thou wroughtest when the Soma flowed.

verses.sa: अवीवृधन्त गोतमा इन्द्र त्वे स्तोमवाहसः । ऐषु धा वीरवद् यशः॥
verses.tr: avīvṛdhanta gotamā indra tve stomavāhasaḥ aiṣu dhā vīravad yaśaḥ
verses.en: Indra, the Gotamas who bring thee praises have grown strong by thee. Give them renown with hero sons.

verses.sa: यच्चिद्धि शश्वतामसीन्द्र साधारणस्त्वम् । तं त्वा वयं हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi śaśvatāmasīndra sādhāraṇastvam taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe
verses.en: For, Indra, verily thou art the general treasure even of all. Thee, therefore, do we invocate.

verses.sa: अर्वाचीनो वसो भवाऽस्मे सु मत्स्वान्धसः । सोमानामिन्द्र सोमपाः॥
verses.tr: arvācīno vaso bhavā'sme su matsvāndhasaḥ somānāmindra somapāḥ
verses.en: Excellent Indra, turn to us: glad thee among us with the juice Of Somas, Soma-drinker thou.

verses.sa: अस्माकं त्वा मतीनामा स्तोम इन्द्र यच्छतु । अर्वागा वर्तया हरी॥
verses.tr: asmākaṃ tvā matīnāmā stoma indra yacchatu arvāgā vartayā harī
verses.en: May praise from us who think on thee, O Indra, bring thee near to us. Turn thy two Bay Steeds hitherward.

verses.sa: पुरोळाशं च नो घसो जोषयासे गिरश्च नः । वधूयुरिव योषणाम्॥
verses.tr: puroḻāśaṃ ca no ghaso joṣayāse giraśca naḥ vadhūyuriva yoṣaṇām
verses.en: Eat of our sacrificial cake: rejoice thee in the songs we sing. Even as a lover in his bride.

verses.sa: सहस्रं व्यतीनां युक्तानामिन्द्रमीमहे । शतं सोमस्य खार्यः॥
verses.tr: sahasraṃ vyatīnāṃ yuktānāmindramīmahe śataṃ somasya khāryaḥ
verses.en: To India for a thousand steeds well-trained and fleet of foot we pray, And hundred jars of Soma juice.

verses.sa: सहस्रा ते शता वयं गवामा च्यावयामसि । अस्मत्रा राध एतु ते॥
verses.tr: sahasrā te śatā vayaṃ gavāmā cyāvayāmasi asmatrā rādha etu te
verses.en: We make a hundred of thy kine, yea, and a thousand, hasten nigh: So let thy bounty come to us.

verses.sa: दश ते कलशानां हिरण्यानामधीमहि । भूरिदा असि वृत्रहन्॥
verses.tr: daśa te kalaśānāṃ hiraṇyānāmadhīmahi bhūridā asi vṛtrahan
verses.en: We have obtained, a gift from thee, ten water-ewers wrought of gold: Thou, Vrtra-slayer, givest much.

verses.sa: भूरिदा भूरि देहि नो मा दभ्रं भूर्या भर । भूरि घेदिन्द्र दित्ससि॥
verses.tr: bhūridā bhūri dehi no mā dabhraṃ bhūryā bhara bhūri ghedindra ditsasi
verses.en: A bounteous Giver, give us much, bring much and not a trifling gift: Much, Indra, wilt thou fain bestow.

verses.sa: भूरिदा ह्यसि श्रुतः पुरुत्रा शूर वृत्रहन् । आ नो भजस्व राधसि॥
verses.tr: bhūridā hyasi śrutaḥ purutrā śūra vṛtrahan ā no bhajasva rādhasi
verses.en: O Vrtra-slayer, thou art famed in many a place as bountiful Hero, thy bounty let us share.

verses.sa: प्र ते बभ्रू विचक्षण शंसामि गोषणो नपात् । माभ्यां गा अनु शिश्रथः॥
verses.tr: pra te babhrū vicakṣaṇa śaṃsāmi goṣaṇo napāt mābhyāṃ gā anu śiśrathaḥ
verses.en: I praise thy pair of Tawny Steeds, wise Son of him who giveth kine Terrify not the cows with these.

verses.sa: कनीनकेव विद्रधे नवे द्रुपदे अर्भके । बभ्रू यामेषु शोभेते॥
verses.tr: kanīnakeva vidradhe nave drupade arbhake babhrū yāmeṣu śobhete
verses.en: Like two slight images of girls, unrobed, upon a new-wrought post, So shine the Bay Steeds in their course.

verses.sa: अरं म उस्रयाम्णेऽरमनुस्रयाम्णे । बभ्रू यामेष्वस्रिधा॥
verses.tr: araṃ ma usrayāmṇe'ramanusrayāmṇe babhrū yāmeṣvasridhā
verses.en: For me the Bays are ready when I start, or start not, with the dawn, Innocuous in the ways they take.

verses.sa:
प्र ऋभुभ्यो दूतमिव वाचमिष्य उपस्तिरे श्वैतरीं धेनुमीळे ।
ये वातजूतास्तरणिभिरेवैः परि द्यां सद्यो अपसो बभूवुः॥
verses.tr: pra ṛbhubhyo dūtamiva vācamiṣya upastire śvaitarīṃ dhenumīḻe ye vātajūtāstaraṇibhirevaiḥ pari dyāṃ sadyo apaso babhūvuḥ
verses.en: I SEND my voice as herald to the Rbhus; I crave the white cow for the overspreading. Wind-sped, the Skillful Ones in rapid motion have in an instant compassed round the heaven.

verses.sa:
यदारमक्रन्नृभवः पितृभ्यां परिविष्टी वेषणा दंसनाभिः ।
आदिद् देवानामुप सख्यमायन् धीरासः पुष्टिमवहन् मनायै॥
verses.tr: yadāramakrannṛbhavaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ pariviṣṭī veṣaṇā daṃsanābhiḥ ādid devānāmupa sakhyamāyan dhīrāsaḥ puṣṭimavahan manāyai
verses.en: What time the Rbus had with care and marvels done proper service to assist their Parents, They won the friendship of the Gods; the Sages carried away the fruit of their devotion.

verses.sa:
पुनर्ये चक्रुः पितरा युवाना सना यूपेव जरणा शयाना ।
ते वाजो विभ्वाँ ऋभुरिन्द्रवन्तो मधुप्सरसो नोऽवन्तु यज्ञम्॥
verses.tr: punarye cakruḥ pitarā yuvānā sanā yūpeva jaraṇā śayānā te vājo vibhvāṃ ṛbhurindravanto madhupsaraso no'vantu yajñam
verses.en: May they who made their Parents, who were lying like posts that moulder, young again for ever,- May Vaja, Vibhvan, Rbhu, joined with Indra, protect our sacrifice, the Soma-lovers.

verses.sa:
यत् संवत्समृभवो गामरक्षन् यत् संवत्समृभवो मा अपिंशन् ।
यत् संवत्समभरन् भासो अस्यास्ताभिः शमीभिरमृतत्वमाशुः॥
verses.tr: yat saṃvatsamṛbhavo gāmarakṣan yat saṃvatsamṛbhavo mā apiṃśan yat saṃvatsamabharan bhāso asyāstābhiḥ śamībhiramṛtatvamāśuḥ
verses.en: As for a year the Rbhus kept the Milch-cow, throughout a year fashioned and formed her body, And through a year's space still sustained her brightness, through these their labours they were made immortal.

verses.sa:
ज्येष्ठ आह चमसा द्वा करेति कनीयान् त्रीन् कृणवामेत्याह ।
कनिष्ठ आह चतुरस्करेति त्वष्ट ऋभवस्तत् पनयद् वचो वः॥
verses.tr: jyeṣṭha āha camasā dvā kareti kanīyān trīn kṛṇavāmetyāha kaniṣṭha āha caturaskareti tvaṣṭa ṛbhavastat panayad vaco vaḥ
verses.en: Two beakers let us make,- thus said the eldest. Let us make three,- this was the younger's sentence. Four beakers let us make,- thus spoke the youngest. Tvastar approved this rede of yours, O Rbhus.

verses.sa:
सत्यमूचुर्नर एवा हि चक्रुरनु स्वधामृभवो जग्मुरेताम् ।
विभ्राजमानाँश्चमसाँ अहेवाऽवेनत् त्वष्टा चतुरो ददृश्वान्॥
verses.tr: satyamūcurnara evā hi cakruranu svadhāmṛbhavo jagmuretām vibhrājamānāṃścamasāṃ ahevā'venat tvaṣṭā caturo dadṛśvān
verses.en: The men spake truth and even so they acted: this Godlike way of theirs the Rbhus followed. And Tvastar, when he looked on the four beakers resplendent as the day, was moved with envy.

verses.sa:
द्वादश द्यून् यदगोह्यस्याऽऽतिथ्ये रणन्नृभवः ससन्तः ।
सुक्षेत्राकृण्वन्ननयन्त सिन्धून् धन्वातिष्ठन्नोषधीर्निम्नमापः॥
verses.tr: dvādaśa dyūn yadagohyasyā''tithye raṇannṛbhavaḥ sasantaḥ sukṣetrākṛṇvannanayanta sindhūn dhanvātiṣṭhannoṣadhīrnimnamāpaḥ
verses.en: When for twelve days the Rbhus joyed reposing as guests of him who never may be hidden, Valley made fair fertile fields, they brought the rivers. Plants spread o'er deserts, waters filled the hollows.

verses.sa:
रथं ये चक्रुः सुवृतं नरेष्ठां ये धेनुं विश्वजुवं विश्वरूपाम् ।
त आ तक्षन्त्वृभवो रयिं नः स्ववसः स्वपसः सुहस्ताः॥
verses.tr: rathaṃ ye cakruḥ suvṛtaṃ nareṣṭhāṃ ye dhenuṃ viśvajuvaṃ viśvarūpām ta ā takṣantvṛbhavo rayiṃ naḥ svavasaḥ svapasaḥ suhastāḥ
verses.en: May they who formed the swift car, bearing Heroes, and the Cow omniform and all-impelling, Even may they form wealth for us,-the Rbhus, dexterous-handed, deft in work and gracious.

verses.sa:
अपो ह्येषामजुषन्त देवा अभि क्रत्वा मनसा दीध्यानाः ।
वाजो देवानामभवत् सुकर्मेन्द्रस्य ऋभुक्षा वरुणस्य विभ्वा॥
verses.tr: apo hyeṣāmajuṣanta devā abhi kratvā manasā dīdhyānāḥ vājo devānāmabhavat sukarmendrasya ṛbhukṣā varuṇasya vibhvā
verses.en: So in their work the Gods had satisfaction, pondering it with thought and mental insight. The Gods' expert artificer was Vaja, Indra's Rbhuksan, Varuna's was Vibhvan.

verses.sa:
ये हरी मेधयोक्था मदन्त इन्द्राय चक्रुः सुयुजा ये अश्वा ।
ते रायस्पोषं द्रविणान्यस्मे धत्त ऋभवः क्षेमयन्तो न मित्रम्॥
verses.tr: ye harī medhayokthā madanta indrāya cakruḥ suyujā ye aśvā te rāyaspoṣaṃ draviṇānyasme dhatta ṛbhavaḥ kṣemayanto na mitram
verses.en: They whole made glad with sacrifice and praises, wrought the two Bays, his docile Steeds, for Indra,- Rbhus, as those who wish a friend to prosper, bestow upon us gear and growth of riches.

verses.sa:
इदाह्नः पीतिमुत वो मदं धुर्न ऋते श्रान्तस्य सख्याय देवाः ।
ते नूनमस्मे ऋभवो वसूनि तृतीये अस्मिन् त्सवने दधात॥
verses.tr: idāhnaḥ pītimuta vo madaṃ dhurna ṛte śrāntasya sakhyāya devāḥ te nūnamasme ṛbhavo vasūni tṛtīye asmin tsavane dadhāta
verses.en: This day have they set gladdening drink before you. Not without toil are Gods inclined to friendship. Therefore do ye who are so great, O Rbhus, vouchsafe us treasures at this third libation.

verses.sa:
ऋभुर्विभ्वा वाज इन्द्रो नो अच्छेमं यज्ञं रत्नधेयोप यात ।
इदा हि वो धिषणा देव्यह्नामधात् पीतिं सं मदा अग्मता वः॥
verses.tr: ṛbhurvibhvā vāja indro no acchemaṃ yajñaṃ ratnadheyopa yāta idā hi vo dhiṣaṇā devyahnāmadhāt pītiṃ saṃ madā agmatā vaḥ
verses.en: To this our sacrifice come Rbhu, Vibhvan, Vaja, and Indra with the gift of riches, Because this day hath Dhisana the Goddess set drink for you: the gladdening draughts have reached you.

verses.sa:
विदानासो जन्मनो वाजरत्ना उत ऋतुभिर्ऋभवो मादयध्वम् ।
सं वो मदा अग्मत सं पुरंधिः सुवीरामस्मे रयिमेरयध्वम्॥
verses.tr: vidānāso janmano vājaratnā uta ṛtubhirṛbhavo mādayadhvam saṃ vo madā agmata saṃ puraṃdhiḥ suvīrāmasme rayimerayadhvam
verses.en: Knowing your birth and rich in gathered treasure, Rbhus, rejoice together with the Rtus. The gladdening draughts and wisdom have approached you: send ye us riches with good store of heroes.

verses.sa:
अयं वो यज्ञ ऋभवोऽकारि यमा मनुष्वत् प्रदिवो दधिध्वे ।
प्र वोऽच्छा जुजुषाणासो अस्थुरभूत विश्वे अग्रियोत वाजाः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vo yajña ṛbhavo'kāri yamā manuṣvat pradivo dadhidhve pra vo'cchā jujuṣāṇāso asthurabhūta viśve agriyota vājāḥ
verses.en: For you was made this sacrifice, O Rbhus, which ye, like men, won for yourselves aforetime. To you come all who find in you their pleasure: ye all were-even the two elder-Vajas.

verses.sa:
अभूदु वो विधते रत्नधेयमिदा नरो दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
पिबत वाजा ऋभवो ददे वो महि तृतीयं सवनं मदाय॥
verses.tr: abhūdu vo vidhate ratnadheyamidā naro dāśuṣe martyāya pibata vājā ṛbhavo dade vo mahi tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ madāya
verses.en: Now for the mortal worshipper, O Heroes, for him who served you, was the gift of riches. Drink, Vajas, Rbhus! unto you is offered, to gladden you, the third and great libation.

verses.sa:
आ वाजा यातोप न ऋभुक्षा महो नरो द्रविणसो गृणानाः ।
आ वः पीतयोऽभिपित्वे अह्नामिमा अस्तं नवस्व इव ग्मन्॥
verses.tr: ā vājā yātopa na ṛbhukṣā maho naro draviṇaso gṛṇānāḥ ā vaḥ pītayo'bhipitve ahnāmimā astaṃ navasva iva gman
verses.en: Come to us, Heroes, Vajas and Rbhuksans, glorified for the sake of mighty treasure. These draughts approach you as the day is closing, as cows, whose calves are newly-born, their stable.

verses.sa:
आ नपातः शवसो यातनोपेमं यज्ञं नमसा हूयमानाः ।
सजोषसः सूरयो यस्य च स्थ मध्वः पात रत्नधा इन्द्रवन्तः॥
verses.tr: ā napātaḥ śavaso yātanopemaṃ yajñaṃ namasā hūyamānāḥ sajoṣasaḥ sūrayo yasya ca stha madhvaḥ pāta ratnadhā indravantaḥ
verses.en: Come to this sacrifice of ours, ye Children of Strength, invoked with humble adoration. Drink of this meath, Wealth-givers, joined with Indra with whom ye are in full accord, ye Princes.

verses.sa:
सजोषा इन्द्र वरुणेन सोमं सजोषाः पाहि गिर्वणो मरुद्भिः ।
अग्रेपाभिर्ऋतुपाभिः सजोषा ग्नास्पत्नीभी रत्नधाभिः सजोषाः॥
verses.tr: sajoṣā indra varuṇena somaṃ sajoṣāḥ pāhi girvaṇo marudbhiḥ agrepābhirṛtupābhiḥ sajoṣā gnāspatnībhī ratnadhābhiḥ sajoṣāḥ
verses.en: Close knit with Varuna drink the Soma, Indra; close-knit, hymn-lover! with the Maruts drink it: Close-knit with drinkers first, who drink in season; close-knit with heavenly Dames who give us treasures.

verses.sa:
सजोषस आदित्यैर्मादयध्वं सजोषस ऋभवः पर्वतेभिः ।
सजोषसो दैव्येना सवित्रा सजोषसः सिन्धुभी रत्नधेभिः॥
verses.tr: sajoṣasa ādityairmādayadhvaṃ sajoṣasa ṛbhavaḥ parvatebhiḥ sajoṣaso daivyenā savitrā sajoṣasaḥ sindhubhī ratnadhebhiḥ
verses.en: Rejoice in full accord with the Adityas, in concord with the Parvatas, O Rbhus; In full accord with Savitar, Divine One; in full accord with floods that pour forth riches.

verses.sa:
ये अश्विना ये पितरा य ऊती धेनुं ततक्षुर्ऋभवो ये अश्वा ।
ये अंसत्रा य ऋधग्रोदसी ये विभ्वो नरः स्वपत्यानि चक्रुः॥
verses.tr: ye aśvinā ye pitarā ya ūtī dhenuṃ tatakṣurṛbhavo ye aśvā ye aṃsatrā ya ṛdhagrodasī ye vibhvo naraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ
verses.en: Rbhus, who helped their Parents and the Asvins, who formed the Milch-cow and the pair of horses, Made armour, set the heaven and earth asunder,-far- reaching Heroes, they have made good offspring.

verses.sa:
ये गोमन्तं वाजवन्तं सुवीरं रयिं धत्थ वसुमन्तं पुरुक्षुम् ।
ते अग्रेपा ऋभवो मन्दसाना अस्मे धत्त ये च रातिं गृणन्ति॥
