verses.tr: ye gomantaṃ vājavantaṃ suvīraṃ rayiṃ dhattha vasumantaṃ purukṣum te agrepā ṛbhavo mandasānā asme dhatta ye ca rātiṃ gṛṇanti
verses.en: Ye who have wealth in cattle and in booty, in heroes, in rich sustenance and treasure, Such, O ye Rbhus, first to drink, rejoicing, give unto us and those who laud our present.

verses.sa:
नापाभूत न वोऽतीतृषामाऽनिःशस्ता ऋभवो यज्ञे अस्मिन् ।
समिन्द्रेण मदथ सं मरुद्भिः सं राजभी रत्नधेयाय देवाः॥
verses.tr: nāpābhūta na vo'tītṛṣāmā'niḥśastā ṛbhavo yajñe asmin samindreṇa madatha saṃ marudbhiḥ saṃ rājabhī ratnadheyāya devāḥ
verses.en: Ye were not far: we have not left you thirsting, blameless in this our sacrifice, O Rbhus. Rejoice you with the Maruts and with Indra, with the Kings, Gods! that ye may give us riches.

verses.sa:
इहोप यात शवसो नपातः सौधन्वना ऋभवो माप भूत ।
अस्मिन् हि वः सवने रत्नधेयं गमन्त्विन्द्रमनु वो मदासः॥
verses.tr: ihopa yāta śavaso napātaḥ saudhanvanā ṛbhavo māpa bhūta asmin hi vaḥ savane ratnadheyaṃ gamantvindramanu vo madāsaḥ
verses.en: Come hither, O ye Sons of Strength, ye Rbhus; stay not afar, ye Children of Sudhanvan. At this libation is your gift of treasure. Let gladdening draughts approach you after Indra's.

verses.sa:
आगन्नृभूणामिह रत्नधेयमभूत् सोमस्य सुषुतस्य पीतिः ।
सुकृत्यया यत् स्वपस्यया चँ एकं विचक्र चमसं चतुर्धा॥
verses.tr: āgannṛbhūṇāmiha ratnadheyamabhūt somasya suṣutasya pītiḥ sukṛtyayā yat svapasyayā caṃ ekaṃ vicakra camasaṃ caturdhā
verses.en: Hither is come the Rbhus' gift of riches; here was the drinking of the well-pressed Soma, Since by dexterity and skill as craftsmen ye made the single chalice to be fourfold

verses.sa:
व्यकृणोत चमसं चतुर्धा सखे वि शिक्षेत्यब्रवीत ।
अथैत वाजा अमृतस्य पन्थां गणं देवानामृभवः सुहस्ताः॥
verses.tr: vyakṛṇota camasaṃ caturdhā sakhe vi śikṣetyabravīta athaita vājā amṛtasya panthāṃ gaṇaṃ devānāmṛbhavaḥ suhastāḥ
verses.en: Ye made fourfold the chalice that wag single: ye spake these words and said, O Friend, assist us; Then, Vajas! gained the path of life eternal, deft-handed Rbhus, to the Gods' assembly.

verses.sa:
किमयः स्विच्चमस एष आस यं काव्येन चतुरो विचक्र ।
अथा सुनुध्वं सवनं मदाय पात ऋभवो मधुनः सोम्यस्य॥
verses.tr: kimayaḥ sviccamasa eṣa āsa yaṃ kāvyena caturo vicakra athā sunudhvaṃ savanaṃ madāya pāta ṛbhavo madhunaḥ somyasya
verses.en: Out of what substance was that chalice fashioned which ye made fourfold by your art and wisdom? Now for the gladdening draught press out the liquor, and drink, O Rbhus, of die meath of Soma.

verses.sa:
शच्याकर्त पितरा युवाना शच्याकर्त चमसं देवपानम् ।
शच्या हरी धनुतरावतष्टेन्द्रवाहावृभवो वाजरत्नाः॥
verses.tr: śacyākarta pitarā yuvānā śacyākarta camasaṃ devapānam śacyā harī dhanutarāvataṣṭendravāhāvṛbhavo vājaratnāḥ
verses.en: Ye with your cunning made your Parents youthful; the cup, for Gods to drink, ye formed with cunning; With cunning, Rbhus, rich in treasure, fashioned the two swift Tawny Steeds who carry Indra.

verses.sa:
यो वः सुनोत्यभिपित्वे अह्नां तीव्रं वाजासः सवनं मदाय ।
तस्मै रयिमृभवः सर्ववीरमा तक्षत वृषणो मन्दसानाः॥
verses.tr: yo vaḥ sunotyabhipitve ahnāṃ tīvraṃ vājāsaḥ savanaṃ madāya tasmai rayimṛbhavaḥ sarvavīramā takṣata vṛṣaṇo mandasānāḥ
verses.en: Whoso pours out for you, when days are closing, the sharp libation for your joy, O Vajas, For him, O mighty Rbhus, ye, rejoicing, have fashioned wealth with plenteous store of heroes.

verses.sa:
प्रातः सुतमपिबो हर्यश्व माध्यंदिनं सवनं केवलं ते ।
समृभुभिः पिबस्व रत्नधेभिः सखीँर्याँ इन्द्र चकृषे सुकृत्या॥
verses.tr: prātaḥ sutamapibo haryaśva mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ kevalaṃ te samṛbhubhiḥ pibasva ratnadhebhiḥ sakhīṃryāṃ indra cakṛṣe sukṛtyā
verses.en: Lord of Bay Steeds, at dawn the juice thou drankest: thine, only thine, is the noonday libation. Now drink thou with the wealth-bestowing Rbhus, whom for their skill thou madest friends, O Indra.

verses.sa:
ये देवासो अभवता सुकृत्या श्येना इवेदधि दिवि निषेद ।
ते रत्नं धात शवसो नपातः सौधन्वना अभवतामृतासः॥
verses.tr: ye devāso abhavatā sukṛtyā śyenā ivedadhi divi niṣeda te ratnaṃ dhāta śavaso napātaḥ saudhanvanā abhavatāmṛtāsaḥ
verses.en: Ye, whom your artist skill hath raised to Godhead have set you down above in heaven like falcons. So give us riches, Children of Sudhanvan, O Sons of Strength; ye have become immortal.

verses.sa:
यत्तृतीयं सवनं रत्नधेयमकृणुध्वं स्वपस्या सुहस्ताः ।
तदृभवः परिषिक्तं व एतत् सं मदेभिरिन्द्रियेभिः पिबध्वम्॥
verses.tr: yattṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ ratnadheyamakṛṇudhvaṃ svapasyā suhastāḥ tadṛbhavaḥ pariṣiktaṃ va etat saṃ madebhirindriyebhiḥ pibadhvam
verses.en: The third libation, that bestoweth treasure, which ye have won by skill, ye dexterous-handed,- This drink hath been effused for you, O Rbhus. drink it with high delight, with joy like Indra's.

verses.sa:
अनश्वो जातो अनभीशुरुक्थ्यो३ रथस्त्रिचक्रः परि वर्तते रजः ।
महत् तद्वो देव्यस्य प्रवाचनं द्यामृभवः पृथिवीं यच्च पुष्यथ॥
verses.tr: anaśvo jāto anabhīśurukthyo3 rathastricakraḥ pari vartate rajaḥ mahat tadvo devyasya pravācanaṃ dyāmṛbhavaḥ pṛthivīṃ yacca puṣyatha
verses.en: This car that was not made for horses or for reins, three-wheeled, worthy of lauds, rolls round the firmament. That is the great announcement of your Deity, that, O ye Rbhus, ye sustain the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
रथं ये चक्रुः सुवृतं सुचेतसोऽविह्वरन्तं मनसस्परि ध्यया ।
ताँ ऊ न्व१स्य सवनस्य पीतय आ वो वाजा ऋभवो वेदयामसि॥
verses.tr: rathaṃ ye cakruḥ suvṛtaṃ sucetaso'vihvarantaṃ manasaspari dhyayā tāṃ ū nva1sya savanasya pītaya ā vo vājā ṛbhavo vedayāmasi
verses.en: Ye Sapient Ones who made the lightly-rolling car out of your mind, by thought, the car that never errs, You, being such, to drink of this drink offering, you, O ye Vajas, and ye Rbhus, we invoke.

verses.sa:
तद् वो वाजा ऋभवः सुप्रवाचनं देवेषु विभ्वो अभवन्महित्वनम् ।
जिव्री यत् सन्ता पितरा सनाजुरा पुनर्युवाना चरथाय तक्षथ॥
verses.tr: tad vo vājā ṛbhavaḥ supravācanaṃ deveṣu vibhvo abhavanmahitvanam jivrī yat santā pitarā sanājurā punaryuvānā carathāya takṣatha
verses.en: O Vajas, Rbhus, reaching far, among the Gods this was your exaltation gloriously declared, In that your aged Parents, worn with length of days, ye wrought again to youth so that they moved at will.

verses.sa:
एकं वि चक्र चमसं चतुर्वयं निश्चर्मणो गामरिणीत धीतिभिः ।
अथा देवेष्वमृतत्वमानश श्रुष्टी वाजा ऋभवस्तद् व उक्थ्यम्॥
verses.tr: ekaṃ vi cakra camasaṃ caturvayaṃ niścarmaṇo gāmariṇīta dhītibhiḥ athā deveṣvamṛtatvamānaśa śruṣṭī vājā ṛbhavastad va ukthyam
verses.en: The chalice that wag single ye have made fourfold, and by your wisdom brought the Cow forth from the hide. So quickly, mid the Gods, ye gained immortal life. Vajas and Rbhus, your great work must be extolled.

verses.sa:
ऋभुतो रयिः प्रथमश्रवस्तमो वाजश्रुतासो यमजीजनन् नरः ।
विभ्वतष्टो विदथेषु प्रवाच्यो यं देवासोऽवथा स विचर्षणिः॥
verses.tr: ṛbhuto rayiḥ prathamaśravastamo vājaśrutāso yamajījanan naraḥ vibhvataṣṭo vidatheṣu pravācyo yaṃ devāso'vathā sa vicarṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: Wealth from the Rbhus is most glorious in renown, that which the Heroes, famed for vigour, have produced. In synods must be sung the car which Vibhvan wrought: that which ye favour, Gods! is famed among mankind.

verses.sa:
स वाज्यर्वा स ऋषिर्वचस्यया स शूरो अस्ता पृतनासु दुष्टरः ।
स रायस्पोषं स सुवीर्यं दधे यं वाजो विभ्वाँ ऋभवो यमाविषुः॥
verses.tr: sa vājyarvā sa ṛṣirvacasyayā sa śūro astā pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraḥ sa rāyaspoṣaṃ sa suvīryaṃ dadhe yaṃ vājo vibhvāṃ ṛbhavo yamāviṣuḥ
verses.en: Strong is the steed, the man a sage in eloquence, the bowman is a hero hard to beat in fight, Great store of wealth and manly power hath he obtained whom Vaja, Vibhvan, Rbhus have looked kindly on.

verses.sa:
श्रेष्ठं वः पेशो अधि धायि दर्शतं स्तोमो वाजा ऋभवस्तं जुजुष्टन ।
धीरासो हि ष्ठा कवयो विपश्चितस्तान् व एना ब्रह्मणा वेदयामसि॥
verses.tr: śreṣṭhaṃ vaḥ peśo adhi dhāyi darśataṃ stomo vājā ṛbhavastaṃ jujuṣṭana dhīrāso hi ṣṭhā kavayo vipaścitastān va enā brahmaṇā vedayāmasi
verses.en: To you hath been assigned the fairest ornament, the hymn of praise: Vajas and Rbhus, joy therein; For ye have lore and wisdom and poetic skill: as such, with this our prayer we call on you to come.

verses.sa:
यूयमस्मभ्यं धिषणाभ्यस्परि विद्वांसो विश्वा नर्याणि भोजना ।
द्युमन्तं वाजं वृषशुष्ममुत्तममा नो रयिमृभवस्तक्षता वयः॥
verses.tr: yūyamasmabhyaṃ dhiṣaṇābhyaspari vidvāṃso viśvā naryāṇi bhojanā dyumantaṃ vājaṃ vṛṣaśuṣmamuttamamā no rayimṛbhavastakṣatā vayaḥ
verses.en: According to the wishes of our hearts may ye, who have full knowledge of all the delights of men, Fashion for us, O Rbhus, power and splendid wealth, rich in high courage, excellent, and vital strength.

verses.sa:
इह प्रजामिह रयिं रराणा इह श्रवो वीरवत् तक्षता नः ।
येन वयं चितयेमात्यन्यान् तं वाजं चित्रमृभवो ददा नः॥
verses.tr: iha prajāmiha rayiṃ rarāṇā iha śravo vīravat takṣatā naḥ yena vayaṃ citayemātyanyān taṃ vājaṃ citramṛbhavo dadā naḥ
verses.en: Bestowing on us here riches and offspring, here fashion fame for us befitting heroes. Vouchsafe us wealth of splendid sort, O Rbhus, that we may make us more renowned than others.

verses.sa:
उप नो वाजा अध्वरमृभुक्षा देवा यात पथिभिर्देवयानैः ।
यथा यज्ञं मनुषो विक्ष्वा३सु दधिध्वे रण्वाः सुदिनेष्वह्नाम्॥
verses.tr: upa no vājā adhvaramṛbhukṣā devā yāta pathibhirdevayānaiḥ yathā yajñaṃ manuṣo vikṣvā3su dadhidhve raṇvāḥ sudineṣvahnām
verses.en: Come to our sacrifice, Vajas, Rbhuksans, Gods, by the paths which Gods are wont to travel, As ye, gay Gods, accept in splendid weather the sacrifice among these folk of Manus.

verses.sa:
ते वो हृदे मनसे सन्तु यज्ञा जुष्टासो अद्य घृतनिर्णिजो गुः ।
प्र वः सुतासो हरयन्त पूर्णाः क्रत्वे दक्षाय हर्षयन्त पीताः॥
verses.tr: te vo hṛde manase santu yajñā juṣṭāso adya ghṛtanirṇijo guḥ pra vaḥ sutāso harayanta pūrṇāḥ kratve dakṣāya harṣayanta pītāḥ
verses.en: May these rites please you in your heart and spirit; may the drops clothed in oil this day approach you. May the abundant juices bear you onward to power and strength, and, when imbibed, delight you.

verses.sa:
त्र्युदायं देवहितं यथा वः स्तोमो वाजा ऋभुक्षणो ददे वः ।
जुह्वे मनुष्वदुपरासु विक्षु युष्मे सचा बृहद्दिवेषु सोमम्॥
verses.tr: tryudāyaṃ devahitaṃ yathā vaḥ stomo vājā ṛbhukṣaṇo dade vaḥ juhve manuṣvaduparāsu vikṣu yuṣme sacā bṛhaddiveṣu somam
verses.en: Your threefold going near is God-appointed, so praise is given you, Vajas and Rbhuksans. So, Manus-like, mid younger folk I offer, to you who are aloft in heaven, the Soma.

verses.sa:
पीवोअश्वाः शुचद्रथा हि भूताऽयःशिप्रा वाजिनः सुनिष्काः ।
इन्द्रस्य सूनो शवसो नपातोऽनु वश्चेत्यग्रियं मदाय॥
verses.tr: pīvoaśvāḥ śucadrathā hi bhūtā'yaḥśiprā vājinaḥ suniṣkāḥ indrasya sūno śavaso napāto'nu vaścetyagriyaṃ madāya
verses.en: Strong, with fair chains of gold and jaws of iron, ye have a splendid car and well-fed horses. Ye Sons of Strength, ye progeny of Indra, to you the best is offered to delight you.

verses.sa:
ऋभुमृभुक्षणो रयिं वाजे वाजिन्तमं युजम् ।
इन्द्रस्वन्तं हवामहे सदासातममश्विनम्॥
verses.tr: ṛbhumṛbhukṣaṇo rayiṃ vāje vājintamaṃ yujam indrasvantaṃ havāmahe sadāsātamamaśvinam
verses.en: Rbhuksans! him, for handy wealth, the mightiest comrade in the fight, Him, Indra's equal, we invoke, most bounteous ever, rich in steeds.

verses.sa:
सेदृभवो यमवथ यूयमिन्द्रश्च मर्त्यम् ।
स धीभिरस्तु सनिता मेधसाता सो अर्वता॥
verses.tr: sedṛbhavo yamavatha yūyamindraśca martyam sa dhībhirastu sanitā medhasātā so arvatā
verses.en: The mortal man whom, Rbhus, ye and Indra favour with your help, Must be successful, by his thoughts, at sacrifice and with the steed.

verses.sa:
वि नो वाजा ऋभुक्षणः पथश्चितन यष्टवे ।
अस्मभ्यं सूरयः स्तुता विश्वा आशास्तरीषणि॥
verses.tr: vi no vājā ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ pathaścitana yaṣṭave asmabhyaṃ sūrayaḥ stutā viśvā āśāstarīṣaṇi
verses.en: O Vajas and Rbhuksans, free for us the paths to sacrifice, Ye Princes, lauded, that we may press forward to each point of heaven.

verses.sa:
तं नो वाजा ऋभुक्षण इन्द्र नासत्या रयिम् ।
समश्वं चर्षणिभ्य आ पुरु शस्त मघत्तये॥
verses.tr: taṃ no vājā ṛbhukṣaṇa indra nāsatyā rayim samaśvaṃ carṣaṇibhya ā puru śasta maghattaye
verses.en: O Vajas and Rbhuksans, ye Nasatyas, Indra, bless this wealth, And, before other men's, the steed, that ample riches may be won.

verses.sa:
उतो हि वां दात्रा सन्ति पूर्वा या पूरुभ्यस्त्रसदस्युर्नितोशे ।
क्षेत्रासां ददथुरुर्वरासां घनं दस्युभ्यो अभिभूतिमुग्रम्॥
verses.tr: uto hi vāṃ dātrā santi pūrvā yā pūrubhyastrasadasyurnitośe kṣetrāsāṃ dadathururvarāsāṃ ghanaṃ dasyubhyo abhibhūtimugram
verses.en: From you two came the gifts in days aforetime which Trasadasyu granted to the Purus. Ye gave the winner of our fields and plough-lands, and the strong smiter who subdued the Dasytis.

verses.sa:
उत वाजिनं पुरुनिष्षिध्वानं दधिक्रामु ददथुर्विश्वकृष्टिम् ।
ऋजिप्यं श्येनं प्रुषितप्सुमाशुं चर्कृत्यमर्यो नृपतिं न शूरम्॥
verses.tr: uta vājinaṃ puruniṣṣidhvānaṃ dadhikrāmu dadathurviśvakṛṣṭim ṛjipyaṃ śyenaṃ pruṣitapsumāśuṃ carkṛtyamaryo nṛpatiṃ na śūram
verses.en: And ye gave mighty Dadhikras, the giver of many gifts, who visiteth all people, Impetuous hawk, swift and of varied colour, like a brave King whom each true man must honour.

verses.sa:
यं सीमनु प्रवतेव द्रवन्तं विश्वः पूरुर्मदति हर्षमाणः ।
पड्भिर्गृध्यन्तं मेधयुं न शूरं रथतुरं वातमिव ध्रजन्तम्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ sīmanu pravateva dravantaṃ viśvaḥ pūrurmadati harṣamāṇaḥ paḍbhirgṛdhyantaṃ medhayuṃ na śūraṃ rathaturaṃ vātamiva dhrajantam
verses.en: Whom, as 'twere down a precipice, swift rushing, each Puru praises and his heart rejoices,- Springing forth like a hero fain for battle, whirling the car and flying like the tempest.

verses.sa:
यः स्मारुन्धानो गध्या समत्सु सनुतरश्चरति गोषु गच्छन् ।
आविर्ऋजीको विदथा निचिक्यत् तिरो अरतिं पर्याप आयोः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ smārundhāno gadhyā samatsu sanutaraścarati goṣu gacchan āvirṛjīko vidathā nicikyat tiro aratiṃ paryāpa āyoḥ
verses.en: Who gaineth precious booty in the combats and moveth, winning spoil, among the cattle; Shown in bright colour, looking on the assemblies, beyond the churl, to worship of the living.

verses.sa:
उत स्मैनं वस्त्रमथिं न तायुमनु क्रोशन्ति क्षितयो भरेषु ।
नीचायमानं जसुरिं न श्येनं श्रवश्चाच्छा पशुमच्च यूथम्॥
verses.tr: uta smainaṃ vastramathiṃ na tāyumanu krośanti kṣitayo bhareṣu nīcāyamānaṃ jasuriṃ na śyenaṃ śravaścācchā paśumacca yūtham
verses.en: Loudly the folk cry after him in battles, as 'twere a thief who steals away a garment; Speeding to glory, or a herd of cattle, even as a hungry falcon swooping downward.

verses.sa:
उत स्मासु प्रथमः सरिष्यन् नि वेवेति श्रेणिभी रथानाम् ।
स्रजं कृण्वानो जन्यो न शुभ्वा रेणुं रेरिहत् किरणं ददश्वान्॥
verses.tr: uta smāsu prathamaḥ sariṣyan ni veveti śreṇibhī rathānām srajaṃ kṛṇvāno janyo na śubhvā reṇuṃ rerihat kiraṇaṃ dadaśvān
verses.en: And, fain to come forth first amid these armies, this way and that with rows of cars he rushes, Gay like a bridesman, making him a garland, tossing the dust, champing the rein that holds him.

verses.sa:
उत स्य वाजी सहुरिर्ऋतावा शुश्रूषमाणस्तन्वा समर्ये ।
तुरं यतीषु तुरयन्नृजिप्योऽधि भ्रुवोः किरते रेणुमृञ्जन्॥
verses.tr: uta sya vājī sahurirṛtāvā śuśrūṣamāṇastanvā samarye turaṃ yatīṣu turayannṛjipyo'dhi bhruvoḥ kirate reṇumṛñjan
verses.en: And that strong Steed, victorious and faithful, obedient with his body in the combat, Speeding straight on amid the swiftly pressing, casts o'er his brows the dust he tosses upward.

verses.sa:
उत स्मास्य तन्यतोरिव द्योर्ऋघायतो अभियुजो भयन्ते ।
यदा सहस्रमभि षीमयोधीद् दुर्वर्तुः स्मा भवति भीम ऋञ्जन्॥
verses.tr: uta smāsya tanyatoriva dyorṛghāyato abhiyujo bhayante yadā sahasramabhi ṣīmayodhīd durvartuḥ smā bhavati bhīma ṛñjan
verses.en: And at his thunder, like the roar of heaven, those who attack tremble and are affrighted; For when he fights against embattled thousands, dread is he in his striving; none may stay him.

verses.sa:
उत स्मास्य पनयन्ति जना जूतिं कृष्टिप्रो अभिभूतिमाशोः ।
उतैनमाहुः समिथे वियन्तः परा दधिक्रा असरत् सहस्रैः॥
verses.tr: uta smāsya panayanti janā jūtiṃ kṛṣṭipro abhibhūtimāśoḥ utainamāhuḥ samithe viyantaḥ parā dadhikrā asarat sahasraiḥ
verses.en: The people praise the overpowering swiftness of this fleet Steed who giveth men abundance. Of him they say when drawing back from battle. Dadhikras hath sped forward with his thousands.

verses.sa:
आ दधिक्राः शवसा पञ्च कृष्टीः सूर्य इव ज्योतिषापस्ततान ।
सहस्रसाः शतसा वाज्यर्वा पृणक्तु मध्वा समिमा वचांसि॥
verses.tr: ā dadhikrāḥ śavasā pañca kṛṣṭīḥ sūrya iva jyotiṣāpastatāna sahasrasāḥ śatasā vājyarvā pṛṇaktu madhvā samimā vacāṃsi
verses.en: Dadhikras hath o'erspread the Fivefold People with vigour, as the Sun lightens the waters. May the strong Steed who winneth hundreds, thousands, requite with sweetness these my words and praises.

verses.sa:
आशुं दधिक्रां तमु नु ष्टवाम दिवस्पृथिव्या उत चर्किराम ।
उच्छन्तीर्मामुषसः सूदयन्त्वति विश्वानि दुरितानि पर्षन्॥
verses.tr: āśuṃ dadhikrāṃ tamu nu ṣṭavāma divaspṛthivyā uta carkirāma ucchantīrmāmuṣasaḥ sūdayantvati viśvāni duritāni parṣan
verses.en: Now give we praise to Dadhikras the rapid, and mention in our laud the Earth and Heaven. May the Dawns flushing move me to exertion, and bear me safely over every trouble.

verses.sa:
महश्चर्कर्म्यर्वतः क्रतुप्रा दधिक्राव्णः पुरुवारस्य वृष्णः ।
यं पूरुभ्यो दीदिवांसं नाग्निं ददथुर्मित्रावरुणा ततुरिम्॥
verses.tr: mahaścarkarmyarvataḥ kratuprā dadhikrāvṇaḥ puruvārasya vṛṣṇaḥ yaṃ pūrubhyo dīdivāṃsaṃ nāgniṃ dadathurmitrāvaruṇā taturim
verses.en: I praise the mighty Steed who fills my spirit, the Stallion Dadhikravan rich in bounties, Whom, swift of foot and shining bright as Agni, ye, Varuna and Mitra, gave to Purus.

verses.sa:
यो अश्वस्य दधिक्राव्णो अकारीत् समिद्धे अग्ना उषसो व्युष्टौ ।
अनागसं तमदितिः कृणोतु स मित्रेण वरुणेना सजोषाः॥
verses.tr: yo aśvasya dadhikrāvṇo akārīt samiddhe agnā uṣaso vyuṣṭau anāgasaṃ tamaditiḥ kṛṇotu sa mitreṇa varuṇenā sajoṣāḥ
verses.en: Him who hath honoured, when the flame is kindled at break of dawn, the Courser Dadhikrivan, Him, of one mind with Varuna and Mitra may Aditi make free from all transgression.

verses.sa:
दधिक्राव्ण इष ऊर्जो महो यदमन्महि मरुतां नाम भद्रम् ।
स्वस्तये वरुणं मित्रमग्निं हवामह इन्द्रं वज्रबाहुम्॥
verses.tr: dadhikrāvṇa iṣa ūrjo maho yadamanmahi marutāṃ nāma bhadram svastaye varuṇaṃ mitramagniṃ havāmaha indraṃ vajrabāhum
verses.en: When we remember mighty Dadhikravan our food and strength, then the blest name of Maruts, Varuna, Mitra, we invoke for welfare, and Agni, and the thunder-wielding Indra.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिवेदुभये वि ह्वयन्त उदीराणा यज्ञमुपप्रयन्तः ।
दधिक्रामु सूदनं मर्त्याय ददथुर्मित्रावरुणा नो अश्वम्॥
verses.tr: indramivedubhaye vi hvayanta udīrāṇā yajñamupaprayantaḥ dadhikrāmu sūdanaṃ martyāya dadathurmitrāvaruṇā no aśvam
verses.en: Both sides invoke him as they call on Indra when they stir forth and turn to sacrificing. To us have Varuna and Mitra granted the Courser Dadhikris, a guide for mortals.

verses.sa:
दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषं जिष्णोरश्वस्य वाजिनः ।
सुरभि नो मुखा करत् प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत्॥
verses.tr: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ surabhi no mukhā karat pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
verses.en: So have I glorified with praise strong Dadhikravan, conquering Steed. Sweet may he make our mouths; may he prolong the days we have to live.

verses.sa:
दधिक्राव्ण इदु नु चर्किराम विश्वा इन्मामुषसः सूदयन्तु ।
अपामग्नेरुषसः सूर्यस्य बृहस्पतेराङ्गिरसस्य जिष्णोः॥
verses.tr: dadhikrāvṇa idu nu carkirāma viśvā inmāmuṣasaḥ sūdayantu apāmagneruṣasaḥ sūryasya bṛhaspaterāṅgirasasya jiṣṇoḥ
verses.en: Let us recite the praise of Dadhikravan: may all the Mornings move me to exertion; Praise of the Lord of Waters, Dawn, and Agni, Brhaspati Son of Angiras, and Surya.

verses.sa:
सत्वा भरिषो गविषो दुवन्यसच्छ्रवस्यादिष उषसस्तुरण्यसत् ।
सत्यो द्रवो द्रवरः पतंगरो दधिक्रावेषमूर्जं स्वर्जनत्॥
verses.tr: satvā bhariṣo gaviṣo duvanyasacchravasyādiṣa uṣasasturaṇyasat satyo dravo dravaraḥ pataṃgaro dadhikrāveṣamūrjaṃ svarjanat
verses.en: Brave, seeking war and booty, dwelling with the good and with the swift, may he hasten the food of Dawn. May he the true, the fleet, the lover of the course, the bird-like Dadhikravan, bring food, strength, and light.

verses.sa:
उत स्मास्य द्रवतस्तुरण्यतः पर्णं न वेरनु वाति प्रगर्धिनः ।
श्येनस्येव ध्रजतो अङ्कसं परि दधिक्राव्णः सहोर्जा तरित्रतः॥
verses.tr: uta smāsya dravatasturaṇyataḥ parṇaṃ na veranu vāti pragardhinaḥ śyenasyeva dhrajato aṅkasaṃ pari dadhikrāvṇaḥ sahorjā taritrataḥ
verses.en: His pinion, rapid runner, fans him m his way, as of a bird that hastens onward to its aim, And, as it were a falcon's gliding through the air, strikes Dadhikravan's side as he speeds on with might.

verses.sa:
उत स्य वाजी क्षिपणिं तुरण्यति ग्रीवायां बद्धो अपिकक्ष आसनि ।
क्रतुं दधिक्रा अनु संतवीत्वत् पथामङ्कांस्यन्वापनीफणत्॥
verses.tr: uta sya vājī kṣipaṇiṃ turaṇyati grīvāyāṃ baddho apikakṣa āsani kratuṃ dadhikrā anu saṃtavītvat pathāmaṅkāṃsyanvāpanīphaṇat
verses.en: Bound by the neck and by the flanks and by the mouth, the vigorous Courser lends new swiftness to his speed. Drawing himself together, as his strength allows, Dadhikras springs along the windings of the paths.

verses.sa:
हंसः शुचिषद् वसुरन्तरिक्षसद्धोता वेदिषदतिथिर्दुरोणसत् ।
नृषद्वरसदृतसद् व्योमसदब्जा गोजा ऋतजा अद्रिजा ऋतम्॥
verses.tr: haṃsaḥ śuciṣad vasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirduroṇasat nṛṣadvarasadṛtasad vyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtam
verses.en: The Hamsa homed in light, the Vasu in mid-air, the priest beside the altar, in the house the guest, Dweller in noblest place, mid men, in truth, in sky, born of flood, kine, truth, mountain, he is holy Law.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा को वां वरुणा सुम्नमाप स्तोमो हविष्माँ अमृतो न होता ।
यो वां हृदि क्रतुमाँ अस्मदुक्तः पस्पर्शदिन्द्रावरुणा नमस्वान्॥
verses.tr: indrā ko vāṃ varuṇā sumnamāpa stomo haviṣmāṃ amṛto na hotā yo vāṃ hṛdi kratumāṃ asmaduktaḥ pasparśadindrāvaruṇā namasvān
verses.en: What laud, O Indra-Varuna, with oblation, hath like the Immortal Priest obtained your favour? Hath our effectual laud, addressed with homage, touched you, O Indra-Varuna, in spirit?

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा ह यो वरुणा चक्र आपी देवौ मर्तः सख्याय प्रयस्वान् ।
स हन्ति वृत्रा समिथेषु शत्रूनवोभिर्वा महद्भिः स प्र शृण्वे॥
verses.tr: indrā ha yo varuṇā cakra āpī devau martaḥ sakhyāya prayasvān sa hanti vṛtrā samitheṣu śatrūnavobhirvā mahadbhiḥ sa pra śṛṇve
verses.en: He who with dainty food hath won you, Indra and Varuna, Gods, as his allies to friendship, Jayeth the Vrtras and his foes in battles, and through your mighty favours is made famous.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा ह रत्नं वरुणा धेष्ठेत्था नृभ्यः शशमानेभ्यस्ता ।
यदी सखाया सख्याय सोमैः सुतेभिः सुप्रयसा मादयैते॥
verses.tr: indrā ha ratnaṃ varuṇā dheṣṭhetthā nṛbhyaḥ śaśamānebhyastā yadī sakhāyā sakhyāya somaiḥ sutebhiḥ suprayasā mādayaite
verses.en: Indra and Varuna are most liberal givers of treasure to the men who toil to serve them, When they, as Friends inclined to friendship, honoured with dainty food, delight in flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा युवं वरुणा दिद्युमस्मिन्नोजिष्ठमुग्रा नि वधिष्टं वज्रम् ।
यो नो दुरेवो वृकतिर्दभीतिस्तस्मिन् मिमाथामभिभूत्योजः॥
verses.tr: indrā yuvaṃ varuṇā didyumasminnojiṣṭhamugrā ni vadhiṣṭaṃ vajram yo no durevo vṛkatirdabhītistasmin mimāthāmabhibhūtyojaḥ
verses.en: Indra and Varuna, ye hurl, O Mighty, on him your strongest flashing bolt of thunder Who treats us ill, the robber and oppressor: measure on him your overwhelming vigour.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा युवं वरुणा भूतमस्या धियः प्रेतारा वृषभेव धेनोः ।
सा नो दुहीयद् यवसेव गत्वी सहस्रधारा पयसा मही गौः॥
verses.tr: indrā yuvaṃ varuṇā bhūtamasyā dhiyaḥ pretārā vṛṣabheva dhenoḥ sā no duhīyad yavaseva gatvī sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, be ye the lovers of this my song, as steers who love the milch-Cow. Milk may it yield us as, gone forth to pasture, the great Cow pouring out her thousand rivers.

verses.sa:
तोके हिते तनय उर्वरासु सूरो दृशीके वृषणश्च पौंस्ये ।
इन्द्रा नो अत्र वरुणा स्यातामवोभिर्दस्मा परितक्म्यायाम्॥
verses.tr: toke hite tanaya urvarāsu sūro dṛśīke vṛṣaṇaśca pauṃsye indrā no atra varuṇā syātāmavobhirdasmā paritakmyāyām
verses.en: For fertile fields, for worthy sons and grandsons, for the Sun's beauty and for steer-like vigour, May Indra-Varuna with gracious favours work marvels for us in the stress of battle.

verses.sa:
युवामिद्ध्यवसे पूर्व्याय परि प्रभूती गविषः स्वापी ।
वृणीमहे सख्याय प्रियाय शूरा मंहिष्ठा पितरेव शम्भू॥
verses.tr: yuvāmiddhyavase pūrvyāya pari prabhūtī gaviṣaḥ svāpī vṛṇīmahe sakhyāya priyāya śūrā maṃhiṣṭhā pitareva śambhū
verses.en: For you, as Princes, for your ancient kindness, good comrades of the man who seeks for booty, We choose to us for the dear bond of friendship, most liberal Heroes bringing bliss like parents.

verses.sa:
ता वां धियोऽवसे वाजयन्तीराजिं न जग्मुर्युवयूः सुदानू ।
श्रिये न गाव उप सोममस्थुरिन्द्रं गिरो वरुणं मे मनीषाः॥
verses.tr: tā vāṃ dhiyo'vase vājayantīrājiṃ na jagmuryuvayūḥ sudānū śriye na gāva upa somamasthurindraṃ giro varuṇaṃ me manīṣāḥ
verses.en: Showing their strength, these hymns for grace, Free-givers I have gone to you, devoted, as to battle. For glory have they gone, as milk to Soma, to Indra-Varuna my thoughts and praises.

verses.sa:
इमा इन्द्रं वरुणं मे मनीषा अग्मन्नुप द्रविणमिच्छमानाः ।
उपेमस्थुर्जोष्टार इव वस्वो रघ्वीरिव श्रवसो भिक्षमाणाः॥
verses.tr: imā indraṃ varuṇaṃ me manīṣā agmannupa draviṇamicchamānāḥ upemasthurjoṣṭāra iva vasvo raghvīriva śravaso bhikṣamāṇāḥ
verses.en: To Indra and to Varuna, desirous of gaining wealth have these my thoughts proceeded. They have come nigh to you as treasure lovers, like mares, fleet-footed, eager for the glory.

verses.sa:
अश्व्यस्य त्मना रथ्यस्य पुष्टेर्नित्यस्य रायः पतयः स्याम ।
ता चक्राणा ऊतिभिर्नव्यसीभिरस्मत्रा रायो नियुतः सचन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: aśvyasya tmanā rathyasya puṣṭernityasya rāyaḥ patayaḥ syāma tā cakrāṇā ūtibhirnavyasībhirasmatrā rāyo niyutaḥ sacantām
verses.en: May we ourselves be lords of during riches, of ample sustenance for car and hones. So may the Twain who work with newest succours bring yoked teams hitherward to us and riches.

verses.sa:
आ नो बृहन्ता बृहतीभिरूती इन्द्र यातं वरुण वाजसातौ ।
यद् दिद्यवः पृतनासु प्रक्रीळान् तस्य वां स्याम सनितार आजेः॥
verses.tr: ā no bṛhantā bṛhatībhirūtī indra yātaṃ varuṇa vājasātau yad didyavaḥ pṛtanāsu prakrīḻān tasya vāṃ syāma sanitāra ājeḥ
verses.en: Come with your mighty succours, O ye Mighty; come, Indra-Varuna, to us in battle. What time the flashing arrows play in combat, may we through you be winners in the contest.

verses.sa:
मम द्विता राष्ट्रं क्षत्रियस्य विश्वायोर्विश्वे अमृता यथा नः ।
क्रतुं सचन्ते वरुणस्य देवा राजामि कृष्टेरुपमस्य वव्रेः॥
verses.tr: mama dvitā rāṣṭraṃ kṣatriyasya viśvāyorviśve amṛtā yathā naḥ kratuṃ sacante varuṇasya devā rājāmi kṛṣṭerupamasya vavreḥ
verses.en: I AM the royal Ruler, mine is empire, as mine who sway all life are all Immortals. Varuna's will the Gods obey and follow. I am the King of men's most lofty cover.

verses.sa:
अहं राजा वरुणो मह्यं तान्यसुर्याणि प्रथमा धारयन्त ।
क्रतुं सचन्ते वरुणस्य देवा राजामि कृष्टेरुपमस्य वव्रेः॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ rājā varuṇo mahyaṃ tānyasuryāṇi prathamā dhārayanta kratuṃ sacante varuṇasya devā rājāmi kṛṣṭerupamasya vavreḥ
verses.en: I am King Varuna. To me were given these first existing high celestial powers. Varuna's will the Gods obey and follow. I am the King of men's most lofty cover.

verses.sa:
अहमिन्द्रो वरुणस्ते महित्वोर्वी गभीरे रजसी सुमेके ।
त्वष्टेव विश्वा भुवनानि विद्वान् त्समैरयं रोदसी धारयं च॥
verses.tr: ahamindro varuṇaste mahitvorvī gabhīre rajasī sumeke tvaṣṭeva viśvā bhuvanāni vidvān tsamairayaṃ rodasī dhārayaṃ ca
verses.en: I Varuna am Indra: in their greatness, these the two wide deep fairly-fashioned regions, These the two world-halves have I, even as Tvastar knowing all beings, joined and held together.

verses.sa:
अहमपो अपिन्वमुक्षमाणा धारयं दिवं सदन ऋतस्य ।
ऋतेन पुत्रो अदितेर्ऋतावोत त्रिधातु प्रथयद्वि भूम॥
verses.tr: ahamapo apinvamukṣamāṇā dhārayaṃ divaṃ sadana ṛtasya ṛtena putro aditerṛtāvota tridhātu prathayadvi bhūma
verses.en: I made to flow the moisture-shedding waters, and set the heaven firm in the scat of Order. By Law the Son of Aditi, Law Observer, hath spread abroad the world in threefold measure.

verses.sa:
मां नरः स्वश्वा वाजयन्तो मां वृताः समरणे हवन्ते ।
कृणोम्याजिं मघवाहमिन्द्र इयर्मि रेणुमभिभूत्योजाः॥
verses.tr: māṃ naraḥ svaśvā vājayanto māṃ vṛtāḥ samaraṇe havante kṛṇomyājiṃ maghavāhamindra iyarmi reṇumabhibhūtyojāḥ
verses.en: Heroes with noble horses, fain for battle, selected warriors, call on me in combat. I Indra Maghavan, excite the conflict; I stir the dust, Lord of surpassing vigour.

verses.sa:
अहं ता विश्वा चकरं नकिर्मा दैव्यं सहो वरते अप्रतीतम् ।
यन्मा सोमासो ममदन्यदुक्थोभे भयेते रजसी अपारे॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ tā viśvā cakaraṃ nakirmā daivyaṃ saho varate apratītam yanmā somāso mamadanyadukthobhe bhayete rajasī apāre
verses.en: All this I did. The Gods' own conquering power never impedeth me whom none opposeth. When lauds and Soma juice have made me joyful, both the unbounded regions are affrighted.

verses.sa:
विदुष्टे विश्वा भुवनानि तस्य ता प्र ब्रवीषि वरुणाय वेधः ।
त्वं वृत्राणि शृण्विषे जघन्वान् त्वं वृताँ अरिणा इन्द्र सिन्धून्॥
verses.tr: viduṣṭe viśvā bhuvanāni tasya tā pra bravīṣi varuṇāya vedhaḥ tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi śṛṇviṣe jaghanvān tvaṃ vṛtāṃ ariṇā indra sindhūn
verses.en: All beings know these deeds of thine thou tellest this unto Varuna, thou great Disposer! Thou art renowned as having slain the Vrtras. Thou madest flow the floods that were obstructed.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमत्र पितरस्त आसन् त्सप्त ऋषयो दौर्गहे बध्यमाने ।
त आयजन्त त्रसदस्युमस्या इन्द्रं न वृत्रतुरमर्धदेवम्॥
verses.tr: asmākamatra pitarasta āsan tsapta ṛṣayo daurgahe badhyamāne ta āyajanta trasadasyumasyā indraṃ na vṛtraturamardhadevam
verses.en: Our fathers then were these, the Seven his, what time the son of Durgaha was captive. For her they gained by sacrifice Trasadasyu, a demi-god, like Indra, conquering foemen.

verses.sa:
पुरुकुत्सानी हि वामदाशद्धव्येभिरिन्द्रावरुणा नमोभिः ।
अथा राजानं त्रसदस्युमस्या वृत्रहणं ददथुरर्धदेवम्॥
verses.tr: purukutsānī hi vāmadāśaddhavyebhirindrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ athā rājānaṃ trasadasyumasyā vṛtrahaṇaṃ dadathurardhadevam
verses.en: The spouse of Purukutsa gave oblations to you, O Indra-Varuna, with homage. Then unto her ye gave King Trasadasyu, the demi-god, the slayer of the foeman.

verses.sa:
राया वयं ससवांसो मदेम हव्येन देवा यवसेन गावः ।
तां धेनुमिन्द्रावरुणा युवं नो विश्वाहा धत्तमनपस्फुरन्तीम्॥
verses.tr: rāyā vayaṃ sasavāṃso madema havyena devā yavasena gāvaḥ tāṃ dhenumindrāvaruṇā yuvaṃ no viśvāhā dhattamanapasphurantīm
verses.en: May we, possessing much, delight in riches, Gods in oblations and the kine in pasture; And that Milch-cow who shrinks not from the milking, O Indra-Varuna, give to us daily.

verses.sa:
क उ श्रवत्कतमो यज्ञियानां वन्दारु देवः कतमो जुषाते ।
कस्येमां देवीममृतेषु प्रेष्ठां हृदि श्रेषाम सुष्टुतिं सुहव्याम्॥
verses.tr: ka u śravatkatamo yajñiyānāṃ vandāru devaḥ katamo juṣāte kasyemāṃ devīmamṛteṣu preṣṭhāṃ hṛdi śreṣāma suṣṭutiṃ suhavyām
verses.en: Who will hear, who of those who merit worship, which of all Gods take pleasure in our homage? On whose heart shall we lay this laud celestial, rich with fair offerings, dearest to Immortals?

verses.sa:
को मृळाति कतम आगमिष्ठो देवानामु कतमः शम्भविष्ठः ।
रथं कमाहुर्द्रवदश्वमाशुं यं सूर्यस्य दुहितावृणीत॥
verses.tr: ko mṛḻāti katama āgamiṣṭho devānāmu katamaḥ śambhaviṣṭhaḥ rathaṃ kamāhurdravadaśvamāśuṃ yaṃ sūryasya duhitāvṛṇīta
verses.en: Who will be gracious? Who will come most quickly of all the Gods? Who will bring bliss most largely? What car do they call swift with rapid coursers? That which the Daughter of the Sun elected.

verses.sa:
मक्षू हि ष्मा गच्छथ ईवतो द्यूनिन्द्रो न शक्तिं परितक्म्यायाम् ।
दिव आजाता दिव्या सुपर्णा कया शचीनां भवथः शचिष्ठा॥
verses.tr: makṣū hi ṣmā gacchatha īvato dyūnindro na śaktiṃ paritakmyāyām diva ājātā divyā suparṇā kayā śacīnāṃ bhavathaḥ śaciṣṭhā
verses.en: So many days do ye come swiftly hither, as Indra to give help in stress of battle. Descended from the sky, divine, strong-pinioned, by which of all your powers are ye most mighty?

verses.sa:
का वां भूदुपमातिः कया न आश्विना गमथो हूयमाना ।
को वां महश्चित् त्यजसो अभीक उरुष्यतं माध्वी दस्रा न ऊती॥
verses.tr: kā vāṃ bhūdupamātiḥ kayā na āśvinā gamatho hūyamānā ko vāṃ mahaścit tyajaso abhīka uruṣyataṃ mādhvī dasrā na ūtī
verses.en: What is the prayer that we should bring you, Asvins, whereby ye come to us when invocated? Whether of you confronts e'en great betrayal? Lovers of sweetness, Dasras, help and save us.

verses.sa:
उरु वां रथः परि नक्षति द्यामा यत् समुद्रादभि वर्तते वाम् ।
मध्वा माध्वी मधु वां प्रुषायन् यत् सीं वां पृक्षो भुरजन्त पक्वाः॥
verses.tr: uru vāṃ rathaḥ pari nakṣati dyāmā yat samudrādabhi vartate vām madhvā mādhvī madhu vāṃ pruṣāyan yat sīṃ vāṃ pṛkṣo bhurajanta pakvāḥ
verses.en: In the wide space your chariot reacheth heaven, what time it turneth hither from the ocean. Sweets from your sweet shall drop, lovers of sweetness! These have they dressed for you as dainty viands.

verses.sa:
सिन्धुर्ह वां रसया सिञ्चदश्वान् घृणा वयोऽरुषासः परि ग्मन् ।
तदू षु वामजिरं चेति यानं येन पती भवथः सूर्यायाः॥
verses.tr: sindhurha vāṃ rasayā siñcadaśvān ghṛṇā vayo'ruṣāsaḥ pari gman tadū ṣu vāmajiraṃ ceti yānaṃ yena patī bhavathaḥ sūryāyāḥ
verses.en: Let Sindhu with his wave bedew your horses: in fiery glow have the red birds come hither. Observed of all was that your rapid going, whereby ye were the Lords of Siirya's Daughter.

verses.sa:
इहेह यद् वां समना पपृक्षे सेयमस्मे सुमतिर्वाजरत्ना ।
उरुष्यतं जरितारं युवं ह श्रितः कामो नासत्या युवद्रिक्॥
verses.tr: iheha yad vāṃ samanā papṛkṣe seyamasme sumatirvājaratnā uruṣyataṃ jaritāraṃ yuvaṃ ha śritaḥ kāmo nāsatyā yuvadrik
verses.en: Whene'er I gratified you here together, your grace was given us, O ye rich in booty. Protect, ye Twain, the singer of your praises: to you, Nasatyas, is my wish directed.

verses.sa:
तं वां रथं वयमद्या हुवेम पृथुज्रयमश्विना संगतिं गोः ।
यः सूर्यां वहति वन्धुरायुर्गिर्वाहसं पुरुतमं वसूयुम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ vāṃ rathaṃ vayamadyā huvema pṛthujrayamaśvinā saṃgatiṃ goḥ yaḥ sūryāṃ vahati vandhurāyurgirvāhasaṃ purutamaṃ vasūyum
verses.en: We will invoke this day your car, farspreading, O Asvins, even the gathering, of the sunlight,- Car praised in hymns, most ample, rich in treasure, fitted with seats, the car that beareth Surya.

verses.sa:
युवं श्रियमश्विना देवता तां दिवो नपाता वनथः शचीभिः ।
युवोर्वपुरभि पृक्षः सचन्ते वहन्ति यत् ककुहासो रथे वाम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ śriyamaśvinā devatā tāṃ divo napātā vanathaḥ śacībhiḥ yuvorvapurabhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante vahanti yat kakuhāso rathe vām
verses.en: Asvins, ye gained that glory by your Godhead, ye Sons of Heaven, by your own might and power. Food followeth close upon your bright appearing when stately horses in your chariot draw you.

verses.sa:
को वामद्या करते रातहव्य ऊतये वा सुतपेयाय वार्कैः ।
ऋतस्य वा वनुषे पूर्व्याय नमो येमानो अश्विना ववर्तत्॥
verses.tr: ko vāmadyā karate rātahavya ūtaye vā sutapeyāya vārkaiḥ ṛtasya vā vanuṣe pūrvyāya namo yemāno aśvinā vavartat
verses.en: Who bringeth you to-day for help with offered oblation, or with hymns to drink the juices? Who, for the sacrifice's ancient lover, turneth you hither, Asvins, offering homage?

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययेन पुरुभू रथेनेमं यज्ञं नासत्योप यातम् ।
पिबाथ इन्मधुनः सोम्यस्य दधथो रत्नं विधते जनाय॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyayena purubhū rathenemaṃ yajñaṃ nāsatyopa yātam pibātha inmadhunaḥ somyasya dadhatho ratnaṃ vidhate janāya
verses.en: Borne on your golden car, ye omnipresent! come to this sacrifice of ours, Nasatyas. Drink of the pleasant liquor of the Soma give riches to the people who adore you.

verses.sa:
आ नो यातं दिवो अच्छा पृथिव्या हिरण्ययेन सुवृता रथेन ।
मा वामन्ये नि यमन् देवयन्तः सं यद् ददे नाभिः पूर्व्या वाम्॥
verses.tr: ā no yātaṃ divo acchā pṛthivyā hiraṇyayena suvṛtā rathena mā vāmanye ni yaman devayantaḥ saṃ yad dade nābhiḥ pūrvyā vām
verses.en: Come hitherward to us from earth, from heaven, borne on your golden chariot rolling lightly. Suffer not other worshippers to stay you here are ye bound by earlier bonds of friendship.

verses.sa:
नू नो रयिं पुरुवीरं बृहन्तं दस्रा मिमाथामुभयेष्वस्मे ।
नरो यद् वामश्विना स्तोममावन् त्सधस्तुतिमाजमीळहासो अग्मन्॥
verses.tr: nū no rayiṃ puruvīraṃ bṛhantaṃ dasrā mimāthāmubhayeṣvasme naro yad vāmaśvinā stomamāvan tsadhastutimājamīḻahāso agman
verses.en: Now for us both, mete out, O Wonder Workers, riches exceeding great with store of heroes, Because the men have sent you praise, O Asvins, and Ajamilhas come to the laudation.

verses.sa:
इहेह यद् वां समना पपृक्षे सेयमस्मे सुमतिर्वाजरत्ना ।
उरुष्यतं जरितारं युवं ह श्रितः कामो नासत्या युवद्रिक्॥
verses.tr: iheha yad vāṃ samanā papṛkṣe seyamasme sumatirvājaratnā uruṣyataṃ jaritāraṃ yuvaṃ ha śritaḥ kāmo nāsatyā yuvadrik
verses.en: Whene'er I gratified you here together, your grace was given us, O ye rich in booty. Protect, ye Twain, the singer of your praises: to you, Nasatyas, is my wish directed.

verses.sa:
एष स्य भानुरुदियर्ति युज्यते रथः परिज्मा दिवो अस्य सानवि ।
पृक्षासो अस्मिन् मिथुना अधि त्रयो दृतिस्तुरीयो मधुनो वि रप्शते॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya bhānurudiyarti yujyate rathaḥ parijmā divo asya sānavi pṛkṣāso asmin mithunā adhi trayo dṛtisturīyo madhuno vi rapśate
verses.en: Yonder goes up that light: your chariot is yoked that travels round upon the summit of this heaven. Within this car are stored three kindred shares of food, and a skin filled with meath is rustling as the fourth.

verses.sa:
उद् वां पृक्षासो मधुमन्त ईरते रथा अश्वास उषसो व्युष्टिषु ।
अपोर्णुवन्तस्तम आ परीवृतं स्व१र्ण शुक्रं तन्वन्त आ रजः॥
verses.tr: ud vāṃ pṛkṣāso madhumanta īrate rathā aśvāsa uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu aporṇuvantastama ā parīvṛtaṃ sva1rṇa śukraṃ tanvanta ā rajaḥ
verses.en: Forth come your viands rich with store of pleasant meath, and cars and horses at the flushing of the dawn, Stripping the covering from the surrounded gloom, and spreading through mid-air bright radiance like the Sun.

verses.sa:
मध्वः पिबतं मधुपेभिरासभिरुत प्रियं मधुने युञ्जाथां रथम् ।
आ वर्तनिं मधुना जिन्वथस्पथो दृतिं वहेथे मधुमन्तमश्विना॥
verses.tr: madhvaḥ pibataṃ madhupebhirāsabhiruta priyaṃ madhune yuñjāthāṃ ratham ā vartaniṃ madhunā jinvathaspatho dṛtiṃ vahethe madhumantamaśvinā
verses.en: Drink of the meath with lips accustomed to the draught; harness for the meath's sake the chariot that ye love. Refresh the way ye go, refresh the paths with meath: hither, O Asvins, bring the skin that holds the meath.

verses.sa:
हंसासो ये वां मधुमन्तो अस्रिधो हिरण्यपर्णा उहुव उषर्बुधः ।
उदप्रुतो मन्दिनो मन्दिनिस्पृशो मध्वो न मक्षः सवनानि गच्छथः॥
verses.tr: haṃsāso ye vāṃ madhumanto asridho hiraṇyaparṇā uhuva uṣarbudhaḥ udapruto mandino mandinispṛśo madhvo na makṣaḥ savanāni gacchathaḥ
verses.en: The swans ye have are friendly, rich in store of meath, gold-pinioned, strong to draw, awake at early morn, Swimming the flood, exultant, fain for draughts that cheer: ye come like flies to our libations of-the meath.

verses.sa:
स्वध्वरासो मधुमन्तो अग्नय उस्रा जरन्ते प्रति वस्तोरश्विना ।
यन्निक्तहस्तस्तरणिर्विचक्षणः सोमं सुषाव मधुमन्तमद्रिभिः॥
verses.tr: svadhvarāso madhumanto agnaya usrā jarante prati vastoraśvinā yanniktahastastaraṇirvicakṣaṇaḥ somaṃ suṣāva madhumantamadribhiḥ
verses.en: Well knowing solemn rites and rich in meath, the fires sing to the morning Asvins at the break of day, When with pure hands the prudent energetic priest hath with the stones pressed out the Soma rich in meath.

verses.sa:
आकेनिपासो अहभिर्दविध्वतः स्व१र्ण शुक्रं तन्वन्त आ रजः ।
सूरश्चिदश्वान् युयुजान ईयते विश्वाँ अनु स्वधया चेतथस्पथः॥
verses.tr: ākenipāso ahabhirdavidhvataḥ sva1rṇa śukraṃ tanvanta ā rajaḥ sūraścidaśvān yuyujāna īyate viśvāṃ anu svadhayā cetathaspathaḥ
verses.en: The rays advancing nigh, chasing with day the gloom, spread through the firmament bright radiance like the Sun; And the Sun harnessing his horses goeth forth: ye through your Godlike nature let his paths be known.

verses.sa:
प्र वामवोचमश्विना धियंधा रथः स्वश्वो अजरो यो अस्ति ।
येन सद्यः परि रजांसि याथो हविष्मन्तं तरणिं भोजमच्छ॥
verses.tr: pra vāmavocamaśvinā dhiyaṃdhā rathaḥ svaśvo ajaro yo asti yena sadyaḥ pari rajāṃsi yātho haviṣmantaṃ taraṇiṃ bhojamaccha
verses.en: Devout in thought I have declared, O Asvins, your chariot with good steeds, which lasts for ever, Wherewith ye travel swiftly through the regions to the prompt worshipper who brings oblation.

verses.sa: अग्रं पिबा मधूनां सुतं वायो दिविष्टिषु । त्वं हि पूर्वपा असि॥
verses.tr: agraṃ pibā madhūnāṃ sutaṃ vāyo diviṣṭiṣu tvaṃ hi pūrvapā asi
verses.en: Drink the best draught of Soma-juice, O Vayu, at our holy rites: For thou art he who drinketh first.

verses.sa: शतेना नो अभिष्टिभिर्नियुत्वाँ इन्द्रसारथिः । वायो सुतस्य तृम्पतम्॥
verses.tr: śatenā no abhiṣṭibhirniyutvāṃ indrasārathiḥ vāyo sutasya tṛmpatam
verses.en: Come, team-drawn, with thy hundred helps, with Indra, seated in the car, Vaya, and drink your fill of juice.

verses.sa: आ वां सहस्रं हरय इन्द्रवायू अभि प्रयः । वहन्तु सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ sahasraṃ haraya indravāyū abhi prayaḥ vahantu somapītaye
verses.en: May steeds a thousand bring you both, Indra. and Vayu, hitherward To drink the Soma, to the feagt.

verses.sa: रथं हिरण्यवन्धुरमिन्द्रवायू स्वध्वरम् । आ हि स्थाथो दिविस्पृशम्॥
verses.tr: rathaṃ hiraṇyavandhuramindravāyū svadhvaram ā hi sthātho divispṛśam
verses.en: For ye, O Indra-Vayu, mount the golden seated car that aids The sacrifice, that reaches heaven.

verses.sa: रथेन पृथुपाजसा दाश्वांसमुप गच्छतम् । इन्द्रवायू इहा गतम्॥
verses.tr: rathena pṛthupājasā dāśvāṃsamupa gacchatam indravāyū ihā gatam
verses.en: On far-refulgent chariot come unto the man who offers gifts: Come, Indra-Vayu, hitherward.

verses.sa: इन्द्रवायू अयं सुतस्तं देवेभिः सजोषसा । पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे॥
verses.tr: indravāyū ayaṃ sutastaṃ devebhiḥ sajoṣasā pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe
verses.en: Here, Indra-Vayu, is the juice: drink it, accordant with the Gods, Within the giver's dwelling-place.

verses.sa: इह प्रयाणमस्तु वामिन्द्रवायू विमोचनम् । इह वां सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: iha prayāṇamastu vāmindravāyū vimocanam iha vāṃ somapītaye
verses.en: Hither, O Indra-Vayu, be your journey here unyoke your steeds, Here for your draught of Soma juice.

verses.sa:
वायो शुक्रो अयामि ते मध्वो अग्रं दिविष्टिषु ।
आ याहि सोमपीतये स्पार्हो देव नियुत्वता॥
verses.tr: vāyo śukro ayāmi te madhvo agraṃ diviṣṭiṣu ā yāhi somapītaye spārho deva niyutvatā
verses.en: Vayu, the bright is offered thee, best of the meath at holy rites. Come thou to drink the Soma juice, God, longed-for, on thy team-drawn car.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रश्च वायवेषां सोमानां पीतिमर्हथः ।
युवां हि यन्तीन्दवो निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक्॥
verses.tr: indraśca vāyaveṣāṃ somānāṃ pītimarhathaḥ yuvāṃ hi yantīndavo nimnamāpo na sadhryak
verses.en: O Vayu, thou and Indra are meet drinkers of these Soma-draughts, For unto you the drops proceed as waters gather to the vale.

verses.sa:
वायविन्द्रश्च शुष्मिणा सरथं शवसस्पती ।
नियुत्वन्ता न ऊतय आ यातं सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: vāyavindraśca śuṣmiṇā sarathaṃ śavasaspatī niyutvantā na ūtaya ā yātaṃ somapītaye
verses.en: O Indra-Vayu, mighty Twain, speeding together, Lords of Strength, Come to our succour with your team, that ye may drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
या वां सन्ति पुरुस्पृहो नियुतो दाशुषे नरा ।
अस्मे ता यज्ञवाहसेन्द्रवायू नि यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: yā vāṃ santi puruspṛho niyuto dāśuṣe narā asme tā yajñavāhasendravāyū ni yacchatam
verses.en: The longed-for teams which ye possess, O Heroes, for the worshipper, Turn to us, Indra-Vayu, ye to whom the sacrifice is paid.

verses.sa:
विहि होत्रा अवीता विपो न रायो अर्यः ।
वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: vihi hotrā avītā vipo na rāyo aryaḥ vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye
verses.en: Taste offerings never tasted yet, as bards enjoy the foeman's wealth. O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.

verses.sa:
निर्युवाणो अशस्तीर्नियुत्वाँ इन्द्रसारथिः ।
वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: niryuvāṇo aśastīrniyutvāṃ indrasārathiḥ vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye
verses.en: Removing curses, drawn by teams, with Indra, seated by thy side, O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.

verses.sa:
अनु कृष्णे वसुधिती येमाते विश्वपेशसा ।
वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: anu kṛṣṇe vasudhitī yemāte viśvapeśasā vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye
verses.en: The two dark treasuries of wealth that wear all beauties wait on thee. O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.

verses.sa:
वहन्तु त्वा मनोयुजो युक्तासो नवतिर्नव ।
वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: vahantu tvā manoyujo yuktāso navatirnava vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye
verses.en: May nine-and-ninety harnessed steeds who yoke them at thy will bring thee. O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.

verses.sa:
वायो शतं हरीणां युवस्व पोष्याणाम् ।
उत वा ते सहस्रिणो रथ आ यातु पाजसा॥
verses.tr: vāyo śataṃ harīṇāṃ yuvasva poṣyāṇām uta vā te sahasriṇo ratha ā yātu pājasā
verses.en: Harness, O Vayu, to thy car a hundred well-fed tawny steeds, Yea, or a thousand steeds, and let thy chariot come to us with might.

verses.sa: इदं वामास्ये हविः प्रियमिन्द्राबृहस्पती । उक्थं मदश्च शस्यते॥
verses.tr: idaṃ vāmāsye haviḥ priyamindrābṛhaspatī ukthaṃ madaśca śasyate
verses.en: Dear is this offering in your mouth, O Indra and Brhaspati: Famed is the laud, the gladdening draught.

verses.sa: अयं वां परि षिच्यते सोम इन्द्राबृहस्पती । चारुर्मदाय पीतये॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vāṃ pari ṣicyate soma indrābṛhaspatī cārurmadāya pītaye
verses.en: This lovely Soma is effused, O Indra and Brhaspati, For you, to drink it and rejoice.

verses.sa: आ न इन्द्राबृहस्पती गृहमिन्द्रश्च गच्छतम् । सोमपा सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: ā na indrābṛhaspatī gṛhamindraśca gacchatam somapā somapītaye
verses.en: As Soma-drinkers to our house come, Indra and Brhaspati-and Indra-to drink Soma juice.

verses.sa: अस्मे इन्द्राबृहस्पती रयिं धत्तं शतग्विनम् । अश्वावन्तं सहस्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: asme indrābṛhaspatī rayiṃ dhattaṃ śatagvinam aśvāvantaṃ sahasriṇam
verses.en: Vouchsafe us riches hundredfold, O Indra, and Brhaspati, With store of horses, thousandfold.

verses.sa: इन्द्राबृहस्पती वयं सुते गीर्भिर्हवामहे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: indrābṛhaspatī vayaṃ sute gīrbhirhavāmahe asya somasya pītaye
verses.en: O Indra. and Brhaspati, we call you when the meath is shed, With songs, to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: सोममिन्द्राबृहस्पती पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे । मादयेथां तदोकसा॥
verses.tr: somamindrābṛhaspatī pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe mādayethāṃ tadokasā
verses.en: Drink, Indra and Brhaspati, the Soma in the giver's house: Delight yourselves abiding there.

verses.sa:
यस्तस्तम्भ सहसा वि ज्मो अन्तान् बृहस्पतिस्त्रिषधस्थो रवेण ।
तं प्रत्नास ऋषयो दीध्यानाः पुरो विप्रा दधिरे मन्द्रजिह्वम्॥
verses.tr: yastastambha sahasā vi jmo antān bṛhaspatistriṣadhastho raveṇa taṃ pratnāsa ṛṣayo dīdhyānāḥ puro viprā dadhire mandrajihvam
verses.en: Him who with might hath propped earth's ends, who sitteth in threefold seat, Brhaspati, with thunder, Him of the pleasant tongue have ancient sages, deep-thinking, holy singers, set before them.

verses.sa:
धुनेतयः सुप्रकेतं मदन्तो बृहस्पते अभि ये नस्ततस्रे ।
पृषन्तं सृप्रमदब्धमूर्वं बृहस्पते रक्षतादस्य योनिम्॥
verses.tr: dhunetayaḥ supraketaṃ madanto bṛhaspate abhi ye nastatasre pṛṣantaṃ sṛpramadabdhamūrvaṃ bṛhaspate rakṣatādasya yonim
verses.en: Wild in their course, in well-marked wise rejoicing were they, Brhaspati, who pressed around us. Preserve Brhaspati, the stall uninjured, this company's raining, ever-moving birthplace.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते या परमा परावदत आ त ऋतस्पृशो नि षेदुः ।
तुभ्यं खाता अवता अद्रिदुग्धा मध्वः श्चोतन्त्यभितो विरप्शम्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate yā paramā parāvadata ā ta ṛtaspṛśo ni ṣeduḥ tubhyaṃ khātā avatā adridugdhā madhvaḥ ścotantyabhito virapśam
verses.en: Brhaspati, from thy remotest distance have they sat down who love the law eternal. For thee were dug wells springing from the mountain, which murmuring round about pour streams of sweetness.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिः प्रथमं जायमानो महो ज्योतिषः परमे व्योमन् ।
सप्तास्यस्तुविजातो रवेण वि सप्तरश्मिरधमत् तमांसि॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāno maho jyotiṣaḥ parame vyoman saptāsyastuvijāto raveṇa vi saptaraśmiradhamat tamāṃsi
verses.en: Brhaspati, when first he had his being from mighty splendour in supremest heaven, Strong, with his sevenfold mouth, with noise of thunder, with his seven rays, blew and dispersed the darkness.

verses.sa:
स सुष्टुभा स ऋक्वता गणेन वलं रुरोज फलिगं रवेण ।
बृहस्पतिरुस्रिया हव्यसूदः कनिक्रदद् वावशतीरुदाजत्॥
verses.tr: sa suṣṭubhā sa ṛkvatā gaṇena valaṃ ruroja phaligaṃ raveṇa bṛhaspatirusriyā havyasūdaḥ kanikradad vāvaśatīrudājat
verses.en: With the loud-shouting band who sang his praises, with thunder, he destroyed obstructive Vala. Brhaspati thundering drave forth the cattle, the lowing cows who make oblations ready.

verses.sa:
एवा पित्रे विश्वदेवाय वृष्णे यज्ञैर्विधेम नमसा हविर्भिः ।
बृहस्पते सुप्रजा वीरवन्तो वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: evā pitre viśvadevāya vṛṣṇe yajñairvidhema namasā havirbhiḥ bṛhaspate suprajā vīravanto vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: Serve we with sacrifices, gifts, and homage even thus the Steer of all the Gods, the Father. Brhaspati, may we be lords of riches, with noble progeny and store of heroes.

verses.sa:
स इद् राजा प्रतिजन्यानि विश्वा शुष्मेण तस्थावभि वीर्येण ।
बृहस्पतिं यः सुभृतं बिभर्ति वल्गूयति वन्दते पूर्वभाजम्॥
verses.tr: sa id rājā pratijanyāni viśvā śuṣmeṇa tasthāvabhi vīryeṇa bṛhaspatiṃ yaḥ subhṛtaṃ bibharti valgūyati vandate pūrvabhājam
verses.en: Surely that King by power and might heroic hath made him lord of all his foes' posses-ions, Who cherishes Brhaspati well-tended, adorns and worships him as foremost sharer.

verses.sa:
स इत् क्षेति सुधित ओकसि स्वे तस्मा इळा पिन्वते विश्वदानीम् ।
तस्मै विशः स्वयमेवा नमन्ते यस्मिन् ब्रह्मा राजनि पूर्व एति॥
verses.tr: sa it kṣeti sudhita okasi sve tasmā iḻā pinvate viśvadānīm tasmai viśaḥ svayamevā namante yasmin brahmā rājani pūrva eti
verses.en: In his own house he dwells in peace and comfort: to him for ever holy food flows richly. To him the people with free will pay homage-the King with whom the Brahman hatb precedence.

verses.sa:
अप्रतीतो जयति सं धनानि प्रतिजन्यान्युत या सजन्या ।
अवस्यवे यो वरिवः कृणोति ब्रह्मणे राजा तमवन्ति देवाः॥
verses.tr: apratīto jayati saṃ dhanāni pratijanyānyuta yā sajanyā avasyave yo varivaḥ kṛṇoti brahmaṇe rājā tamavanti devāḥ
verses.en: He, unopposed, is master of the riches of his own subjects and of hostile people. The Gods uphold that King with their protection who helps the Brahman when he seeks his favour.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रश्च सोमं पिबतं बृहस्पतेऽस्मिन् यज्ञे मन्दसाना वृषण्वसू ।
आ वां विशन्त्विन्दवः स्वाभुवोऽस्मे रयिं सर्ववीरं नि यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: indraśca somaṃ pibataṃ bṛhaspate'smin yajñe mandasānā vṛṣaṇvasū ā vāṃ viśantvindavaḥ svābhuvo'sme rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchatam
verses.en: Indra, Brhaspati, rainers of treasure, rejoicing at this sacrifice drink the Soma. Let the abundant drops sink deep within you: vouchsafe us riches with full store of heroes.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पत इन्द्र वर्धतं नः सचा सा वां सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ।
अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्जजस्तमर्यो वनुषामरातीः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspata indra vardhataṃ naḥ sacā sā vāṃ sumatirbhūtvasme aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ puraṃdhīrjajastamaryo vanuṣāmarātīḥ
verses.en: Brhaspati and Indra, make us prosper may this be your benevolence to usward. Assist our holy thoughts, wake up our spirit: weaken the hatred of our foe and rivals.

verses.sa:
इदमु त्यत् पुरुतमं पुरस्ताज्ज्योतिस्तमसो वयुनावदस्थात् ।
नूनं दिवो दुहितरो विभातीर्गातुं कृणवन्नुषसो जनाय॥
verses.tr: idamu tyat purutamaṃ purastājjyotistamaso vayunāvadasthāt nūnaṃ divo duhitaro vibhātīrgātuṃ kṛṇavannuṣaso janāya
verses.en: Forth from the darkness in the region eastward this most abundant splendid light hath mounted. Now verily the far-refulgent Mornings, Daughters of Heaven, bring welfare to the people.

verses.sa:
अस्थुरु चित्रा उषसः पुरस्तान्मिता इव स्वरवोऽध्वरेषु ।
व्यू व्रजस्य तमसो द्वारोच्छन्तीरव्रञ्छुचयः पावकाः॥
verses.tr: asthuru citrā uṣasaḥ purastānmitā iva svaravo'dhvareṣu vyū vrajasya tamaso dvārocchantīravrañchucayaḥ pāvakāḥ
verses.en: The richly-coloured Dawns have mounted eastward, like pillars planted at our sacrifices, And, flushing far, splendid and purifying, unbarred the portals of the fold of darkness.

verses.sa:
उच्छन्तीरद्य चितयन्त भोजान् राधोदेयायोषसो मघोनीः ।
अचित्रे अन्तः पणयः ससन्त्वबुध्यमानास्तमसो विमध्ये॥
verses.tr: ucchantīradya citayanta bhojān rādhodeyāyoṣaso maghonīḥ acitre antaḥ paṇayaḥ sasantvabudhyamānāstamaso vimadhye
verses.en: Dispelling gloom this day the wealthy Mornings urge liberal givers to present their treasures. In the unlightened depth of darkness round them let niggard traffickers sleep unawakened.

verses.sa:
कुवित् स देवीः सनयो नवो वा यामो बभूयादुषसो वो अद्य ।
येना नवग्वे अङ्गिरे दशग्वे सप्तास्ये रेवती रेवदूष॥
verses.tr: kuvit sa devīḥ sanayo navo vā yāmo babhūyāduṣaso vo adya yenā navagve aṅgire daśagve saptāsye revatī revadūṣa
verses.en: O Goddesses, is this your car, I ask you, ancient this day, or is it new, ye Mornings, Wherewith, rich Dawns, ye seek with wealth Navagva, Dasagva Angira, the seven-toned singer?

verses.sa:
यूयं हि देवीर्ऋतयुग्भिरश्वैः परिप्रयाथ भुवनानि सद्यः ।
प्रबोधयन्तीरुषसः ससन्तं द्विपाच्चतुष्पाच्चरथाय जीवम्॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ hi devīrṛtayugbhiraśvaiḥ pariprayātha bhuvanāni sadyaḥ prabodhayantīruṣasaḥ sasantaṃ dvipāccatuṣpāccarathāya jīvam
verses.en: With horses harnessed by eternal Order, Goddesses, swiftly round the worlds ye travel, Arousing from their rest, O Dawns, the sleeping, and all that lives, man, bird, and beast, to motion.

verses.sa:
क्व स्विदासां कतमा पुराणी यया विधाना विदधुर्ऋभूणाम् ।
शुभं यच्छुभ्रा उषसश्चरन्ति न वि ज्ञायन्ते सदृशीरजुर्याः॥
verses.tr: kva svidāsāṃ katamā purāṇī yayā vidhānā vidadhurṛbhūṇām śubhaṃ yacchubhrā uṣasaścaranti na vi jñāyante sadṛśīrajuryāḥ
verses.en: Which among these is eldest, and where is she through whom they fixed the Rbhus' regulations? What time the splendid Dawns go forth for splendour, they are not known apart alike, unwasting.

verses.sa:
ता घा ता भद्रा उषसः पुरासुरभिष्टिद्युम्ना ऋतजातसत्याः ।
यास्वीजानः शशमान उक्थैः स्तुवञ्छंसन् द्रविणं सद्य आप॥
verses.tr: tā ghā tā bhadrā uṣasaḥ purāsurabhiṣṭidyumnā ṛtajātasatyāḥ yāsvījānaḥ śaśamāna ukthaiḥ stuvañchaṃsan draviṇaṃ sadya āpa
verses.en: Blest were these Dawns of old, shining with succour, true with the truth that springs from holy Order; With whom the toiling worshipper, by praises, hymning and lauding, soon attained to riches.

verses.sa:
ता आ चरन्ति समना पुरस्तात् समानतः समना पप्रथानाः ।
ऋतस्य देवीः सदसो बुधाना गवां न सर्गा उषसो जरन्ते॥
verses.tr: tā ā caranti samanā purastāt samānataḥ samanā paprathānāḥ ṛtasya devīḥ sadaso budhānā gavāṃ na sargā uṣaso jarante
verses.en: Hither from eastward all at once they travel, from one place spreading in the selfsame manner. Awaking, from the seat of holy Order the Godlike Dawns come nigh like troops of cattle.

verses.sa:
ता इन्न्वे३व समना समानीरमीतवर्णा उषसश्चरन्ति ।
गूहन्तीरभ्वमसितं रुशद्भिः शुक्रास्तनूभिः शुचयो रुचानाः॥
verses.tr: tā innve3va samanā samānīramītavarṇā uṣasaścaranti gūhantīrabhvamasitaṃ ruśadbhiḥ śukrāstanūbhiḥ śucayo rucānāḥ
verses.en: Thus they go forth with undiminished colours, these Mornings similar, in self-same fashion, Concealing the gigantic might of darkness with radiant bodies bright and pure and shining.

verses.sa:
रयिं दिवो दुहितरो विभातीः प्रजावन्तं यच्छतास्मासु देवीः ।
स्योनादा वः प्रतिबुध्यमानाः सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम॥
verses.tr: rayiṃ divo duhitaro vibhātīḥ prajāvantaṃ yacchatāsmāsu devīḥ syonādā vaḥ pratibudhyamānāḥ suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma
verses.en: O Goddesses, O Heaven's refulgent Daughters, bestow upon us wealth with store of children. As from our pleasant place of rest ye rouse us may we be masters of heroic vigour.

verses.sa:
तद् वो दिवो दुहितरो विभातीरुप ब्रुव उषसो यज्ञकेतुः ।
वयं स्याम यशसो जनेषु तद् द्यौश्च धत्तां पृथिवी च देवी॥
verses.tr: tad vo divo duhitaro vibhātīrupa bruva uṣaso yajñaketuḥ vayaṃ syāma yaśaso janeṣu tad dyauśca dhattāṃ pṛthivī ca devī
verses.en: Well-skilled in lore of sacrifice, ye Daughters of Heaven, refulgent Dawns, I thus address you. May we be glorious among the people. May Heaven vouchsafe us this, and Earth the Goddess,

verses.sa: प्रति ष्या सूनरी जनी व्युच्छन्ती परि स्वसुः । दिवो अदर्शि दुहिता॥
verses.tr: prati ṣyā sūnarī janī vyucchantī pari svasuḥ divo adarśi duhitā
verses.en: This Lady, giver of delight, after her Sister shining forth, Daughter of Heaven, hath shown herself.-

verses.sa: अश्वेव चित्रारुषी माता गवामृतावरी । सखाभूदश्विनोरुषाः॥
verses.tr: aśveva citrāruṣī mātā gavāmṛtāvarī sakhābhūdaśvinoruṣāḥ
verses.en: Unfailing, Mother of the Kine, in colour like a bright red mare, The Dawn became the Asvins' Friend.

verses.sa: उत सखास्यश्विनोरुत माता गवामसि । उतोषो वस्व ईशिषे॥
verses.tr: uta sakhāsyaśvinoruta mātā gavāmasi utoṣo vasva īśiṣe
verses.en: Yea, and thou art the Asvins' Friend, the Mother of the Kine art thou: O Dawn thou rulest over wealth.

verses.sa: यावयद्द्वेषसं त्वा चिकित्वित् सूनृतावरि । प्रति स्तोमैरभुत्स्महि॥
verses.tr: yāvayaddveṣasaṃ tvā cikitvit sūnṛtāvari prati stomairabhutsmahi
verses.en: Thinking of thee, O joyous One, as her who driveth hate away, We woke to meet thee with our lauds.

verses.sa: प्रति भद्रा अदृक्षत गवां सर्गा न रश्मयः । ओषा अप्रा उरु ज्रयः॥
verses.tr: prati bhadrā adṛkṣata gavāṃ sargā na raśmayaḥ oṣā aprā uru jrayaḥ
verses.en: Our eyes behold thy blessed rays like troops of cattle loosed to feed. Dawn hath filled full the wide expanse.

verses.sa: आपप्रुषी विभावरि व्यावर्ज्योतिषा तमः । उषो अनु स्वधामव॥
verses.tr: āpapruṣī vibhāvari vyāvarjyotiṣā tamaḥ uṣo anu svadhāmava
verses.en: When thou hast filled it, Fulgent One! thou layest bare the gloom with light. After thy nature aid us, Dawn.

verses.sa: आ द्यां तनोषि रश्मिभिरान्तरिक्षमुरु प्रियम् । उषः शुक्रेण शोचिषा॥
verses.tr: ā dyāṃ tanoṣi raśmibhirāntarikṣamuru priyam uṣaḥ śukreṇa śociṣā
verses.en: Thou overspreadest heaven with rays, the dear wide region of mid-air. With thy bright shining lustre, Dawn.

verses.sa:
तद् देवस्य सवितुर्वार्यं महद् वृणीमहे असुरस्य प्रचेतसः ।
छर्दिर्येन दाशुषे यच्छति त्मना तन्नो महाँ उदयान् देवो अक्तुभिः॥
verses.tr: tad devasya saviturvāryaṃ mahad vṛṇīmahe asurasya pracetasaḥ chardiryena dāśuṣe yacchati tmanā tanno mahāṃ udayān devo aktubhiḥ
verses.en: Of Savitar the God, the sapient Asura, we crave this great gift which is worthy of our choice, Wherewith he freely grants his worshiper defense. This with his rays the Great God hath vouchsafed to us.

verses.sa:
दिवो धर्ता भुवनस्य प्रजापतिः पिशङ्गं द्रापिं प्रति मुञ्चते कविः ।
विचक्षणः प्रथयन्नापृणन्नुर्वजीजनत् सविता सुम्नमुक्थ्यम्॥
verses.tr: divo dhartā bhuvanasya prajāpatiḥ piśaṅgaṃ drāpiṃ prati muñcate kaviḥ vicakṣaṇaḥ prathayannāpṛṇannurvajījanat savitā sumnamukthyam
verses.en: Sustainer of the heaven, Lord of the whole world's life, the Sage, he putteth on his golden-coloured mail. Clear-sighted, spreading far, filling the spacious realm, Savitar hath brought forth bliss that deserveth laud.

verses.sa:
आप्रा रजांसि दिव्यानि पार्थिवा श्लोकं देवः कृणुते स्वाय धर्मणे ।
प्र बाहू अस्राक् सविता सवीमनि निवेशयन्प्रसुवन्नक्तुभिर्जगत्॥
verses.tr: āprā rajāṃsi divyāni pārthivā ślokaṃ devaḥ kṛṇute svāya dharmaṇe pra bāhū asrāk savitā savīmani niveśayanprasuvannaktubhirjagat
verses.en: He hath filled full the regions of the heaven and earth: the God for his own strengthening waketh up the hymn. Savitar hath stretched out his arms to cherish life, producing with his rays and lulling all that moves.

verses.sa:
अदाभ्यो भुवनानि प्रचाकशद् व्रतानि देवः सविताभि रक्षते ।
प्रास्राग्बाहू भुवनस्य प्रजाभ्यो धृतव्रतो महो अज्मस्य राजति॥
verses.tr: adābhyo bhuvanāni pracākaśad vratāni devaḥ savitābhi rakṣate prāsrāgbāhū bhuvanasya prajābhyo dhṛtavrato maho ajmasya rājati
verses.en: Lighting all living creatures, ne'er to be deceived, Savitar, God, protects each holy ordinance. He hath stretched out his arms to all the folk of earth, and, with his laws observed, rules his own mighty course.

verses.sa:
त्रिरन्तरिक्षं सविता महित्वना त्री रजांसि परिभुस्त्रीणि रोचना ।
तिस्रो दिवः पृथिवीस्तिस्र इन्वति त्रिभिर्व्रतैरभि नो रक्षति त्मना॥
verses.tr: trirantarikṣaṃ savitā mahitvanā trī rajāṃsi paribhustrīṇi rocanā tisro divaḥ pṛthivīstisra invati tribhirvratairabhi no rakṣati tmanā
verses.en: Savitar thrice surrounding with his mightiness mid-air, three regions, and the triple sphere of light, Sets the three heavens in motion and the threefold earth, and willingly protects us with his triple law.

verses.sa:
बृहत्सुम्नः प्रसवीता निवेशनो जगतः स्थातुरुभयस्य यो वशी ।
स नो देवः सविता शर्म यच्छत्वस्मे क्षयाय त्रिवरूथमंहसः॥
verses.tr: bṛhatsumnaḥ prasavītā niveśano jagataḥ sthāturubhayasya yo vaśī sa no devaḥ savitā śarma yacchatvasme kṣayāya trivarūthamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Most gracious God, who brings to life and lulls to rest, he who controls the world, what moves not and what moves, May he vouchsafe us shelter, -Savitar the God,- for tranquil life, with triple bar against distress.

verses.sa:
आगन् देव ऋतुभिर्वर्धतु क्षयं दधातु नः सविता सुप्रजामिषम् ।
स नः क्षपाभिरहभिश्च जिन्वतु प्रजावन्तं रयिमस्मे समिन्वतु॥
verses.tr: āgan deva ṛtubhirvardhatu kṣayaṃ dadhātu naḥ savitā suprajāmiṣam sa naḥ kṣapābhirahabhiśca jinvatu prajāvantaṃ rayimasme saminvatu
verses.en: With the year's seasons hath Savitar, God, come nigh: may he prosper our home, give food and noble sons. May he invigorate us through the days and nights, and may he send us opulence with progeny.

verses.sa:
अभूद् देवः सविता वन्द्यो नु न इदानीमह्न उपवाच्यो नृभिः ।
वि यो रत्ना भजति मानवेभ्यः श्रेष्ठं नो अत्र द्रविणं यथा दधत्॥
verses.tr: abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nu na idānīmahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇaṃ yathā dadhat
verses.en: Now must we praise and honour Savitar the God: at this time of the day the men must call to him, Him who distributes wealth to Manu's progeny, that he may grant us here riches most excellent.

verses.sa:
देवेभ्यो हि प्रथमं यज्ञियेभ्योऽमृतत्वं सुवसि भागमुत्तमम् ।
आदिद् दामानं सवितर्व्यूर्णुषेऽनूचीना जीविता मानुषेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: devebhyo hi prathamaṃ yajñiyebhyo'mṛtatvaṃ suvasi bhāgamuttamam ādid dāmānaṃ savitarvyūrṇuṣe'nūcīnā jīvitā mānuṣebhyaḥ
verses.en: For thou at first producest for the holy Gods the noblest of all portions, immortality: Thereafter as a gift to men, O Savitar, thou openest existence, life succeeding life.

verses.sa:
अचित्ती यच्चकृमा दैव्ये जने दीनैर्दक्षैः प्रभूती पूरुषत्वता ।
देवेषु च सवितर्मानुषेषु च त्वं नो अत्र सुवतादनागसः॥
verses.tr: acittī yaccakṛmā daivye jane dīnairdakṣaiḥ prabhūtī pūruṣatvatā deveṣu ca savitarmānuṣeṣu ca tvaṃ no atra suvatādanāgasaḥ
verses.en: If we, men as we are, have sinned against the Gods through want of thought, in weakness, or through insolence, Absolve us from the guilt and make us free from sin, O Savitar, alike among both Gods and men.

verses.sa:
न प्रमिये सवितुर्दैव्यस्य तद् यथा विश्वं भुवनं धारयिष्यति ।
यत् पृथिव्या वरिमन्ना स्वङ्गुरिर्वर्ष्मन् दिवः सुवति सत्यमस्य तत्॥
verses.tr: na pramiye saviturdaivyasya tad yathā viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ dhārayiṣyati yat pṛthivyā varimannā svaṅgurirvarṣman divaḥ suvati satyamasya tat
verses.en: None may impede that power of Savitar the God whereby he will maintain the universal world. What the fair-fingered God brings forth on earth's expanse or in the height of heaven, that work of his stands sure.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रज्येष्ठान् बृहद्भ्यः पर्वतेभ्यः क्षयाँ एभ्यः सुवसि पस्त्यावतः ।
यथायथा पतयन्तो वियेमिर एवैव तस्थुः सवितः सवाय ते॥
verses.tr: indrajyeṣṭhān bṛhadbhyaḥ parvatebhyaḥ kṣayāṃ ebhyaḥ suvasi pastyāvataḥ yathāyathā patayanto viyemira evaiva tasthuḥ savitaḥ savāya te
verses.en: To lofty hills thou sendest those whom Indra leads, and givest fixed abodes with houses unto these. However they may fly and draw themselves apart, still, Savitar, they stand obeying thy behest.

verses.sa:
ये ते त्रिरहन् त्सवितः सवासो दिवेदिवे सौभगमासुवन्ति ।
इन्द्रो द्यावापृथिवी सिन्धुरद्भिरादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यंसत्॥
verses.tr: ye te trirahan tsavitaḥ savāso divedive saubhagamāsuvanti indro dyāvāpṛthivī sindhuradbhirādityairno aditiḥ śarma yaṃsat
verses.en: May the libations poured to thee thrice daily, day after day, O Savitar, bring us blessing. May Indra, Heaven, Earth, Sindhu with the Waters, Aditi with Adityas, give us shelter.

verses.sa:
को वस्त्राता वसवः को वरूता द्यावाभूमी अदिते त्रासीथां नः ।
सहीयसो वरुण मित्र मर्तात् को वोऽध्वरे वरिवो धाति देवाः॥
verses.tr: ko vastrātā vasavaḥ ko varūtā dyāvābhūmī adite trāsīthāṃ naḥ sahīyaso varuṇa mitra martāt ko vo'dhvare varivo dhāti devāḥ
verses.en: Who of you, Vasus, saveth? who protecteth? O Heaven and Earth and Aditi, preserve us, Varuna., Mitra, from the stronger mortal. Gods, which of you at sacrifice giveth comfort?

verses.sa:
प्र ये धामानि पूर्व्याण्यर्चान् वि यदुच्छान् वियोतारो अमूराः ।
विधातारो वि ते दधुरजस्रा ऋतधीतयो रुरुचन्त दस्माः॥
verses.tr: pra ye dhāmāni pūrvyāṇyarcān vi yaducchān viyotāro amūrāḥ vidhātāro vi te dadhurajasrā ṛtadhītayo rurucanta dasmāḥ
verses.en: They who with laud extol the ancient statutes, when they shine forth infallible dividers, Have ordered as perpetual Ordainers, and beamed as holy-thoughted WonderWorkers.

verses.sa:
प्र पस्त्या३मदितिं सिन्धुमर्कैः स्वस्तिमीळे सख्याय देवीम् ।
उभे यथा नो अहनी निपात उषासानक्ता करतामदब्धे॥
verses.tr: pra pastyā3maditiṃ sindhumarkaiḥ svastimīḻe sakhyāya devīm ubhe yathā no ahanī nipāta uṣāsānaktā karatāmadabdhe
verses.en: The Housewife Goddess, Aditi, and Sindhu, the Goddess Svasti I implore for friendship: And may the unobstructed Night and Morning both, day and night, provide for our protection.

verses.sa:
व्यर्यमा वरुणश्चेति पन्थामिषस्पतिः सुवितं गातुमग्निः ।
इन्द्राविष्णू नृवदु षु स्तवाना शर्म नो यन्तममवद् वरूथम्॥
verses.tr: vyaryamā varuṇaśceti panthāmiṣaspatiḥ suvitaṃ gātumagniḥ indrāviṣṇū nṛvadu ṣu stavānā śarma no yantamamavad varūtham
verses.en: Aryaman, Varuna have disclosed the pathway, Agni as Lord of Strength the road to welfare. Lauded in manly mode may Indra-Visnu grant us their powerful defense and shelter.

verses.sa:
आ पर्वतस्य मरुतामवांसि देवस्य त्रातुरव्रि भगस्य ।
पात् पतिर्जन्यादंहसो नो मित्रो मित्रियादुत न उरुष्येत्॥
verses.tr: ā parvatasya marutāmavāṃsi devasya trāturavri bhagasya pāt patirjanyādaṃhaso no mitro mitriyāduta na uruṣyet
verses.en: I have besought the favourof the Maruts, of Parvata, of Bhaga God who rescues. From trouble caused by man the Lord preserve us; from woe sent by his friend let Mitra save us.

verses.sa:
नू रोदसी अहिना बुध्न्येन स्तुवीत देवी अप्येभिरिष्टैः ।
समुद्रं न संचरणे सनिष्यवो घर्मस्वरसो नद्यो३ अप व्रन्॥
verses.tr: nū rodasī ahinā budhnyena stuvīta devī apyebhiriṣṭaiḥ samudraṃ na saṃcaraṇe saniṣyavo gharmasvaraso nadyo3 apa vran
verses.en: Agree, through these our watery oblations, Goddesses, Heaven and Earth, with Ahibudhnya. As if to win the sea, the Gharma-heaters have opened, as they come anear, the rivers.

verses.sa:
देवैर्नो देव्यदितिर्नि पातु देवस्त्राता त्रायतामप्रयुच्छन् ।
नहि मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धासिमर्हामसि प्रमियं सान्वग्नेः॥
verses.tr: devairno devyaditirni pātu devastrātā trāyatāmaprayucchan nahi mitrasya varuṇasya dhāsimarhāmasi pramiyaṃ sānvagneḥ
verses.en: May Goddess Aditi with Gods defend us, save us the saviour God with care unceasing. We dare not stint the sacred food of Mitra and Varuna upon the back of Agni.

verses.sa: अग्निरीशे वसव्यस्याग्निर्महः सौभगस्य । तान्यस्मभ्यं रासते॥
verses.tr: agnirīśe vasavyasyāgnirmahaḥ saubhagasya tānyasmabhyaṃ rāsate
verses.en: Agni is Sovran Lord of wealth, Agni of great prosperity: May he bestow these gifts on us.

verses.sa: उषो मघोन्या वह सूनृते वार्या पुरु । अस्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति॥
verses.tr: uṣo maghonyā vaha sūnṛte vāryā puru asmabhyaṃ vājinīvati
verses.en: Hither to us, rich pleasant Dawn, bring many things to be desired, Thou who hast ample store of wealth.

verses.sa: तत् सु नः सविता भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । इन्द्रो नो राधसा गमत्॥
verses.tr: tat su naḥ savitā bhago varuṇo mitro aryamā indro no rādhasā gamat
verses.en: So then may Bhaga, Savitar, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Indra, with bounty come to us.

verses.sa:
मही द्यावापृथिवी इह ज्येष्ठे रुचा भवतां शुचयद्भिरर्कैः ।
यत् सीं वरिष्ठे बृहती विमिन्वन् रुवद्धोक्षा पप्रथानेभिरेवैः॥
verses.tr: mahī dyāvāpṛthivī iha jyeṣṭhe rucā bhavatāṃ śucayadbhirarkaiḥ yat sīṃ variṣṭhe bṛhatī viminvan ruvaddhokṣā paprathānebhirevaiḥ
verses.en: May mighty Heaven and Earth, most meet for honour, be present here with light and gleaming splendours; When, fixing them apart, vast, most extensive, the Steer roars loudly in far-reaching courses.

verses.sa:
देवी देवेभिर्यजते यजत्रैरमिनती तस्थतुरुक्षमाणे ।
ऋतावरी अद्रुहा देवपुत्रे यज्ञस्य नेत्री शुचयद्भिरर्कैः॥
verses.tr: devī devebhiryajate yajatrairaminatī tasthaturukṣamāṇe ṛtāvarī adruhā devaputre yajñasya netrī śucayadbhirarkaiḥ
verses.en: The Goddesses with Gods, holy with holy, the Two stand pouring out their rain, exhaustless: Faithful and guileless, having Gods for children, leaders of sacrifice with shining splendours.

verses.sa:
स इत् स्वपा भुवनेष्वास य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जजान ।
उर्वी गभीरे रजसी सुमेके अवंशे धीरः शच्या समैरत्॥
verses.tr: sa it svapā bhuvaneṣvāsa ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī jajāna urvī gabhīre rajasī sumeke avaṃśe dhīraḥ śacyā samairat
verses.en: Sure in the worlds he was a skillful Craftsman, he who produced these Twain the Earth and Heaven. Wise, with his power he brought both realms, together spacious and deep, wellfashioned, unsupported.

verses.sa:
नू रोदसी बृहद्भिर्नो वरूथैः पत्नीवद्भिरिषयन्ती सजोषाः ।
उरूची विश्वे यजते नि पातं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः॥
verses.tr: nū rodasī bṛhadbhirno varūthaiḥ patnīvadbhiriṣayantī sajoṣāḥ urūcī viśve yajate ni pātaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
verses.en: O Heaven and Earth, with one accord promoting, with high protection as of Queens, our welfare, Far-reaching, universal, holy, guard us. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa: प्र वां महि द्यवी अभ्युपस्तुतिं भरामहे । शुची उप प्रशस्तये॥
verses.tr: pra vāṃ mahi dyavī abhyupastutiṃ bharāmahe śucī upa praśastaye
verses.en: To both of you, O Heaven and Earth, we bring our lofty song of praise, Pure Ones! to glorify you both.

verses.sa: पुनाने तन्वा मिथः स्वेन दक्षेण राजथः । ऊह्याथे सनादृतम्॥
verses.tr: punāne tanvā mithaḥ svena dakṣeṇa rājathaḥ ūhyāthe sanādṛtam
verses.en: Ye sanctify each other's form, by your own proper might ye rule, And from of old observe the Law.

verses.sa: मही मित्रस्य साधथस्तरन्ती पिप्रती ऋतम् । परि यज्ञं नि षेदथुः॥
verses.tr: mahī mitrasya sādhathastarantī pipratī ṛtam pari yajñaṃ ni ṣedathuḥ
verses.en: Furthering and fulfilling, ye, O Mighty, perfect Mitra's Law. Ye sit around our sacrifice.

sections.label: To the lord of the field
sections.name: Mandala 4, hymn 57

verses.sa:
क्षेत्रस्य पतिना वयं हितेनेव जयामसि ।
गामश्वं पोषयित्न्वा स नो मृळातीदृशे॥
verses.tr: kṣetrasya patinā vayaṃ hiteneva jayāmasi gāmaśvaṃ poṣayitnvā sa no mṛḻātīdṛśe
verses.en: We through the Master of the Field, even as through a friend, obtain What nourisheth our kine and steeds. In such may he be good to us.

verses.sa:
क्षेत्रस्य पते मधुमन्तमूर्मिं धेनुरिव पयो अस्मासु धुक्ष्व ।
मधुश्चुतं घृतमिव सुपूतमृतस्य नः पतयो मृळयन्तु॥
verses.tr: kṣetrasya pate madhumantamūrmiṃ dhenuriva payo asmāsu dhukṣva madhuścutaṃ ghṛtamiva supūtamṛtasya naḥ patayo mṛḻayantu
verses.en: As the cow yieldeth milk, pour for us freely, Lord of the Field, the wave that beareth sweetness, Distilling meath, well-purified like butter, and let the. Lords of holy Law be gracious.

verses.sa:
मधुमतीरोषधीर्द्याव आपो मधुमन्नो भवत्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
क्षेत्रस्य पतिर्मधुमान् नो अस्त्वरिष्यन्तो अन्वेनं चरेम॥
verses.tr: madhumatīroṣadhīrdyāva āpo madhumanno bhavatvantarikṣam kṣetrasya patirmadhumān no astvariṣyanto anvenaṃ carema
verses.en: Sweet be the plants for us. the heavens, the waters, and full of sweets for us be air's mid-region. May the Field's Lord for us be full of sweetness, and may we follow after him uninjured.

verses.sa:
शुनं वाहाः शुनं नरः शुनं कृषतु लाङ्गलम् ।
शुनं वरत्रा बध्यन्तां शुनमष्ट्रामुदिङ्गय॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ vāhāḥ śunaṃ naraḥ śunaṃ kṛṣatu lāṅgalam śunaṃ varatrā badhyantāṃ śunamaṣṭrāmudiṅgaya
verses.en: Happily work our steers and men, may the plough furrow happily. Happily be the traces bound; happily may he ply the goad.

verses.sa: शुनासीराविमां वाचं जुषेथां यद् दिवि चक्रथुः पयः । तेनेमामुप सिञ्चतम्॥
verses.tr: śunāsīrāvimāṃ vācaṃ juṣethāṃ yad divi cakrathuḥ payaḥ tenemāmupa siñcatam
verses.en: Suna and Sira, welcome ye this laud, and with the milk which ye have made in heaven Bedew ye both this earth of ours.

verses.sa: अर्वाची सुभगे भव सीते वन्दामहे त्वा । यथा नः सुभगाससि यथा नः सुफलाससि॥
verses.tr: arvācī subhage bhava sīte vandāmahe tvā yathā naḥ subhagāsasi yathā naḥ suphalāsasi
verses.en: Auspicious Sita, come thou near: we venerate and worship thee That thou mayst bless and prosper us and bring us fruits abundantly.

verses.sa: इन्द्रः सीतां नि गृह्णातु तां पूषानु यच्छतु । सा नः पयस्वती दुहामुत्तरामुत्तरां समाम्॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sītāṃ ni gṛhṇātu tāṃ pūṣānu yacchatu sā naḥ payasvatī duhāmuttarāmuttarāṃ samām
verses.en: May Indra press the furrow down, may Pusan guide its course aright. May she, as rich in milk, be drained for us through each succeeding year.

verses.sa:
शुनं नः फाला वि कृषन्तु भूमिं शुनं कीनाशा अभि यन्तु वाहैः ।
शुनं पर्जन्यो मधुना पयोभिः शुनासीरा शुनमस्मासु धत्तम्॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ naḥ phālā vi kṛṣantu bhūmiṃ śunaṃ kīnāśā abhi yantu vāhaiḥ śunaṃ parjanyo madhunā payobhiḥ śunāsīrā śunamasmāsu dhattam
verses.en: Happily let the shares turn up the ploughland, happily go the ploughers with the oxen. With meath and milk Parjanya make us happy. Grant us prosperity, Suna and Sira.

verses.sa:
समुद्रादूर्मिर्मधुमाँ उदारदुपांशुना सममृतत्वमानट् ।
घृतस्य नाम गुह्यं यदस्ति जिह्वा देवानाममृतस्य नाभिः॥
verses.tr: samudrādūrmirmadhumāṃ udāradupāṃśunā samamṛtatvamānaṭ ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yadasti jihvā devānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ
verses.en: Forth from the ocean sprang the wave of sweetness: together with the stalk it turned to Amrta, That which is holy oil's mysterious title: but the Gods' tongue is truly Amrta's centre.

verses.sa:
वयं नाम प्र ब्रवामा घृतस्याऽस्मिन् यज्ञे धारयामा नमोभिः ।
उप ब्रह्मा शृणवच्छस्यमानं चतुःशृङ्गोऽवमीद् गौर एतत्॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ nāma pra bravāmā ghṛtasyā'smin yajñe dhārayāmā namobhiḥ upa brahmā śṛṇavacchasyamānaṃ catuḥśṛṅgo'vamīd gaura etat
verses.en: Let us declare aloud the name of Ghrta, and at this sacrifice hold it up with homage. So let the Brahman hear the praise we utter. This hath the four-horned Buffalo emitted.

verses.sa:
चत्वारि शृङ्गा त्रयो अस्य पादा द्वे शीर्षे सप्त हस्तासो अस्य ।
त्रिधा बद्धो वृषभो रोरवीति महो देवो मर्त्याँ आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe sapta hastāso asya tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti maho devo martyāṃ ā viveśa
verses.en: Four are his horns, three are the feet that bear him; his heads are two, his hands are seven in number. Bound with a triple bond the Steer roars loudly: the mighty God hath entered in to mortals.

verses.sa:
त्रिधा हितं पणिभिर्गुह्यमानं गवि देवासो घृतमन्वविन्दन् ।
इन्द्र एकं सूर्य एकं जजान वेनादेकं स्वधया निष्टतक्षुः॥
verses.tr: tridhā hitaṃ paṇibhirguhyamānaṃ gavi devāso ghṛtamanvavindan indra ekaṃ sūrya ekaṃ jajāna venādekaṃ svadhayā niṣṭatakṣuḥ
verses.en: That oil in triple shape the Gods discovered laid down within the Cow, concealed by Panis. Indra produced one shape, Surya another: by their own power they formed the third from Vena.

verses.sa:
एता अर्षन्ति हृद्यात् समुद्राच्छतव्रजा रिपुणा नावचक्षे ।
घृतस्य धारा अभि चाकशीमि हिरण्ययो वेतसो मध्य आसाम्॥
verses.tr: etā arṣanti hṛdyāt samudrācchatavrajā ripuṇā nāvacakṣe ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhya āsām
verses.en: From inmost reservoir in countless channels flow down these rivers which the foe beholds not. I look upon the streams of oil descending, and lo! the Golden Reed is there among them.

verses.sa:
सम्यक् स्रवन्ति सरितो न धेना अन्तर्हृदा मनसा पूयमानाः ।
एते अर्षन्त्यूर्मयो घृतस्य मृगा इव क्षिपणोरीषमाणाः॥
verses.tr: samyak sravanti sarito na dhenā antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ ete arṣantyūrmayo ghṛtasya mṛgā iva kṣipaṇorīṣamāṇāḥ
verses.en: Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves in inmost heart and spirit. The streams of holy oil pour swiftly downward like the wild beasts that fly before the bowman.

verses.sa:
सिन्धोरिव प्राध्वने शूघनासो वातप्रमियः पतयन्ति यह्वाः ।
घृतस्य धारा अरुषो न वाजी काष्ठा भिन्दन्नूर्मिभिः पिन्वमानः॥
verses.tr: sindhoriva prādhvane śūghanāso vātapramiyaḥ patayanti yahvāḥ ghṛtasya dhārā aruṣo na vājī kāṣṭhā bhindannūrmibhiḥ pinvamānaḥ
verses.en: As rushing down the rapids of a river, flow swifter than the wind the vigorous currents, The streams of oil in swelling fluctuation like a red courser bursting through the fences.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रवन्त समनेव योषाः कल्याण्य१ः स्मयमानासो अग्निम् ।
घृतस्य धाराः समिधो नसन्त ता जुषाणो हर्यति जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: abhi pravanta samaneva yoṣāḥ kalyāṇya1ḥ smayamānāso agnim ghṛtasya dhārāḥ samidho nasanta tā juṣāṇo haryati jātavedāḥ
verses.en: Like women at a gathering fair to look on and gently smiling, they incline to Agni. The streams of holy oil attain the fuel, and Jatavedas joyfully receives them.

verses.sa:
कन्या इव वहतुमेतवा उ अञ्ज्यञ्जाना अभि चाकशीमि ।
यत्र सोमः सूयते यत्र यज्ञो घृतस्य धारा अभि तत्पवन्ते॥
verses.tr: kanyā iva vahatumetavā u añjyañjānā abhi cākaśīmi yatra somaḥ sūyate yatra yajño ghṛtasya dhārā abhi tatpavante
verses.en: As maidens dock themselves with gay adornment to join the bridal feast, I now behold them. Where Soma flows and sacrifice is ready, thither the streams of holy oil are running.

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्षत सुष्टुतिं गव्यमाजिमस्मासु भद्रा द्रविणानि धत्त ।
इमं यज्ञं नयत देवता नो घृतस्य धारा मधुमत्पवन्ते॥
verses.tr: abhyarṣata suṣṭutiṃ gavyamājimasmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumatpavante
verses.en: Send to our eulogy a herd of cattle bestow upon us excellent possessions. Bear to the Gods the sacrifice we offer the streams of oil flow pure and full of sweetness.

verses.sa:
धामन् ते विश्वं भुवनमधि श्रितमन्तः समुद्रे हृद्य१न्तरायुषि ।
अपामनीके समिथे य आभृतस्तमश्याम मधुमन्तं त ऊर्मिम्॥
verses.tr: dhāman te viśvaṃ bhuvanamadhi śritamantaḥ samudre hṛdya1ntarāyuṣi apāmanīke samithe ya ābhṛtastamaśyāma madhumantaṃ ta ūrmim
verses.en: The universe depends upon thy power and might within the sea, within the heart, within all life.
